items.summary_ja: 肥満/過体重を伴う2型糖尿病成人を対象に、デュアルアゴニストCagriSemaのセマグルチド単独療法、カグリリンチド単独療法、プラセボに対する有効性及び安全性を評価したランダム化比較試験（RCT）の系統的レビューおよびペアワイズメタ解析。Embase、MEDLINE、PubMed、Cochrane Libraryを2026年6月14日までに検索し、8件のRCT（6,898名）を含む。ランダム効果モデルを用いて個別のペアワイズメタ解析を実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CagriSemaは、既存の標準単独療法およびプラセボと比較して、体重減少、血糖コントロール、脂質コントロールにおいて優越性を示したが、有害事象（特に消化管有害事象）は増加した。
items.why_matters_ja: 過体重、肥満、糖尿病は長期的管理を要する重大な社会経済的負担であり、CagriSemaというデュアルアゴニストが既存の単独療法を上回る代謝アウトカムをもたらす可能性は、治療選択肢の拡大に寄与しうる。ただし、長期的心血管エンドポイントの欠如が限界として指摘されている。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびペアワイズメタ解析（ランダム化比較試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少率（percentage body weight reduction）、ヘモグロビンA1c（HbA1c）減少率、絶対体重、腹囲、BMI、血圧、C反応性蛋白（CRP）、脂質プロファイル、全有害事象、消化管有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: 体重減少率：CagriSema vs セマグルチド [MD -6.60%; 95%CI: -8.51 to -4.68; P<0.0001; I2=82%]、vs カグリリンチド [MD -8.15%; 95%CI: -11.40 to -4.89; P<0.0001; I2=95%]、vs プラセボ [MD -14.30%; 95%CI: -17.41 to -11.19; P<0.0001; I2=99%]。HbA1c減少率：CagriSema vs セマグルチド [MD -0.09%; 95%CI: -0.14 to -0.04; P=0.0004; I2=39%]、vs カグリリンチド [MD -0.87%; 95%CI: -1.48 to -0.26; P=0.005; I2=97%]、vs プラセボ [MD -1.55%; 95%CI: -2.14 to -0.97; P<0.0001; I2=99%]。絶対体重、腹囲、BMI：全比較対照群で有意な減少（all p<0.0001）。血圧：カグリリンチドおよびプラセボより優位に良好、セマグルチドと同等。CRP：カグリリンチドおよびプラセボより有意に減少。脂質プロファイル：カグリリンチドおよびプラセボより有意に改善。有害事象：全比較対照群と比較して全有害事象および消化管有害事象が増加。

items.title: A longitudinal case report illustrating diagnostic complexity among overlapping sleep-wake phenotypes.
items.abstract: The coexistence of multiple primary sleep disorders in a single patient is uncommon and poses significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. We report a 45-year-old woman with severe mixed sleep apnea (OSA/CSA), NREM parasomnia (night terrors), sleep-related eating disorder (SRED), nightmare disorder (with RBD like behavior but no REM atonia on PSG), and central hypersomnolence phenotype minimally affected with PAP optimization and delayed sleep-wake phase disorder. Symptoms began more than two decades earlier and included violent dream-enactment behaviors, hypnopompic hallucinations, sleep inertia, and chronic excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS). Treatment required multi-modal therapy. Positive airway pressure therapy successfully treated sleep disordered breathing while pitolisant and solriamfetol produced the most durable improvement in daytime sleepiness. Together melatonin plus clonazepam reduced parasomnia frequency and severity. Several other agents (including prazosin, sodium oxybate, paroxetine, and modafinil) were tried and discontinued for limited benefit or adverse effects. Notably, GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) therapy for obesity was followed by a substantial weight loss and coincided with resolution of SRED. Because this occurred alongside improved sleep stability, PAP adherence, behavioral adaptation, and medication changes, causality cannot be inferred. The observation may justify further study of metabolic and incretin-related pathways in sleep-related eating behaviors. Overall, this case highlights the complexity of overlapping sleep-wake disorders, the need for individualized pharmacologic sequencing, and a potential emerging role for GLP-1 agonists in SRED.
items.authors: Martirosyan Zara, Whitesell Peter
items.summary_ja: 45歳女性において、混合型睡眠時無呼吸（OSA/CSA）、NREMパラソムニア（夜驚症）、睡眠関連摂食障害（SRED）、悪夢障害（RBD様行動ありだがPSGでREMアトニアなし）、中枢性過眠フェノタイプ、および遅延睡眠覚醒型障害が併存した縦断的症例報告。症状は20年以上前に発症し、暴力的な夢行動、覚醒前幻覚、睡眠慣性、慢性の過剰日中眠気（EDS）を伴った。治療には多面的なアプローチが必要であり、PAPで睡眠時呼吸障害を治療、ピトリサンとソリアムフェトールで日中眠気に最も持続的な改善、メラトニンとクロナゼパムでパラソムニアの頻度と重症度を軽減した。GLP-1受容体作動薬による減量とSREDの解決が同時期に観察されたが、因果関係は推定できない。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 重複する睡眠覚醒障害の複雑性、個別化された薬物療法の順序設計の必要性、およびSREDにおけるGLP-1作動薬の潜在的な役割を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: 単一患者における複数の原発性睡眠障害の併存は稀であり、診断・治療上の重大な課題を呈する。GLP-1受容体作動薬とSRED解決の関連は、睡眠関連摂食行動における代謝・インクレチン関連経路のさらなる研究を正当化する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 縦断的症例報告
items.endpoints_ja: 睡眠時呼吸障害（PAP治療による）、日中眠気（ピトリサン・ソリアムフェトールによる）、パラソムニアの頻度と重症度（メラトニン＋クロナゼパムによる）、SRED（GLP-1受容体作動薬による）、体重

items.title: Assessing the Growing Impact of Oral GLP-1 Agonists on National Obesity Policies of the United Kingdom.
items.abstract: Obesity is a widely recognised major health concern within the United Kingdom (UK), culminating in rising costs for the National Health Service (NHS) per annum. Considering recent approval from regulatory bodies for the administration of oral glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists for weight management, this editorial explores the potential impact of oral GLP-1 receptor agonists on UK obesity policies, as well as establishing their safety profile and purported long-term health outcomes. It outlines key challenges faced by the NHS and the UK Government, such as growing inequalities in current access to the medication and the assurance of fair state provision, targeting the highest-risk patient groups first. Whilst national policy in tackling obesity is an ever-evolving landscape, it is imperative that oral GLP-1 receptor agonists are recognised by the wider populace not as substitutes for established methods but as tools to augment their efficacy.
items.authors: Mathew Alan, Anwar Hannah
items.summary_ja: 英国の肥満対策政策に対する経口GLP-1受容体作動薬の潜在的な影響を考察したエディトリアル。経口GLP-1受容体作動薬の安全性プロファイルと長期的な健康転帰、NHSおよび英国政府が直面する課題（薬物へのアクセスの不平等、公平な公的提供の確保、最高リスク患者群への優先的提供）を概説している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口GLP-1受容体作動薬は確立された方法の代替ではなく、その効果を補強するツールとして広く認識されるべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: 英国では肥満が重大な健康課題として認識されており、NHSの年間コストが上昇している。経口GLP-1受容体作動薬の体重管理への規制当局による承認が、国家肥満政策にどのような影響を与えるかが政策決定者にとって重要である。
items.study_type_ja: エディトリアル
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors in Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome: Drugs Unifying Heart, Kidney, and Metabolism Pharmacotherapy.
items.abstract: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome describes a complex interplay between cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and metabolic disorders. Recent randomized controlled trials have demonstrated beneficial effects of SGLT2 inhibitors in patients with this multifaceted condition. This review aims to critically evaluate the available evidence supporting the role of SGLT2 inhibitors in patients with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome and familiarize healthcare providers with the evidence surrounding significant renal and cardiac benefits of SGLT2 inhibitors. A comprehensive narrative literature review was conducted using PubMed. Eligible studies included randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, and meta-analyses published in English between 2018 and 2025, focusing on SGLT2 inhibitors in the context of cardio-renal syndrome and cardio-kidney-metabolic syndrome. Multiple landmark trials have shown that SGLT2 inhibitors significantly reduce the risk of chronic kidney disease progression, MACE, and hospitalization for HF. These benefits were seen in patients both with and without type 2 diabetes. Importantly, SGLT2 inhibitors such as canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, and sotagliflozin were well tolerated, though caution is advised in volume-depleted patients or those at risk for genitourinary infections. Positive effects, ranging from glycemic control to renoprotective and cardioprotective properties, support SGLT2 inhibitors as first-line therapy in improving clinical outcomes and quality of life in patients affected by this interconnected disease spectrum.
items.journal: American journal of cardiovascular drugs : drugs, devices, and other interventions
items.authors: Okhovat Valentina, Lybeshari Kamela, Cubeddu Luigi X, Hale Genevieve
items.summary_ja: 心血管・腎・代謝症候群（CKM症候群）におけるSGLT2阻害薬の役割を批判的に評価する包括的ナラティブ文献レビュー。PubMedを用い、2018年から2025年間に英語で出版された無作為化比較試験、システマティックレビュー、メタアナリシスを対象に、CKM症候群におけるSGLT2阻害薬の腎保護・心保護効果の証拠を整理した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬（カナグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン、エンパグリフロジン、ソタグリフロジン）は、2型糖尿病の有無を問わず、CKD進行、MACE、心不全による入院のリスクを有意に低減し、良好な忍容性を示した。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は血糖管理から腎保護・心保護に至る幅広い効果を持ち、CKM症候群という相互に関連する疾患スペクトルを持つ患者の臨床アウトカムと生活の質の改善において第一選択療法として位置づけられる根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブ文献レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 慢性腎臓病（CKD）の進行、主要心血管事象（MACE）、心不全による入院、血糖管理、腎保護効果、心保護効果

items.title: Cagrilintide and retatrutide combination therapy enhances weight loss and metabolic outcomes in obese male rats.
items.abstract: Peptide multi-receptor agonists have advanced obesity treatment, yet challenges remain in achieving maximal weight loss and metabolic control, especially in patients with obesity and type 2 diabetes. Here we demonstrate enhanced metabolic benefits of a combination therapy with retatrutide, a unimolecular GLP-1R/GIPR/GCGR tri-agonist, and cagrilintide, an AMLNR/CALCR co-agonist, in diet-induced obese male rats. Daily co-administration produces dose-dependent reductions in body weight and food intake that exceed both equimolar monotherapies and matched-dose comparator combinations incorporating semaglutide or tirzepatide. The combination therapy also improves circulating markers of metabolic health, including cholesterol, triglycerides and insulin levels. Pair-feeding and weight-matching studies reveal that the enhanced weight loss cannot be explained by reduced food intake alone and enable discrimination between weight-loss-dependent and drug-specific molecular responses. Plasma proteomic profiling highlights enrichment of bioenergetic processes with the combination therapy, whereas brain transcriptomic profiling identifies convergent central neuronal programmes linked to energy balance regulation. Collectively, our preclinical findings support five-receptor polypharmacology as a strategy for efficaciously lowering body weight and provide guidance for the design of next-generation unimolecular multi-receptor agonists.
items.authors: Petersen Jonas, Merrild Christoffer, Holm Stephanie Kjærulff, Kurgan Nigel, Hassan Shad, Mathiesen Cecilie Vad, Börchers Stina, Svendsen Charlotte
items.summary_ja: 食事誘発性肥満雄性ラットにおいて、retatrutide（GLP-1R/GIPR/GCGRトリアゴニスト）とcagrilintide（AMLNR/CALCRコアゴニスト）の併用療法が、単独療法およびsemaglutideやtirzepatideを含む比較併用療法を上回る体重減少と代謝改善をもたらすことを示した前臨床研究。
items.key_takeaway_ja: cagrilintideとretatrutideの併用は、等モル単独療法およびmatched-doseの比較併用療法（semaglutide、tirzepatideを含む）を上回る用量依存性の体重減少と食事摂取量の減少を産生し、5受容体ポリファーマコロジーが体重低下の有効な戦略であることを支持する。
items.why_matters_ja: 5受容体ポリファーマコロジーが体重を効果的に低下させる戦略であることを前臨床データで支持し、次世代の単分子マルチレセプターアゴニストの設計に指針を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（食事誘発性肥満雄性ラット）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、食事摂取量、循環代謝マーカー（コレステロール、トリグリセリド、インスリン）、血漿プロテオミクスプロファイリング、脳トランスクリプトミクスプロファイリング
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載なし。用量依存性の体重減少と食事摂取量の減少が等モル単独療法およびmatched-doseの比較併用療法（semaglutide、tirzepatideを含む）を上回ったこと、コレステロール・トリグリセリド・インスリンレベルが改善したことが記載されている。

items.title: A multicenter real-world study on the safety and effectiveness of the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (liraglutide) in adolescents with obesity in Taiwan.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Pediatric obesity is linked to many metabolic complications and has limited treatment options. We evaluated the safety and effectiveness of GLP-1 receptor agonist (liraglutide) in adolescents with obesity in clinical practice in Taiwan.
METHODS: We conducted a prospective study (NCT06283641) across 14 hospitals and clinics from February 2024 to March 2025 evaluating adolescents receiving liraglutide at baseline, week 13, and week 26. Demographics, and safety and effectiveness outcomes, including incidence proportions of adverse events and adverse drug reactions, and changes in body weight and body mass index, were assessed.
RESULTS: Among 41 participants, 22 (53.7%) were male, with mean age (±standard deviation) 13.9 ± 1.8 years, body weight (BW) 88.5 ± 19.3 kg, and body mass index (BMI) 33.4 ± 5.1 kg/m2. Nineteen (46.3%) had medical history of hepatic impairment. Mean daily and maximum doses were 1.4 ± 0.5 mg/day and 1.8 ± 0.7 mg/day, respectively, throughout 128.3 ± 56.0 days; 14.4% escalated to 3.0 mg/day. Overall respective incidence proportions of adverse events and adverse drug reactions were 19.5% (8/41; all mild) and 9.8% (4/41; 6 events), respectively. Gastrointestinal events were most frequent, followed by injection site-related events. No treatment discontinuation resulted from intolerance. Mean respective losses in BW, BMI, and BMI standard deviation score at weeks 13 and 26 were -2.7 ± 3.8 kg (p = 0.0003), -1.3 ± 1.4 kg/m2 (p < 0.0001), and -0.2 ± 0.2 (p < 0.0001); and -4.4 ± 5.7 kg (p = 0.0015), -1.9 ± 2.1 kg/m2 (p = 0.0004), and -0.4 ± 0.3 (p < 0.0001), respectively.
CONCLUSION: In adolescents with obesity in Taiwan, liraglutide at doses below 3.0 mg/day was well-tolerated, and reductions in BW, BMI, and BMI standard deviation score were observed.
items.authors: Chiu Chiao-Fan, Chou Chu-Kuang, Hu Shu-Wei, Huang Kuo-Chin, Wu Yi-Lei, Wu Hsiang-Fan, Liu Yang-Lin, Yang Yu-Chen
items.summary_ja: 台湾の14病院・クリニックで実施された前向き多施設リアルワールド研究（NCT06283641、2024年2月〜2025年3月）。肥満を有する思春期患者41例を対象に、リラグルチドの安全性と有効性をベースライン、13週、26週で評価した。主要評価項目は有害事象・有害薬物反応の発生割合、体重・BMI・BMI SDSの変化であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 台湾の肥満思春期患者において、3.0 mg/day未満のリラグルチドは良好な忍容性を示し、体重・BMI・BMI SDSの有意な減少が確認された。有害事象はすべて軽度であり、不耐容による治療中断はなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 小児肥満は多くの代謝合併症と関連するが、治療選択肢は限られている。本研究は、思春期肥満患者におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬（リラグルチド）のリアルワールドでの安全性・有効性に関する前向き多施設データを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前向き多施設リアルワールド研究（観察研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 有害事象の発生割合、有害薬物反応の発生割合、体重の変化、BMIの変化、BMI SDSの変化

items.title: Sequential liraglutide and setmelanotide therapy in Bardet-Biedl Syndrome: metabolic and renal outcomes in a real-world case report and literature review.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS) is a syndromic ciliopathy characterized by multiple clinical features, including obesity and kidney disease. Therapeutic options remain limited. Setmelanotide, a melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) agonist, is approved for obesity in BBS, but real-world data in adults is scarce. This case highlights the synergistic metabolic and nephroprotective effects of a sequential therapeutic strategy combining a glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist and a MC4R agonist.
CASE PRESENTATION: We report the case of a 37-year-old male with genetically confirmed BBS due to compound heterozygous likely pathogenic BBS10 variants presenting with obesity, insulin resistance, dyslipidemia, albuminuria and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Treatment with liraglutide induced modest weight loss (-3.4%, BMI 35.2→34 kg/m²), improved urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR) and liver enzymes levels within 8 months. Following discontinuation of liraglutide, setmelanotide therapy was subsequently initiated. After 12 months of treatment, the patient achieved a 10.5% weight loss compared with baseline (BMI 35.2→31.5 kg/m²), normalization of liver transaminases, reduced liver stiffness, and sustained improvement in uACR, while eGFR remained stable. Fasting insulin and HOMA-IR improved. Metformin, statin, and fenofibrate were discontinued, though fenofibrate was later reintroduced for hypertriglyceridemia. Two interventional studies (n≃10-40, 3-52 weeks) similarly reported consistent reduction in metabolic syndrome burden (METs-Z-BMI-score), liver steatosis, stiffness, and enzymes, while renal biomarkers showed stabilization or improvement, supporting potential hepatoprotective and reno-protective effects.
CONCLUSION: Setmelanotide promoted clinically meaningful weight loss and improved liver, kidney, and metabolic parameters in an adult patient carrying BBS10-likely pathogenic variants. Together with emerging evidence for interventional studies, these findings suggest that MC4R agonism may confer organ-level and cardiometabolic benefits beyond weight reduction.
items.authors: Pasquariello Tommaso, Secondulfo Floriana, Roscini Anna Rita, Nardi Elisabetta, Prosperi Enrico, Capasso Giovambattista, Perna Alessandra F, Zacchia Miriam
items.summary_ja: Bardet-Biedl症候群（BBS）は肥満と腎疾患を含む複数の臨床特徴を有する症候性シリアーパチーであり、治療選択肢は限られている。本症例報告では、BBS10複合ヘテロ接合おそらく病的変異により遺伝学的に確認された37歳男性BBS患者に対し、GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（リラグルチド）とMC4Rアゴニスト（セットメラノチド）のsequential therapyを実施した。リラグルチド投与により8ヶ月で体重-3.4%（BMI 35.2→34 kg/m²）、uACRおよび肝酵素の改善が認められた。その後リラグルチドを中止しセットメラノチドを開始し、12ヶ月でベースライン比10.5%の減量（BMI 35.2→31.5 kg/m²）、肝トランスアミナーゼの正常化、肝硬度の低下、uACRの持続的改善、eGFRの安定、空腹時インスリンおよびHOMA-IRの改善が得られた。メトホルミン、スタチン、フェノフィブレートは中止された（フェノフィブレートは高トリグリセリド血症のため後日再開）。また、2つの介入研究（n≒10-40、3-52週間）でも代謝症候群負荷（METs-Z-BMI-score）、肝脂肪変性、硬度、酵素の減少および腎バイオマーカーの安定または改善が報告され、肝保護・腎保護効果の可能性を支持した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: BBS成人患者において、GLP-1受容体アゴニストにMC4Rアゴニスト（セットメラノチド）をsequentialに投与することで、体重減少のみならず肝・腎・代謝パラメータの臨床的に有意な改善が得られた。MC4R作動は減量を超えた臓器レベルおよび心代謝的恩恵をもたらす可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: BBS成人におけるセットメラノチドの実臨床データは乏しく、本症例はsequential therapyによる代謝・腎保護効果のシナジーを示す貴重な実世界エビデンスを提供する。MC4R作動が体重減少を超えた臓器保護効果を持つ可能性は、BBS患者の臓器合併症管理に新たな治療戦略を示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告（real-world case report）および文献レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少率（%）、BMI、尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比（uACR）、肝酵素（トランスアミナーゼ）、肝硬度、eGFR、空腹時インスリン、HOMA-IR、METs-Z-BMI-score、肝脂肪変性
items.endpoint_results_ja: リラグルチド投与8ヶ月：体重-3.4%、BMI 35.2→34 kg/m²、uACR改善、肝酵素改善。セットメラノチド投与12ヶ月：ベースライン比10.5%減量、BMI 35.2→31.5 kg/m²、肝トランスアミナーゼ正常化、肝硬度低下、uACR持続的改善、eGFR安定、空腹時インスリンおよびHOMA-IR改善。介入研究（n≒10-40、3-52週間）：METs-Z-BMI-score、肝脂肪変性、硬度、酵素の減少、腎バイオマーカーの安定または改善。

items.title: Celastrol alleviates SGLT2 inhibitor-induced diabetic hyperketonemia by inhibiting hepatic ketogenesis.
items.abstract: SGLT2 inhibitor (SGLT2i)-induced diabetic hyperketonemia is a life-threatening acute complication of diabetes. While celastrol has been reported to have beneficial effects on obesity, its potential role in ketogenesis remains unclear. In this study, celastrol administration significantly attenuates the fasting-induced increase in blood β-hydroxybutyrate levels. Moreover, a 7-day course of celastrol (1 mg/kg/day) leads to reductions in body weight and fat mass. Mechanistically, celastrol specifically downregulates HMGCS2 expression and suppresses hepatic ketogenesis through the inhibition of PPARα expression in the short term (≤ 2 days). However, after prolonged treatment for 7 days, celastrol modulates both PPARα and serum free fatty acid (FFA) levels. Furthermore, the anti-ketogenic effect of celastrol is abolished in Pparα -/- mice. Importantly, celastrol effectively ameliorates SGLT2i-induced hyperketonemia. In summary, celastrol curbs hepatic ketone overproduction in a PPARα-dependent manner, indicating its protective potential against SGLT2i-induced hyperketonemia.
items.authors: Zhu Yinghan, Wang Yiting, Zhang Minglong, Liu Lingxu, Tian Yang, Guo Zeyu, Zhang Ran, Zhang Jinrui
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）誘発の糖尿病性高ケトンは生命を脅かす急性合併症である。本研究では、セレスタロール投与が空腹誘発による血中β-ヒドロキシブチレートレベルの上昇を有意に軽減し、7日間のセレスタロール投与（1 mg/kg/day）で体重および脂肪量減少が認められた。機能的には、セレスタロールは短期的（≤2日）にPPARα発現の抑制を介してHMGCS2発現を特異的に下調し肝ケトネーゼを抑制した。7日間の長期投与ではPPARαおよび血清遊離脂肪酸（FFA）レベルの両方を調節した。Pparα-/-マウスでは抗ケトネーゼ効果が消失した。セレスタロールはSGLT2i誘発の高ケトン血症を効果的に改善した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セレスタロールはPPARα依存性で肝ケトン過剰産生を抑制し、SGLT2i誘発の高ケトン血症に対する保護的潜在力を持つ。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2i誘発の糖尿病性高ケトンは生命を脅かす急性合併症であり、その予防・治療に有効な薬剤の探索は臨床的に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床（動物実験）研究
items.endpoints_ja: 血中β-ヒドロキシブチレートレベル、体重、脂肪量、HMGCS2発現、PPARα発現、血清遊離脂肪酸（FFA）レベル、SGLT2i誘発高ケトン血症
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値結果（p値、平均値、変化率など）の記載なし。定性的な記述のみ（有意に軽減、減少、下調、抑制、消失、改善）。

items.title: Study Protocol for the TIGHTEN Study Comparing the Effects of Tofogliflozin and Glimepiride on Skeletal Muscle Mass in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes without Obesity: A Prospective, Multicenter, Open-Label, Randomized, Parallel Group Trial in Japan.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Although sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are associated with a lower risk of hypoglycemia, they may result in weight reduction, and provide additional benefits for cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, and heart failure. However, their use in Japanese individuals with type 2 diabetes (T2D)-many of whom are older and without obesity-raises concerns regarding sarcopenia. This study aims to investigate the impact of the SGLT2 inhibitor tofogliflozin, compared with sulfonylurea glimepiride, on skeletal muscle mass in patients with T2D without obesity.
METHODS: This study is a prospective, multicenter, open-label, randomized, parallel group, comparative trial. Adult Japanese patients with T2D with a body mass index of < 25 kg/m2 and a glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) level of 7.0 to < 10.0% will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive tofogliflozin (20 mg orally/day) or glimepiride (0.5-4 mg orally/day) for 24 weeks. The primary endpoint is the change in total skeletal muscle mass to total body weight ratio from baseline to 24 weeks. The key secondary endpoints include the percentage change in total skeletal muscle mass to total body weight ratio and the change or percentage change in skeletal muscle mass index from baseline to 24 weeks. In total, 56 participants were calculated to be required, considering a dropout rate 15%, a two-sided alpha of 0.05, and a power of 0.9.
PLANNED OUTCOMES: Participant recruitment commenced in April 2024 and concluded in June 2025. The complete findings of this study are anticipated to be published in 2027. We expect that the results will elucidate the impact of SGLT2 inhibitors on skeletal muscle mass in individuals with T2D without obesity, thereby addressing concerns related to sarcopenia.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Japan Registry of Clinical Trials (jRCT) (No. jRCTs041240011); registered 10 April 2024, https://jrct.mhlw.go.jp/en-latest-detail/jRCTs041240011 .

items.authors: Takeda Yasutaka, Ozawa Tsubasa, Ikoma Maki, Shimada Keiji, Saito Reina, Nakagawa Atsushi, Sawamura Toshitaka, Kumashiro Naoki
items.summary_ja: 日本における非肥満（BMI < 25 kg/m²）の2型糖尿病患者において、SGLT2阻害薬トフォグリフロジンとスルホニルウレア薬グリメピリドの骨格筋量への影響を比較する前向き・多施設・オープンラベル・ランダム化・並行群比較試験のプロトコル。HbA1c 7.0〜<10.0%の成人日本人患者を1:1で割り付け、24週間投与する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文は試験プロトコルであり、結果は報告されていない。非肥満の日本人2型糖尿病患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬の骨格筋量への影響をグリメピリドと比較して評価することを目的としている。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は体重減少を伴う可能性があり、高齢で非肥満の日本人2型糖尿病患者ではサルコペニアの懸念がある。本試験は、SGLT2阻害薬が非肥満の2型糖尿病患者の骨格筋量にどのような影響を与えるかを明らかにし、サルコペニアに関する懸念に答えることを目的としている。
items.study_type_ja: 前向き・多施設・オープンラベル・ランダム化・並行群比較試験（プロトコル）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：ベースラインから24週までの総骨格筋量/総体重比の変化。主要セカンダリエンドポイント：総骨格筋量/総体重比の変化率、骨格筋量指数の変化または変化率（ベースラインから24週）。
items.sample_size_ja: 脱落率15%、両側α 0.05、検出力0.9を考慮し、合計56名が算出された。

items.title: Longitudinal Changes in Corneal Epithelial and Central Corneal Thickness in Type 2 Diabetes Assessed by AS-OCT: A Real-World Study.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: To evaluate longitudinal changes in central corneal epithelial thickness (CCET) and central corneal thickness (CCT) using anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) over 12 months in adults with type 2 diabetes receiving one of two routinely prescribed oral antidiabetic regimens, and to explore their association with glycemic changes.
METHODS: In this retrospective observational cohort study, 40 adults with type 2 diabetes receiving one of two routinely prescribed treatment regimens (vildagliptin-metformin, n=19; empagliflozin-metformin, n=21) underwent AS-OCT at baseline, 3 months, and 12 months. Glycated hemoglobin and fasting plasma glucose were assessed at each visit. Precision analysis indicated detectable between-group differences of 4.7 µm for CCT and 6.1 µm for CCET.
RESULTS: Both groups showed significant within-group glycated hemoglobin improvement (mean reduction: -2.28% and -2.88% in the vildagliptin-metformin and empagliflozin-metformin groups, respectively; p<0.05) without between-group differences. CCT and CCET showed no statistically detectable longitudinal change over 12 months, with no significant differences in longitudinal change between groups. Glycated hemoglobin change showed a modest independent association with CCT change (β = 0.81 µm per 1% glycated hemoglobin; 95% CI 0.20-1.42; p=0.011; n=32).
CONCLUSIONS: Corneal structural parameters showed no statistically detectable longitudinal change or between-group difference over 12 months. Given the modest sample size and observational design, these findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and require confirmation in larger prospective studies.
items.authors: Boyacı İhsan, Demirci Göktuğ
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病成人40名（ビルダグリプチン-メトホルミン群 n=19、エンパグリフロジン-メトホルミン群 n=21）を対象に、AS-OCTを用いてベースライン、3か月、12か月時の中央角膜上皮厚（CCET）と中央角膜厚（CCT）の縦断的変化を評価した後ろ向き観察コホート研究。血糖変化との関連も検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 12か月間のCCETおよびCCTには統計的に検出可能な縦断的変化は認められず、群間差も有意ではなかった。HbA1c変化とCCT変化の間には modest な独立した関連が認められた（β = 0.81 µm per 1% HbA1c; 95% CI 0.20-1.42; p=0.011; n=32）。
items.why_matters_ja: 糖尿病における角膜構造パラメータの経時的変化をAS-OCTで評価する初期のエビデンスを提供するが、サンプルサイズが小さく観察研究デザインであるため、仮説生成段階の知見であり、より大規模な前向き研究での確認が必要である。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き観察コホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 中央角膜上皮厚（CCET）および中央角膜厚（CCT）の12か月間の縦断的変化、血糖変化（HbA1c、空腹時血糖）との関連
items.endpoint_results_ja: HbA1c平均減少：ビルダグリプチン-メトホルミン群 -2.28%、エンパグリフロジン-メトホルミン群 -2.88%（p<0.05）、群間差なし。CCTおよびCCET：12か月間で統計的に検出可能な縦断的変化なし、群間の縦断的変化に有意差なし。HbA1c変化とCCT変化の関連：β = 0.81 µm per 1% HbA1c; 95% CI 0.20-1.42; p=0.011; n=32。精度解析：群間差の検出可能閾値はCCT 4.7 µm、CCET 6.1 µm。
items.sample_size_ja: 40名（ビルダグリプチン-メトホルミン群 n=19、エンパグリフロジン-メトホルミン群 n=21）

items.title: Real-World Evidence for Existing Anti-Obesity Therapies-The Realities of Treatment Adherence, Tolerability, Access and Patient Satisfaction.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity is associated with substantial cardiometabolic and psychosocial morbidity. Although randomized controlled trials demonstrate the efficacy of anti-obesity therapies, outcomes in real-world practice may be attenuated due to limited access, tolerability, adherence and insufficient long-term support.
PURPOSE: This narrative review aimed to synthesize real-world evidence on adherence, tolerability, access and patient satisfaction across lifestyle programmes, pharmacotherapy, metabolic bariatric surgery (MBS) and endoscopic procedures, with emphasis on incretin-based medications.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE search was conducted through July 2026. Studies reporting real-world treatment effectiveness, adherence, persistence, discontinuation, tolerability, access or patient satisfaction in adults or adolescents with overweight or obesity were included. Randomized trials and reviews were used to contextualize real-world findings.
FINDINGS: Intensive lifestyle interventions generally achieve approximately 5% weight loss, but attrition and weight regain after programme completion are common. Incretin-based therapies, including semaglutide and tirzepatide, produce substantial weight loss in trials but real-world effectiveness is relatively smaller because of non-initiation, incomplete dose escalation, gastrointestinal adverse effects, treatment interruptions, and financial or insurance barriers. Older medications demonstrate poor persistence, largely related to neurologic, psychiatric or gastrointestinal intolerance, despite lower costs for some agents. MBS provides the greatest and most durable weight loss but remains substantially underused, with racial, socioeconomic and insurance disparities. Endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty offers moderate, durable weight loss with low serious adverse event rates, whereas intragastric balloons are more limited by intolerance, reintervention and weight regain after removal.
CONCLUSIONS: Real-world effectiveness is determined not only by biological efficacy but also by treatment tolerability, adherence, access and sustained support. Proactive adverse effect management, individualized behavioural support, streamlined referral pathways and policies that improve affordability and equitable access are essential to narrowing the trial-to-practice gap.
items.authors: Kassem Sameer
items.summary_ja: 肥満症に対する既存の抗肥満療法（生活習慣プログラム、薬物療法、代謝・肥満外科手術、内視鏡的手術）におけるアドヒアランス、忍容性、アクセス、患者満足度に関するリアルワールドエビデンスを統合したナラティブレビュー。インクレチン系薬剤に重点を置いている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: リアルワールドにおける抗肥満療法の有効性は、生物学的有効性だけでなく、治療の忍容性、アドヒアランス、アクセス、持続的なサポートによって決定される。
items.why_matters_ja: ランダム化比較試験で示された有効性とリアルワールドでの実効性との間にギャップが存在し、その原因としてアクセス制限、忍容性問題、アドヒアランス不良、長期サポートの不足が指摘されている。このギャップを縮小するための戦略（副作用の能動的な管理、個別化された行動支援、紹介経路の簡素化、費用対効果と公平なアクセスを改善する政策）が提言されている。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少、アドヒアランス、継続率（persistence）、中止率（discontinuation）、忍容性、アクセス、患者満足度
items.endpoint_results_ja: 集学的な生活習慣介入は概ね約5%の体重減少を達成するが、プログラム終了後の脱落と体重再増加が頻繁にみられる。

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist-Based Prandial Insulin De-Intensification in Outpatients With Type 2 Diabetes Receiving Basal-Bolus Insulin Therapy or Multiple Daily Injections: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.abstract:
AIMS: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to compare GLP-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA)-based prandial insulin de-intensification with continued basal-bolus insulin therapy (BBI) or multiple daily injections (MDI) in adult outpatients with type 2 diabetes receiving established BBI/MDI at randomisation.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) and Web of Science were searched for randomised controlled trials enrolling adult outpatients with type 2 diabetes receiving established BBI/MDI at randomisation. Eligible trials compared a GLP-1RA-based strategy involving protocol-directed withdrawal, replacement or substantial reduction of scheduled prandial insulin while maintaining basal insulin versus continued BBI/MDI therapy. The primary outcome was change in HbA1c. Secondary outcomes included changes in body weight, total daily insulin dose (TDD), hypoglycaemia and de-intensification-related outcomes.
RESULTS: Seven randomised controlled trials involving 1332 participants were included. Compared with continued BBI/MDI therapy, GLP-1RA-based prandial insulin de-intensification was not associated with a significant difference in HbA1c change (mean difference [MD] -0.08 percentage points, 95% confidence interval [CI] -0.28 to 0.12; p = 0.391). The de-intensification strategy was associated with reductions in body weight (MD -4.94 kg, 95% CI -7.37 to -2.51; p = 0.003) and total daily insulin dose (MD -33.32 U/day, 95% CI -52.23 to -14.41; p = 0.006). The risk of experiencing at least one hypoglycaemic event was lower with GLP-1RA-based de-intensification (risk ratio [RR] 0.76, 95% CI 0.66 to 0.87; p = 0.007).
CONCLUSIONS: In adults with type 2 diabetes receiving established BBI/MDI therapy, GLP-1RA-based prandial insulin de-intensification was associated with maintenance of short-term glycaemic control while reducing body weight and total daily insulin requirements. A potential reduction in hypoglycaemia remains uncertain. This strategy may represent an option for treatment optimisation in appropriately selected patients receiving intensive insulin therapy; however, further studies are needed to determine its long-term sustainability and optimal implementation.
items.authors: Yang Hongxia, Ren Tianli, Zhou Jin, Liu Hao, Yin Fen, Liu Zhengtang
items.summary_ja: 本システマティックレビュー・メタアナリシスは、確立されたベースール・ボラスインスリン療法（BBI）または1日複数回注射（MDI）を受けている2型糖尿病の外来成人患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）に基づく食前インスリンの減量（de-intensification）と継続BBI/MDI療法を比較した。7件のランダム化比較試験（RCT）、1332名が対象となった。GLP-1RAに基づく食前インスリン減量は、HbA1c変化に有意差を示さなかったが、体重減少（MD -4.94 kg）、総日量インスリン用量の減少（MD -33.32 U/day）、低血糖イベントリスクの低下（RR 0.76）と関連した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 確立されたBBI/MDI療法を受けている2型糖尿病成人患者において、GLP-1RAに基づく食前インスリン減量は短期間の血糖管理を維持しつつ、体重と総日量インスリン用量を減少させ、低血糖リスクの低下も示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 集学的インスリン療法を受けている患者の治療最適化の選択肢として、インスリン負荷と低血糖リスクを軽減しつつ血糖管理を維持する戦略の根拠を提供する。ただし、長期持続性及び最適な実施方法についてはさらなる研究が必要とされている。
items.study_type_ja: システマティックレビュー・メタアナリシス（ランダム化比較試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：HbA1cの変化。副次エンドポイント：体重の変化、総日量インスリン用量（TDD）の変化、低血糖、減量関連アウトカム。
items.endpoint_results_ja: HbA1c変化：MD -0.08 percentage points, 95% CI -0.28 to 0.12; p = 0.391。体重：MD -4.94 kg, 95% CI -7.37 to -2.51; p = 0.003。総日量インスリン用量：MD -33.32 U/day, 95% CI -52.23 to -14.41; p = 0.006。低血糖イベント（少なくとも1回）：RR 0.76, 95% CI 0.66 to 0.87; p = 0.007。

items.title: Psychiatric Safety of GLP-1 and Dual GIP/GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Adolescents With Obesity.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists are increasingly used for adolescent obesity, but concerns persist regarding psychiatric adverse events, particularly suicidality.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used deidentified electronic health records from the TriNetX Global Collaborative Network. Adolescents with overweight or obesity were included. New users of semaglutide, liraglutide, or tirzepatide were compared with those receiving lifestyle interventions. Cohorts were balanced using propensity score matching. The primary outcome was suicide-related events (suicidal ideation or suicide attempt). Secondary outcomes included suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, anxiety, insomnia, depression, and eating disorders, assessed from 30 days to 1095 days after the index date.
RESULTS: After propensity score matching, 9222 adolescents were included in each group. Incretin-based therapy was associated with lower risks of suicide-related events (HR, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.57-0.95), suicidal ideation (HR, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.56-0.96), and anxiety (HR, 0.92; 95% CI, 0.84-0.99) compared with lifestyle intervention. No significant differences were observed for suicide attempt, insomnia, depression, or eating disorders. Risk reductions were significant among female adolescents (HR, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.46-0.82) and those without Type 2 diabetes (HR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.47-0.85), but not among males or those with Type 2 diabetes. Sensitivity analyses supported the primary findings.
CONCLUSIONS: Among adolescents with obesity, incretin-based therapy was not associated with increased psychiatric risk and was associated with lower risks of suicide-related events, suicidal ideation, and anxiety compared with lifestyle intervention. Although a lower risk was observed compared with lifestyle intervention, this finding should be interpreted cautiously given potential selection bias and the lack of a significant difference in the active-comparator analysis with metformin.
items.authors: Liu Ting-Hui, Shen Yang-Li, Kuo Tien-Hsiang, Wu Jheng-Yan, Lin Chien-Ho, Lai Chih-Cheng
items.summary_ja: TriNetXグローバル協働ネットワークの匿名化電子健康記録を用いた後方視コホート研究。過体重または肥満の青少年において、セマグルチド、リラグルチド、またはtirzepatideの新規使用者を生活習慣介入群と比較した。プロパティスコアマッチングにより各群9,222例を均衡化し、インデックス日から30日〜1095日までの自殺関連事象（主要評価項目）および自殺念慮、自殺未遂、不安、不眠、うつ、摂食障害（副次評価項目）を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満を有する青少年において、インクレチン系療法は精神科的リスクの増加とは関連せず、生活習慣介入と比較して自殺関連事象、自殺念慮、不安のリスクが有意に低かった。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬は青少年の肥満治療に増加して使用されているが、特に自殺性に関する精神科的有害事象への懸念が持続している。本研究は、この重要な安全性の懸念に直接答えるものである。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（電子健康記録を用いた観察研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：自殺関連事象（自殺念慮または自殺未遂）。副次評価項目：自殺念慮、自殺未遂、不安、不眠、うつ、摂食障害。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 自殺関連事象：HR 0.74（95% CI 0.57-0.95）、自殺念慮：HR 0.73（95% CI 0.56-0.96）、不安：HR 0.92（95% CI 0.84-0.99）で生活習慣介入群より有意に低リスク。自殺未遂、不眠、うつ、摂食障害には有意差なし。女性青少年ではHR 0.61（95% CI 0.46-0.82）、2型糖尿病なしではHR 0.63（95% CI 0.47-0.85）で有意なリスク低下。男性および2型糖尿病ありでは有意差なし。

items.title: Prior GLP-1RA or Tirzepatide Use and Early Cardiorenal Outcomes After Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To compare early postoperative cardiovascular and kidney outcomes after metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) according to prior glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) or tirzepatide use.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used the US Medical Records Database. Adults undergoing MBS from 2016 through 2025 were included. Prior use was defined by at least 1 GLP-1RA or tirzepatide prescription from 365 to 7 days before MBS; patients with prescriptions closer to surgery were excluded. Prior users and nonusers were propensity score matched 1:1. The primary outcome was 4-point major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), and a key secondary outcome was early postoperative kidney events, assessed from postoperative day 1 through day 90.
RESULTS: After matching, each group included 11,052 patients, with well-balanced baseline characteristics. Prior use was associated with lower risks of 4-point MACE (36 patients [0.3%] vs 67 patients [0.6%]; hazard ratio [HR], 0.535; 95% CI, 0.357-0.803) and early postoperative kidney events (158 patients [1.4%] vs 256 patients [2.3%]; HR, 0.613; 95% CI, 0.502-0.747). Prior GLP-1RA or tirzepatide use was also associated with lower risks of coronary events and heart failure.
CONCLUSIONS: Among adults undergoing MBS, prior GLP-1RA or tirzepatide use was associated with lower 90-day risks of 4-point MACE and early postoperative kidney events. These findings support further investigation of preoperative metabolic optimization strategies and their potential role in improving postoperative cardiorenal outcomes.

items.title: The Incretin Revolution: Integrating Incretin-Based Therapies into Clinical Care.
items.abstract: Incretin-based therapies have changed the landscape of modern medical practice. Obesity-related disease processes including type 2 diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, and obstructive sleep apnea improve in patients treated with these medications, and several now carry organ-specific regulatory indications. In this narrative review we summarize the mechanisms through which these medications act, appraise the evidence for each indication by study design and endpoint status, and set out a practical framework for integrating incretin therapy into care outside endocrinology, covering agent selection by dominant comorbidity, sequencing with other disease-modifying therapy, monitoring, safety and long-term management, and prescribing where access is constrained.

items.title: DUTCH weight control in atrial fibrillation study (DUTCH-WAIST) : Design and rationale of a randomised controlled trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Obesity is a well-established and highly prevalent risk factor for atrial fibrillation (AF) and its progression by promoting structural and electrical atrial remodelling, leading to AF recurrence and persistence. Weight loss is expected to reverse atrial remodelling and improve rhythm control. Optimal strategies for weight management are, however, under-explored.
OBJECTIVE: To quantify the effect of clinically meaningful weight loss on rhythm control in overweight patients with first detected persistent AF.
DESIGN: A multicentre, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial evaluating semaglutide 2.4 mg once weekly versus placebo, in addition to combined lifestyle intervention (CLI), during a one-year period.
PARTICIPANTS: Adults with a BMI > 30 kg/m2, or BMI > 27 kg/m2 with a weight-related comorbidity, and first detected (< 6 months) persistent AF scheduled for electrical cardioversion.
INTERVENTION: Weekly subcutaneous injections of semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo, alongside CLI and standard AF care in both groups.
OUTCOMES: The co-primary outcome is (i) a hierarchical assessment of rhythm status at one year, ranking patients by severity from arrhythmic death to sinus rhythm without any additional rhythm control support. (ii) the composite of either persistent atrial fibrillation on ECG, catheter ablation for AF, arrhythmic death, or any serious adverse event due to anti-arrhythmic drugs occurring within 1 year.
CONCLUSION: This study investigates whether treatment of overweight with semaglutide, as an adjunct to lifestyle intervention, enhances rhythm control in AF patients with first detected persistent AF and overweight, offering a potential new approach to reducing AF burden and cardiovascular risk in this population.

items.summary_ja: DUTCH-WAIST試験は、肥満を伴う初回検出の持続性心房細動（AF）患者において、週1回セマグルチド2.4 mg皮下注射を併用生活習慣介入（CLI）および標準AF治療に追加してプラセボと比較する、多施設・二重盲検・ランダム化・プラセボ対照試験のデザインと根拠を報告する論文である。対象はBMI>30 kg/m2、またはBMI>27 kg/m2かつ体重関連合併症を有し、電気的除細動が予定されている初回検出（6ヶ月未満）の持続性AFを有する成人である。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文は完了した試験の結果ではなく、セマグルチドがCLIに追加されることで初回検出の持続性AFを伴う肥満患者のリズムコントロールを改善するかを評価するRCTのデザインと根拠を提示するものである。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は心房の構造的・電気的リモデリングを促進しAFの再発・持続を招く確立されたリスク因子であり、減量により心房リモデリングが逆転しリズムコントロールが改善すると期待されるが、最適な体重管理戦略は未十分に探索されている。セマグルチドというGLP-1受容体作動薬がAFのリズムコントロールに寄与するかどうかは、AF負荷および心血管リスク低減の新たなアプローチとして臨床的に重要である。

items.title: Effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists on body weight and cardiovascular outcomes: a review.
items.abstract: Obesity is a rapidly increasing global health challenge that is strongly linked to the cardiorenometabolic syndrome, cardiovascular morbidity, and mortality. Lifestyle interventions remain the cornerstone of treatment, but average long-term weight loss is modest and durable weight maintenance is often limited. Bariatric surgery is not suitable for all patients, and substantial weight regain occurs in a considerable proportion over time. Glucagon-like peptide‑1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs), originally developed for type 2 diabetes (T2D), have emerged as potent agents for weight reduction and cardiometabolic risk improvement. By enhancing glucose-dependent insulin secretion, suppressing appetite, improving lipid metabolism, and exerting anti-inflammatory, endothelial, and haemodynamic effects, GLP-1RAs influence multiple pathways relevant to cardiovascular disease.Across large cardiovascular-outcome trials, GLP-1RAs consistently reduce major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), all-cause mortality, and heart-failure hospitalizations in individuals with T2D. In populations with overweight or obesity without diabetes, semaglutide, as shown in the SELECT trial, has demonstrated significant cardiovascular risk reduction, partly independent of weight loss. Overall, GLP-1RAs represent a therapeutic option for cardiovascular prevention across a broad spectrum of patients at high-risk for or with established CVD. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the pleiotropic cardiovascular effects associated with GLP-1RAs and discusses their potential integration into cardiovascular care.

items.authors: van Maren Susan J F, van Doorn Eveline P M, Smits Mark M, Tack Cees J J, van Rossum Elisabeth F C, El Messaoudi Saloua
items.summary_ja: 肥満は心腎代謝症候群、心血管疾患の有病率・死亡率と強く関連する世界的な健康課題である。GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RAs）は、インスリン分泌の促進、食欲抑制、脂質代謝の改善、抗炎症・内皮・血流力学的効果を通じて心血管疾患に関連する複数の経路に影響を与える。大規模心血管アウトカム試験において、GLP-1RAsはT2D患者で主要心血管不良事象（MACE）、全死因死亡率、心不全入院を一貫して減少させる。糖尿病を伴わない過体重・肥満患者では、SELECT試験においてセマグルチドが体重減少に部分的に独立して心血管リスクの有意な減少を示した。本レビューはGLP-1RAsに伴う多面的な心血管効果の包括的な概要を提供し、心血管ケアへの統合の可能性を議論する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAsは、心血管疾患のリスクが高いまたは確立されたCVDを有する幅広い患者群における心血管予防の治療選択肢である。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は急速に増加する世界的な健康課題であり、生活習慣介入の長期体重減少は限定的で、肥満手術はすべての患者に適用可能ではない。GLP-1RAsは体重減少と心血管代謝リスク改善の両面で有望な治療選択肢として位置づけられる。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonist use and mental health outcomes in adolescents with obesity: a retrospective review.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Adolescent obesity is associated with increased rates of depression and suicidality. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are increasingly used to treat pediatric obesity, yet concerns remain regarding potential psychiatric effects. This study evaluated changes in depressive symptoms and suicidality screening scores among adolescents with obesity treated with GLP-1RAs in a pediatric endocrinology setting. We evaluated changes in depressive symptoms and suicidality following initiation of GLP-1RA therapy in adolescents with obesity.
METHODS: We performed a retrospective chart review of adolescents aged 12-21 years with obesity treated with liraglutide or semaglutide at a single academic center between June 2022 and December 2024. Demographic, clinical, and psychosocial data were extracted from the electronic health record at baseline and follow-up. Depressive symptoms or suicidality were screened at clinic visits per protocol using either the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) or the Ask Suicide-Screening Questions (ASQ), respectively. Analyses were restricted to patients with paired baseline and follow-up assessments using the same instrument. Paired nonparametric tests were used for longitudinal comparisons.
RESULTS: Forty-four adolescents met inclusion criteria. Among patients with paired PHQ-9 data (n=15), the median PHQ-9 score decreased significantly from 6 (IQR 2-14) at baseline to 1 (IQR 0-5) at follow-up (p=0.003), independent of changes in BMI. Among patients with paired ASQ data (n=23), no increase in suicidality or new suicidal ideation was observed.
CONCLUSIONS: In this small, exploratory retrospective review, no evidence of short-term psychological harm or increased suicidality was observed among adolescents receiving GLP-1RA therapy. These findings support the short-term psychosocial safety of GLP-1RA therapy in adolescents with obesity. Larger prospective case-control studies are needed to better characterize psychiatric safety and psychosocial outcomes.

items.why_matters_ja: 思春期肥満はうつ病や自殺リスクの増加と関連しており、GLP-1RAの小児・思春期への使用が拡大する中、精神科的な安全性に関する懸念が存在する。本研究は、GLP-1RA治療の短期的な心理社会的安全性を支持する初期のエビデンスを提供する。

items.title: Effect of dapagliflozin on electrocardiographic arrhythmic markers in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Arrhythmic risk is elevated in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) partly because of abnormal ventricular repolarization. Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT-2) inhibitors may favourably modify electrophysiological properties beyond their glycaemic effects. We aimed to evaluate the association between dapagliflozin initiation and changes in ECG-derived arrhythmic markers in SGLT-2 inhibitor-naive patients with T2DM.
METHODS: In this prospective, non-randomized, controlled observational study, 700 T2DM patients (350 dapagliflozin, 350 control) were enrolled between June 2023 and February 2026 at a single tertiary-care center. Dapagliflozin was initiated as part of routine clinical care; controls continued existing antidiabetic therapy. Twelve-lead ECGs and echocardiograms were obtained at baseline and after 3 months. Primary outcomes were changes in QT interval, QTc, QT dispersion, Tp-e interval, Tp-e/QT ratio and Tp-e/QTc ratio. All 700 enrolled patients completed 3-month follow-up.
RESULTS: At 3 months, the dapagliflozin group showed significant reductions in QT (-8.8 ms), QTc (-10.1 ms), QTd (-5.1 ms), Tp-e (-6.2 ms), Tp-e/QT (-0.012) and Tp-e/QTc (-0.010) (all p < .001), whereas no clinically meaningful changes occurred in controls. Between-group delta comparisons confirmed significantly greater reductions with dapagliflozin (all p < .001; Cohen's d: 0.48-1.08). Reduction in Tp-e correlated weakly with HbA1c improvement (r = -0.145, p = .037, r2 ≈ 2%); the Tp-e/QT vs. HbA1c correlation did not reach statistical significance (r = -0.147, p = .086). Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) improved modestly (+0.8%, p = .003), and left atrial diameter decreased (-0.6 mm, p < .001).
CONCLUSION: Three months of dapagliflozin therapy was associated with improvements in multiple ECG-based arrhythmic markers in patients T2DM.
items.authors: Traş Gülüzar, Polat Fuat, Saday Bozkurt Melike, Altıntaş İsmail
items.summary_ja: 前向き・非ランダム化・対照観察研究として、単一サードケアセンターで2023年6月から2026年2月にかけて、SGLT-2阻害薬未使用の2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者700例（ダパグリフロジン群350例、対照群350例）を対象に、ダパグリフロジンの開始が心電図由来の不整脈マーカーに与える影響を評価した。ダパグリフロジンは通常の臨床診療の一部として開始され、対照群は既存の抗糖尿病療法を継続した。ベースラインと3ヶ月後に12誘導心電図と心エコー検査を実施し、全700例が3ヶ月フォローアップを完了した。主要アウトカムはQT間隔、QTc、QT分散、Tp-e間隔、Tp-e/QT比、Tp-e/QTc比の変化であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 3ヶ月間のダパグリフロジン療法は、2型糖尿病患者においてQT間隔（-8.8 ms）、QTc（-10.1 ms）、QT分散（-5.1 ms）、Tp-e間隔（-6.2 ms）、Tp-e/QT比（-0.012）、Tp-e/QTc比（-0.010）のすべての心電図由来不整脈マーカーの有意な改善と関連した（すべてp<.001）。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病患者では心室再分極異常に起因する不整脈リスクが上昇しており、SGLT-2阻害薬は血糖管理効果を超えて電気生理学的特性を好ましく修正する可能性がある。本結果は、ダパグリフロジンが心臓電気生理学的保護効果を持つ可能性を示唆し、T2DM患者の心血管リスク管理において新たな機序を提供する。
