items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Musculoskeletal Outcomes: A Systematic Literature Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are increasingly used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, but their effects on musculoskeletal health remain completely misunderstood.
OBJECTIVE: This systematic review/meta-analysis aims to synthesise clinical data on the effects of GLP-1 RAs on key relevant bone, muscle, and joint outcomes.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) (both via Ovid® platform) and Embase were searched from inception to March 2025 to identify relevant randomised controlled trials (RCTs) or real-world evidence (RWE) studies to be included. This bibliographic search was completed manually. A random-effect model meta-analysis was performed for any outcome reported in at least 2 studies. Subgroup analyses were performed on the type of GLP-1 RAs, type of comparator used and study design. Sensitivity analyses (i.e., leave-out sensitivity analyses and analyses restricted to the most adjusted effect estimate) were performed to test the robustness of the data. The strength of evidence was assessed using GRADE. This work has been performed in adherence with PRISMA statement. (PROSPERO Record ID: CRD420251024082).
RESULTS: From 1148 potentially relevant references, 60 articles (46 RCTs, 13 RWE studies and 1 pharmacovigilance study, comprising 1,250,717 individuals) met our inclusion criteria. Different GLP-1 RAs were represented across the panel of studies, i.e., semaglutide, liraglutide, exenatide, dulaglutide, tirzepatide (dual agonist gastric inhibitory polypeptide [GIP]/GLP-1) and others. No effect on bone outcomes (i.e., bone mineral density [all sites] and fractures [all sites]) were observed when the meta-analytical models included the most adjusted effect size. Regarding muscle outcomes, a significant decrease of lean body mass/fat-free mass was consistently observed with GLP-1 RAs in the global model (k = 28, standardised mean difference [SMD] 0.52, 95% confidence interval [CI] -0.8; -0.23, I2 88%, p-value for heterogeneity <0.0001), which remained robust in all sensitivity analyses. Subgroup analyses showed that the effect was mainly driven by liraglutide and semaglutide, with a decrease in lean body mass/fat-free mass observed when GLP-1 RAs were compared with placebo. No publication bias was found. Regarding joint outcome, models revealed no significant change in The Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC) pain, physical function and stiffness.
CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis is the first to investigate the effects of GLP-1 RAs on a large panel of musculoskeletal health outcomes. While no significant effects were observed on bone- or joint-related outcomes, GLP-1 RAs were associated with reductions in lean body mass/fat-free mass, although the certainty of evidence was low and these changes appeared largely related to weight loss. Whether these changes translate into clinically meaningful impairments in muscle function or physical performance remains uncertain. Further studies in this field, including those looking at muscle function, strength or performance and using multivariate models considering confounding are needed to better reinforce the models and final findings.
items.authors: Beaudart Charlotte, Malréchauffé Yveline, van Heden Sophie, Sanchez-Rodriguez Dolores, Scheen André, Bruyère Olivier, Mobasheri Ali, Duque Gustavo
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）が骨・筋・関節の運動器系アウトカムに与える影響を評価した系統的レビューおよびメタ解析。MEDLINE、CENTRAL、Embaseを2025年3月まで検索し、60論文（46件のRCT、13件のRWE研究、1件の薬物警戒研究、対象者1,250,717名）が基準を満たした。骨アウトカム（全部位の骨密度および骨折）には有意な影響は認められなかった。筋アウトカムでは、除脂肪体重/無脂肪体重の有意な減少が認められた（k=28、SMD 0.52、95%CI -0.8～-0.23、I² 88%、p<0.0001）。関節アウトカム（WOMACの疼痛・身体機能・こわばり）には有意な変化は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAは除脂肪体重/無脂肪体重の減少と関連するが、骨や関節のアウトカムには有意な影響は認められなかった。筋量減少は主に体重減少に起因すると考えられ、それが臨床的に有意な筋機能や身体性能の障害に転化するかは不確実である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAは2型糖尿病および肥満の治療にますます使用されているが、運動器系健康への影響は完全に未解明であった。本メタ解析は、運動器系健康アウトカムの広範なパネルについてGLP-1 RAの影響を調査した最初の研究である。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビューおよびメタ解析
items.endpoints_ja: 骨アウトカム（全部位の骨密度、全部位の骨折）、筋アウトカム（除脂肪体重/無脂肪体重）、関節アウトカム（WOMAC疼痛、身体機能、こわばり）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 骨アウトカム：最も調整済みの効果量を含むメタ解析モデルでは、骨密度（全部位）および骨折（全部位）に有意な影響は認められなかった。筋アウトカム：除脂肪体重/無脂肪体重の有意な減少が認められた（k=28、SMD 0.52、95%CI -0.8～-0.23、I² 88%、異質性p値<0.0001）。サブグループ解析では、効果が主にリラグルチドとセマグルチドに起因し、プラセボとの比較で除脂肪体重/無脂肪体重の減少が認められた。関節アウトカム：WOMAC疼痛、身体機能、こわばりに有意な変化は認められなかった。
items.sample_size_ja: 1,250,717名（60論文：46件のRCT、13件のRWE研究、1件の薬物警戒研究）

items.title: Combination of genetic eNOS deficiency and high-fat diet induces reproducible cardiometabolic HFpEF.
items.abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a complex, multi-organ cardiometabolic syndrome lacking universally effective therapies. We developed and validated a robust murine model leveraging complete, constitutive genetic endothelial nitric oxide synthase deficiency (eNOS KO) coupled with metabolic stress via a high-fat diet (HFD) in both male and female cohorts. eNOS KO mice subjected to HFD (10 weeks for males; 15 weeks for females) developed a severe and highly reproducible cardiometabolic HFpEF phenotype. Despite preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, both sexes exhibited profound diastolic dysfunction, characterized by elevated E/e' ratios and left ventricular end-diastolic pressures (LVEDP), alongside severe exercise intolerance. Consistent with the systemic clinical syndrome, pathological remodeling extended to multi-organ damage, featuring prominent cardiac fibrosis, severe hepatic steatosis, and renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis. Finally, chronic administration of the dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide largely reversed the hemodynamic, functional, and systemic fibrotic derangements. In conclusion, this novel eNOS KO mouse + HFD model provides a rapidly developing, highly penetrant, and chemically unconfounded platform that ensures robust HFpEF induction across both sexes. This model can be readily adopted for the investigation of mechanistic insights into HFpEF pathobiology and for the study of novel HFpEF therapeutics.
items.authors: Elbatreek Mahmoud H, Khodade Vinayak, Amin Darshan, Huerta Miguel, Allerton Timothy D, Polhemus David J, Shah Sanjiv J, Vondriska Thomas M
items.summary_ja: eNOSノックアウトマウスに高脂肪食（HFD）を投与することで、心拍出分数は保たれたまま重度の拡張機能不全（E/e'比上昇、左室終末拡張期圧上昇）、重度の運動不耐容、心筋線維化、重度の肝脂肪変性、腎尿細間質線維化を伴う再現性の高い心代謝性HFpEF表現型を誘導できるマウスモデルを開発・検証した。さらに、GIP/GLP-1受容体二重作動薬tirzepatideの慢性投与により、血流力学的・機能的・全身線維化の異常がほぼ完全に改善した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: eNOS KOマウス＋HFDモデルは、両性で迅速に発症し、高浸透性かつ化学的に無混淆のHFpEF研究プラットフォームとして機能する。
items.why_matters_ja: HFpEFは汎用的に有効な治療法が欠如している複雑な多臓器心代謝性症候群であり、本モデルはHFpEFの病態生理の解明や新規治療薬の検討に即座に採用可能なプラットフォームを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 動物実験（マウスモデルの開発・検証）
items.endpoints_ja: 左室駆出率、拡張機能不全（E/e'比、左室終末拡張期圧）、運動不耐容、心筋線維化、肝脂肪変性、腎尿細間質線維化、tirzepatide投与による血流力学的・機能的・全身線維化パラメータの改善
items.endpoint_results_ja: 左室駆出率は保たれた。E/e'比と左室終末拡張期圧は上昇し、重度の運動不耐容を認めた。心筋線維化、重度の肝脂肪変性、腎尿細間質線維化を伴った。tirzepatideの慢性投与により血流力学的・機能的・全身線維化の異常がほぼ完全に改善した。

items.title: Euglycemic ketoacidosis in a nondiabetic patient receiving dapagliflozin for heart failure.
items.abstract: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are increasingly used for cardiovascular indications in patients without diabetes, increasing exposure to uncommon metabolic complications. Euglycemic ketoacidosis is a serious but under-recognized adverse effect that may be overlooked because marked hyperglycemia is absent. We report a 72-year-old woman without diabetes who presented with high anion gap metabolic acidosis: bicarbonate 16 mmol/L (reference range, 22-29 mmol/L), anion gap 19 mmol/L (reference range, 8-12 mmol/L), and glucose 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L) (reference range, 70-100 mg/dL [3.9-5.6 mmol/L]). Serum beta-hydroxybutyrate was 3.4 mmol/L (reference range, <0.5 mmol/L), confirming ketosis. She was receiving dapagliflozin for heart failure. Discontinuation of dapagliflozin, intravenous fluids, and oral carbohydrate supplementation resulted in rapid resolution without insulin therapy. Because no alternative precipitant was identified and recurrence remained a concern, dapagliflozin was permanently discontinued, and SGLT2 inhibitor rechallenge was not recommended. This case demonstrates that euglycemic ketoacidosis may occur in nondiabetic patients without typical precipitants. Early recognition and individualized management can prevent unnecessary escalation of care as SGLT2 inhibitor use expands.
items.authors: Silveira Giullia, Kvasha Yuliana, Shah Preksha, Shah Harin, Gogineni Jyothi
items.summary_ja: 糖尿病を有さない72歳女性で、心不全に対してダパグリフロジンを使用していた患者に、正常血糖性ケトアシドーシス（高アニオンギャップ代謝性アシドーシス）が発生した単例報告。重炭酸塩16 mmol/L、アニオンギャップ19 mmol/L、血糖140 mg/dL（7.8 mmol/L）、血清β-ヒドロキシブチレート3.4 mmol/Lを呈した。ダパグリフロジンの中止、静脈内輸液、経口炭水化物補給によりインスリン治療なしで速やかに改善した。再発の懸念からダパグリフロジンの永久中止とし、SGLT2阻害薬の再挑戦は推奨されなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬を使用する非糖尿病患者において、典型的な誘因なしに正常血糖性ケトアシドーシスが発生し得る。SGLT2阻害薬の心血管適応での使用拡大に伴い、早期認識と個別化された管理が重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬は糖尿病患者以外でも心血管適応で増加しており、稀な代謝性合併症への曝露が増加している。正常血糖性ケトアシドーシスは著明な高血糖を伴わないため見逃されやすく、認識不足が問題である。
items.study_type_ja: 単例報告（Case Report）
items.endpoints_ja: 正常血糖性ケトアシドーシスの臨床的改善（インスリン治療なしでの解決）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 重炭酸塩 16 mmol/L（基準範囲 22-29 mmol/L）、アニオンギャップ 19 mmol/L（基準範囲 8-12 mmol/L）、血糖 140 mg/dL（7.8 mmol/L）（基準範囲 70-100 mg/dL [3.9-5.6 mmol/L]）、血清β-ヒドロキシブチレート 3.4 mmol/L（基準範囲 <0.5 mmol/L）。ダパグリフロジン中止、静脈内輸液、経口炭水化物補給によりインスリン治療なしで速やかに改善。

items.title: The Expanding Role of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Dual GIP/GLP-1 Agonists in Dermatology: From Immunometabolism to Clinical Practice.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) and dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (dual GIP/GLP-1 agonists) have rapidly changed the management of obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Beyond their effects on weight reduction and glycemic control, these agents exert pleiotropic effects on inflammation, adipose tissue biology, endothelial function and tissue repair, properties of growing relevance to dermatology, where several chronic inflammatory diseases are closely linked to obesity, insulin resistance and systemic low-grade inflammation. Current evidence suggests potential clinical benefit in psoriasis and hidradenitis suppurativa, encouraging signals regarding wound healing and a generally favorable cutaneous safety profile, although cutaneous adverse events, including injection site reactions, hypersensitivity, alopecia and rare autoimmune eruptions, have been increasingly reported. This review summarizes the immunometabolic rationale, current clinical evidence, the dermatologic safety profile and future perspectives of GLP-1RAs and dual GIP/GLP-1 agonists in dermatology. Although available data remain heterogeneous and largely observational outside psoriasis and hidradenitis suppurativa, these therapies may represent a new class of systemic immunometabolic modulators with practical implications for inflammatory, surgical and aesthetic dermatology.
items.authors: Giorgio Caterina M, Romanò Carola, Arisi Mariachiara, Rossi Mariateresa, Venturini Marina, Mezzana Sara, Grigolato Laura, Galli Benedetta
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）およびデュアルGIP/GLP-1受容体作動薬は、肥満および2型糖尿病の治療を急速に変革してきた。体重減少や血糖管理の効果に加え、炎症、脂肪組織生物学、内皮機能、組織修復に対する多面的な作用が皮膚科学において重要性を増している。本レビューは、GLP-1RAおよびデュアルGIP/GLP-1作動薬の皮膚科学における免疫代謝的根拠、現在の臨床エビデンス、皮膚的安全性プロファイル、今後の展望を総括する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAおよびデュアルGIP/GLP-1作動薬は、炎症性・外科的・美容皮膚科学に実用的な含意を持つ新しいクラスの全身性免疫代謝調節薬となり得るが、乾癬および化膿性汗腺炎以外のデータは不均一で、主に観察研究に留まっている。
items.why_matters_ja: 皮膚科学における複数の慢性炎症性疾患は肥満、インスリン抵抗性、全身性低度炎症と密接に関連しており、GLP-1RAおよびデュアルGIP/GLP-1作動薬の炎症・脂肪組織・内皮機能・組織修復に対する多面的な作用は、これらの疾患管理に新たな治療戦略を提供する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: International expert panel review for the use of resmetirom and semaglutide in the management of MASH-related fibrosis: clinical practice update.
items.abstract: The recent conditional US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of two therapies, resmetirom (Rezdiffra) and semaglutide (Wegovy), marks the first time clinicians have pharmacological therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) with significant fibrosis (F2-F3) without cirrhosis, a disease that previously had no available pharmacological treatment. The two agents act through complementary mechanisms: resmetirom as a liver-directed thyroid hormone receptor-beta agonist and semaglutide as a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1 RA) with a broad spectrum of metabolic effects. In this international expert panel review, we consolidate data from phase III trials, FDA labels and emerging clinical experience into a single resource. It covers the entire care pathway: non-invasive test-based diagnosis of MASH with significant fibrosis, treatment selection and initiation, on-treatment monitoring and response assessment. We offer practical recommendations for individualising therapy by patient phenotype, managing patients already receiving GLP-1 RAs and defining response, non-response and criteria for switching or combining agents. The proposed framework is intended to evolve as long-term outcomes data emerge and additional MASH therapies become available.
items.authors: Mironova Maria, Ratziu Vlad, Rinella Mary E, Bansal Meena B, Noureddin Mazen, Alkhouri Naim, Anstee Quentin M, Newsome Philip N
items.summary_ja: MASH（代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）で有意な線維化（F2-F3）を伴う非肝硬変症例に対する、resmetirom（甲状腺ホルモン受容体βアゴニスト）とsemaglutide（GLP-1受容体アゴニスト）の臨床実践に関する国際専門家パネルレビュー。Phase III試験データ、FDAラベル、および臨床経験の知見を統合し、非侵襲的検査による診断、治療選択・開始、治療中のモニタリング・反応評価を含むケアパス全体をカバーする。患者フェノタイプに応じた個別化治療、GLP-1 RA投与中患者の管理、反応・非反応の定義、薬剤切り替えまたは併用の基準について実践的提言を提示する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASHで有意な線維化を伴う症例に対し、初めて薬物療法（resmetiromとsemaglutide）が利用可能となり、本レビューは臨床現場での実践的な使用フレームワークを提供する。
items.why_matters_ja: MASHで有意な線維化を伴う症例は従来薬物療法が存在しなかった疾患であり、本レビューは新承認薬の臨床導入を支援する統合的リソースとして、診断から治療・モニタリングまでのケアパス全体を網羅する。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（国際専門家パネルレビュー／臨床実践アップデート）
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Structural Overview of GLP-1 Analogs.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs exert potent metabolic effects through structural features that govern receptor engagement, signaling, and pharmacokinetics. Key structural determinants include N-terminal modifications that confer resistance to dipeptidyl peptidase-4 degradation, as well as C-terminal and backbone elements that stabilize peptide helicity and enhance GLP-1 receptor affinity. Lipidation and albumin-binding strategies prolong systemic exposure by increasing circulating half-life, forming the basis of long-acting agents such as liraglutide and semaglutide. Structural variation further modulates signaling bias between G protein pathways and β-arrestin recruitment, potentially influencing therapeutic efficacy. Emerging multi-receptor agonists extend these principles across incretin receptor families and are increasingly supported by computational approaches to peptide optimization. Collectively, these advances illustrate how rational design drives the development of next-generation incretin therapeutics. This review synthesizes current insights into structural determinants of GLP-1 analogs and highlights future directions in the field.
items.authors: van der Velden Wijnand J C, Andresen Asta F, Rosenkilde Mette M
items.summary_ja: GLP-1アナログの構造的特徴が受容体結合・シグナル伝達・薬物動態をどのように支配するかを概観したレビュー論文。N末端修飾によるDPP-4分解耐性、C末端および骨格要素によるヘリックス安定化とGLP-1受容体親和性の向上、リポ化やアルブミン結合による半減期延長、Gタンパク質経路とβ-arrestin募集間のシグナルバイアスの調節、およびマルチレセプターアゴニストの発展について統合的に論じている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1アナログの構造設計（N末端修飾、リポ化、アルブミン結合、シグナルバイアス制御）が薬理学的特性を決定し、次世代インクレチン治療薬の合理的開発の基盤を形成している。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1アナログの構造と機能の関係を体系的に整理することで、次世代インクレチン治療薬の合理的設計と最適化に直接的な知見を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Where the Future Lies: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists as Therapeutics for Dermatologic Comorbidities.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have transformed the management of obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and cardiometabolic disease through effects on weight reduction, glycemic control, and systemic inflammation. Their varied immunometabolic actions have generated increasing interest in dermatology, where chronic inflammatory skin diseases frequently coexist with obesity, insulin resistance, metabolic syndrome, and cardiovascular disease. Emerging evidence from clinical trials, observational studies, and real-world analyses suggests that GLP-1RAs may improve outcomes in psoriasis, hidradenitis suppurativa, and atopic dermatitis while simultaneously reducing the burden of associated metabolic and cardiovascular comorbidities. In psoriasis, combination therapy with tirzepatide has demonstrated enhanced skin clearance, substantial weight loss, and reduced risk of psoriatic arthritis. In hidradenitis suppurativa and atopic dermatitis, GLP-1RAs have been associated with improvements in cardiometabolic outcomes and reductions in systemic complications. Collectively, these findings support an evolving paradigm in which the greatest therapeutic utility of GLP-1RAs in dermatology may lie not only in direct modulation of cutaneous inflammation but also in addressing the metabolic dysfunction and chronic systemic inflammation that drive disease severity and multimorbidity. We review the current clinical evidence and propose a conceptual framework positioning GLP-1RAs as immune-metabolic therapies that target the systemic comorbidities of inflammatory skin disease, highlighting future opportunities for disease modification and integrated dermatologic care.
items.authors: DeCoster Mikaela, Narla Shanthi
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体アゴニスト（GLP-1RA）が肥満、2型糖尿病、心代謝性疾患の管理を変革してきた背景のもと、その免疫代謝作用が皮膚科領域、特に慢性炎症性皮膚疾患（乾癬、化膿性汗腺炎、アトピー性皮膚炎）における治療応用について検討したレビュー論文。GLP-1RAが皮膚疾患の改善と関連する代謝・心血管合併症の軽減を同時に達成しうる可能性を、臨床試験・観察研究・実世界データから概観し、免疫代謝療法としての概念フレームワークを提案している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RAの皮膚科における最大の治療的有用性は、皮膚炎症の直接的な調節だけでなく、疾患重症度と多疾患併存を駆動する代謝機能不全と慢性全身性炎症に対処することにある可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 慢性炎症性皮膚疾患は肥満、インスリン抵抗性、代謝症候群、心血管疾患と頻繁に併存する。GLP-1RAは皮膚疾患そのものの改善と、関連する代謝・心血管合併症の軽減を同時に達成しうるため、統合的な皮膚科ケアの新たなパラダイムを提示する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（総説）
items.endpoints_ja: 乾癬：皮膚クリアランス、体重減少、乾癬性関節炎リスク。化膿性汗腺炎・アトピー性皮膚炎：心代謝性アウトカム、全身性合併症の軽減。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし（具体的な数値は記載されていない）

items.title: Metabolic Effects of a GLP-1 Analog Combined with Aerobic Training in Ovariectomized Rats.
items.abstract: Menopause is associated with visceral obesity, low-grade chronic inflammation, and increased risk of dyslipidemia, insulin resistance, and type 2 diabetes. Although exercise (EXE) and GLP-1 receptor agonists, such as semaglutide (SEM), have demonstrated beneficial effects on metabolic regulation, their combined impact in menopause models has been less investigated. In this study, ovariectomized female Wistar rats were divided into four experimental groups: sedentary plus saline (SED + SAL), sedentary plus semaglutide (SED + SEM), exercise (EXE + SAL), and EXE + SEM. The aerobic exercise protocol consisted of treadmill running at moderate intensity for four weeks, during which the rats received either SEM or SAL weekly. At the end of the protocol, metabolic parameters were assessed in blood, liver, soleus and gastrocnemius muscles. Both SEM groups had lower body weight, weight gain, relative subcutaneous white adipose tissue (scWAT) mass, glucose, total proteins, and triglycerides in serum and liver, while LDL cholesterol, glycogen in liver and gastrocnemius, and AMPK and HSF1 expression in gastrocnemius increased. EXE decreased total and LDL cholesterol, liver triglycerides and HSF1 expression in both tissues, while glycogen in liver and gastrocnemius, liver HSF1 expression and relative mass were increased. The combination of SEM + EXE increased glycogen content in the gastrocnemius and AMPK expression in both gastrocnemius and liver. This combined treatment reduced HDL levels, hepatic triglycerides and scWAT relative weight. These results suggest that SEM and EXE exert complementary effects on glycemic and lipid metabolism, with partially distinct metabolic outcomes that may involve different underlying mechanisms.
items.authors: Selau Bruna, Bastos Leonardo Marensi, Normann Rafaella Sanfelice, Cubas Gustavo Kasper, Herrmann Rodrigo de Oliveira Corrêa da Cunha, Barros Lucas Dos Anjos de Oliveira de, de Amaral Marjoriane, Trapp Márcia
items.summary_ja: 卵巣摘出ラット（閉経モデル）を用い、GLP-1受容体作動薬セマグルチド（SEM）と有酸素運動（EXE）の併用による代謝への影響を4群（SED+SAL、SED+SEM、EXE+SAL、EXE+SEM）で比較検討した。中等強度のトレッドミル走行を4週間実施し、週1回SEMまたはSALを投与した。プロトコル終了時に血液、肝臓、腓腹筋、ヒラメ筋の代謝パラメータを評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SEMとEXEは血糖・脂質代謝に対して相補的な効果を示し、部分的に異なる代謝的アウトカムが異なる基盤メカニズムを介して生じる可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 閉経は内臓肥満、低度慢性炎症、脂質異常症・インスリン抵抗性・2型糖尿病のリスク上昇と関連するが、運動とGLP-1受容体作動薬の併用効果は閉経モデルにおいて十分に研究されていない。
items.study_type_ja: 動物実験（前臨床研究）：卵巣摘出ラットを用いた4群比較の介入試験
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、体重増加、皮下白色脂肪組織（scWAT）相対質量、血清および肝臓のグルコース・総タンパク質・トリグリセリド、LDLコレステロール、HDLコレステロール、肝臓および腓腹筋のグリコーゲン、腓腹筋および肝臓のAMPK発現、腓腹筋および肝臓のHSF1発現、肝臓相対質量

items.title: Postoperative outcomes after total knee arthroplasty in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients receiving semaglutide versus tirzepatide: a propensity score-matched national research network analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Semaglutide (GLP-1 receptor agonist) and tirzepatide (dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist) are increasingly prescribed to adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA). Whether short-term postoperative outcomes differ between these agents was unknown.
METHODS: This was a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX research network database. Adults with T2DM who underwent primary TKA between June 1, 2022, and December 31, 2024, and had an active prescription for semaglutide or tirzepatide within 90 days preoperatively were eligible. 1:1 propensity score matching was conducted on age, sex, race, body mass index, hemoglobin A1c, comorbidity burden, and concurrent diabetes medication use, yielding 415 matched pairs. Outcomes through 90 and 180 days included medical complications, surgical complications, and healthcare utilization. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using logistic regression.
RESULTS: After matching (n = 830), there were no differences in 90-day medical complications (OR 1.122, 95% CI 0.736-1.710; P = 0.591) or 180-day surgical complications (OR 1.632, 95% CI 0.845-3.152; P = 0.141) between semaglutide and tirzepatide cohorts. Individual events, including myocardial infarction, stroke, pneumonia, sepsis, pulmonary embolism, deep vein thrombosis, acute kidney injury (OR 0.867, 95% CI 0.417-1.801; P = 0.701), urinary tract infection (OR 1.562, 95% CI 0.863-2.827; P = 0.138), surgical site infection (OR 1.726, 95% CI 0.782-3.810; P = 0.172), periprosthetic joint infection, wound dehiscence, mortality, and revision-were statistically similar (all P > 0.05). Emergency department visits and/or readmissions were comparable at 90 days (OR 0.775, 95% CI 0.570-1.052; P = 0.102) and 180 days (OR 0.887, 95% CI 0.672-1.170; P = 0.397). Several outcomes had low event counts in both groups, limiting precision.
CONCLUSION: In a large, propensity-matched national cohort of primary TKA, semaglutide and tirzepatide demonstrated similar short-term safety and utilization profiles. These findings support continued perioperative use of either agent in T2DM patients undergoing TKA.
items.authors: Wu Kevin A, Choudhury Ankit, Wu Joshua A, Shenoy Devika A, Song Junho, Mai Eric, Dhanjani Suraj, Shatkin Michael
items.summary_ja: TriNetX研究ネットワークデータベースを用いた後方視コホート研究。2022年6月1日から2024年12月31日の間に初回人工膝関節置換術（TKA）を受けた2型糖尿病（T2DM）成人患者で、術前90日以内にセマグルチドまたはtirzepatideの処方が有効であった対象を抽出した。年齢、性別、人種、BMI、HbA1c、合併症負荷、併用糖尿病薬使用を基準に1:1プロパティスコアマッチングを行い、415対（n=830）を解析した。90日および180日の医学的合併症、外科的合併症、医療資源利用を比較し、ロジスティック回帰でオッズ比（OR）と95%信頼区間（CI）を推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 初回TKAを受けたT2DM患者において、セマグルチドとtirzepatideの間で90日・180日の短期的安全性プロファイルおよび医療資源利用に有意な差は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチド（GLP-1受容体作動薬）とtirzepatide（GIP/GLP-1二重作動薬）はTKAを受けるT2DM患者に増加して処方されているが、両薬剤間の術後短期アウトカムの差は不明であった。本結果は、TKAを受けるT2DM患者においてどちらの薬剤も術前・術後期に継続使用可能であることを支持する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（プロパティスコアマッチング、全国研究ネットワークデータベース）
items.endpoints_ja: 90日医学的合併症、180日外科的合併症、個別イベント（心筋梗塞、脳卒中、肺炎、敗血症、肺塞栓症、深部静脈血栓症、急性腎障害、尿路感染症、手術部位感染、周囲関節感染、創離開、死亡、再手術）、90日および180日の救急外来受診および/または再入院

items.title: Improvement of small fiber neuropathy assessed by corneal confocal microscopy following semaglutide treatment: a case report and literature review.
items.abstract: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is the most common chronic complication of type 2 diabetes (T2D) and a major predisposing factor for the development of diabetic foot, one of the most devastating diabetes-related conditions associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. To date, no pharmacological therapy has been shown capable of preventing, halting, or reversing neuropathic damage. We report the case of a 57-year-old man with T2D and obesity (BMI 35.2 kg/m²) who presented with symptoms and signs of DPN, including a neuropathy symptom score (NSS) of 3/9, a neuropathy disability score (NDS) of 3/10, and a vibration perception threshold (VPT) of 22 volts (V) bilaterally. In vivo corneal confocal microscopy (CCM) was performed to further evaluate small fiber involvement. Despite adequate glycemic control (HbA1c 6.6%), semaglutide was initiated to optimize metabolic status and promote weight loss. After 6 months of treatment, both BMI and HbA1c had improved, while NSS, NDS, and VPT remained unchanged. Repeat CCM demonstrated improvement across all corneal nerve parameters. This case suggests that semaglutide-associated metabolic improvement, or a direct semaglutide effect on small fiber integrity, may contribute to early regeneration of small nerve fibers in DPN. Further studies are urgently needed to determine whether semaglutide has a therapeutic role in the management of DPN.
items.authors: Anastasiou Ioanna A, Tentolouris Nikolaos, Rebelos Eleni
items.summary_ja: T2Dおよび肥満（BMI 35.2 kg/m²）を伴う57歳男性のDPN症例報告および文献レビュー。血糖管理は十分（HbA1c 6.6%）であったが、代謝状態の最適化と減量目的でセマグルチドを開始。6ヶ月後、BMIとHbA1cは改善したが、NSS・NDS・VPTは変化なし。再検査の角膜共焦点顕微鏡（CCM）では、すべての角膜神経パラメータで改善が認められた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド治療に伴う代謝改善、またはセマグルチドの末梢神経線維への直接作用が、DPNにおける小神経線維の早期再生に寄与する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: DPNはT2Dで最も一般的な慢性合併症であり、糖尿病足発症の主要な危険因子である。現在までに、神経障害を予防・停止・逆転できる薬物療法は示されていない。本症例はセマグルチドがDPN管理に治療的役割を果たす可能性を示唆している。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告および文献レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: BMI、HbA1c、神経症状スコア（NSS）、神経障害スコア（NDS）、振動覚閾値（VPT）、角膜共焦点顕微鏡（CCM）による角膜神経パラメータ
items.endpoint_results_ja: ベースライン：BMI 35.2 kg/m²、HbA1c 6.6%、NSS 3/9、NDS 3/10、VPT 22 V（両側）。6ヶ月後：BMI改善（具体値記載なし）、HbA1c改善（具体値記載なし）、NSS変化なし、NDS変化なし、VPT変化なし、CCMではすべての角膜神経パラメータで改善（具体値記載なし）。

items.title: The SGLT2i Treatment Gap in UK Primary Care: A Cross-Sectional RWE Study of Prescribing in Clinical Practice.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) improve cardiovascular and renal outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), chronic kidney disease (CKD) and chronic heart failure (CHF). Despite clinical guideline recommendations, SGLT2i uptake in UK primary care remains suboptimal and information on utilisation is limited. This study aims to quantify and describe the UK primary care population with T2DM, CKD and/or CHF who are eligible for but not currently prescribed an SGLT2i.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted using routinely collected electronic health records from the Optimum Patient Care Research Database. Adults aged ≥ 18 years on 1 July 2024 were included. Descriptive analyses estimated disease prevalence (defined by morbidity-coded diagnosis), SGLT2i eligibility (defined using NICE clinical guidelines) and current SGLT2i treatment (defined as any SGLT2i prescription in the previous 2 months) by conditions and selected characteristics. Main results are based on diagnosed disease; in a separate CKD sensitivity analysis, indicative CKD (without a morbidity code) was defined using kidney function test results.
RESULTS: In the study population of 9.8 million adults, prevalence was 6.52% for T2DM, 4.95% for diagnosed CKD (6.07% including indicative CKD) and 1.40% for CHF. Among all SGLT2i-eligible individuals, 17.5% were currently prescribed an SGLT2i. Current SGLT2i treatment was lowest in CKD-only patients (3.8% treated among eligible) and highest in those meeting eligibility criteria for all three indications (32.9% treated). SGLT2i treatment was lower in women and older adults.
CONCLUSIONS: SGLT2i therapy is significantly underutilised in UK primary care, particularly for CKD. Equitable implementation of SGLT2i clinical guidelines is vital to improve cardio-renal-metabolic care.
items.authors: Stefanska Chelsea, Chung Ryan, Ramjaun Salman, Jin Danyao, Doherty Ciara, McCafferty Kieran, Seidu Samuel
items.summary_ja: 英国プライマリケアにおけるSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）の処方ギャップを定量化・記述することを目的とした横断的RWE研究。Optimum Patient Care Research Databaseの電子健康記録を用い、2024年7月1日時点で18歳以上の成人を対象に、T2DM・CKD・CHFの有病率、NICEガイドラインに基づくSGLT2i適応該当率、および現在のSGLT2i処方率を記述的に分析した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 英国プライマリケアにおいてSGLT2iは著しく未活用されており、特にCKD単独患者では適応該当者のうち3.8%のみが処方されていた。3疾患すべてに該当する患者でも32.9%にとどまり、ガイドラインの公平な実施が課題である。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2iは心血管・腎予後改善のエビデンスがあり、ガイドラインで推奨されているにもかかわらず、実臨床での処方率が低いことを大規模RWEデータで定量的に示した。臨床開発・ヘルスケア政策の観点から、未処方の原因解明や介入戦略の設計に重要な基盤データとなる。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的RWE研究（電子健康記録を用いた記述的分析）
items.endpoints_ja: T2DM・CKD・CHFの有病率、SGLT2i適応該当率（NICEガイドライン準拠）、現在のSGLT2i処方率（過去2ヶ月間のSGLT2i処方あり）

items.title: Carbon Emission Impact of Semaglutide in People with Obesity in the UK Using a Disease Modelling Approach.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: We aimed to assess the carbon footprint and clinical outcomes of once-weekly semaglutide in people with overweight or obesity in the UK using a disease modelling approach.
METHODS: A per-patient carbon footprint analysis was conducted to estimate emissions related to obesity management with semaglutide 2.4 mg as an add on to diet and exercise versus diet and exercise alone. A Markov state-transition cohort model (Core Obesity Model) was used for the analysis. Data were sourced from STEP and SELECT trials across three populations: (1) body mass index [BMI] ≥ 30 or ≥ 27 with one or more obesity-related complications (BMI30+/BMI27+C), (2) BMI ≥ 27 with one or more complications, including type 2 diabetes mellitus (BMI27+C), and (3) BMI ≥ 27 with established cardiovascular disease (BMI27+CVD). Carbon emissions were estimated using resource-based and cost-based methods. Key outcomes included life-years, quality-adjusted life-years, and incremental carbon footprint effectiveness ratio.
RESULTS: In the BMI30+/BMI27+C and BMI27+C populations, semaglutide was dominant, yielding 0.30 and 0.25 additional life-years, 0.51 and 0.46 additional quality-adjusted life-years, while reducing lifetime carbon emissions by 1.8% (9850 vs 10,030 kg of CO2 equivalent [CO2e]) and 1.9% (9792 vs 9983 kg CO2e), respectively. Manufacturing emissions of semaglutide were offset by reductions in carbon emissions resulting from fewer obesity-related complications. In the BMI27+CVD population, semaglutide improved life-years by 0.56 and quality-adjusted life-years by 0.59, but emissions increased (14,700 vs 14,444 kg CO2e) because of longer survival and increased monitoring. Scenario and sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of the results.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide offers both clinical and environmental benefits in obesity management, supporting the UK's net-zero emissions goals.
items.authors: Lund Niels, Lübker Christopher, Rasche Andreas, Taylor Matthew, Xu Weiwei, Taneja Loveleen, Shukla Suramya, Olivieri Anamaria-Vera
items.summary_ja: 英国における肥満症患者を対象に、週1回セマグルチド2.4 mg（食事・運動療法併用）と食事・運動療法単独の炭素フットプリントと臨床アウトカムを、Markov状態遷移コホートモデル（Core Obesity Model）を用いて評価したモデリング研究。STEP試験とSELECT試験のデータを3つの母集団（BMI30+/BMI27+C、BMI27+C、BMI27+CVD）に適用し、リソースベース法とコストベース法で炭素排出量を推定した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: BMI30+/BMI27+CおよびBMI27+C母集団ではセマグルチドが優位（dominant）であり、寿命・QALYの改善とともに生涯炭素排出量を1.8〜1.9%削減した。一方、BMI27+CVD母集団では生存延長とモニタリング増加により排出量が増加した。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満治療におけるセマグルチドの臨床的効果と環境的インパクトを同時に評価し、英国のネットゼロ排出目標との整合性を示した点で、臨床開発・薬物経済学・環境持続可能性の交差点において重要な知見を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: モデリング研究（Markov状態遷移コホートモデル）
items.endpoints_ja: 寿命（life-years）、QALY（quality-adjusted life-years）、生涯炭素排出量（kg CO2e）、増分炭素フットプリント効果比（incremental carbon footprint effectiveness ratio）
items.endpoint_results_ja: BMI30+/BMI27+C：寿命+0.30年、QALY+0.51、炭素排出量 9850 vs 10,030 kg CO2e（1.8%削減）。BMI27+C：寿命+0.25年、QALY+0.46、炭素排出量 9792 vs 9983 kg CO2e（1.9%削減）。BMI27+CVD：寿命+0.56年、QALY+0.59、炭素排出量 14,700 vs 14,444 kg CO2e（増加）。

items.title: Increased Energy Expenditure through Intermittent Cold Exposure Does Not Enhance Tirzepatide Induced Weight-loss in Obese Mice.
items.abstract: Obesity results from an imbalance between energy intake and energy expenditure. While pharmacological approaches such as tirzepatide, a dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, reduce food intake and body weight, enhancing energy expenditure via intermittent cold exposure-induced activation of thermogenesis may provide complementary benefits. Intermittent cold exposure increases energy expenditure and improves glucose homeostasis independent of weight loss. The objective of this study was to investigate the individual and combined effects of tirzepatide and intermittent cold exposure (ICE) on weight loss and glucose homeostasis. We hypothesized that combining ICE with tirzepatide would lead to greater weight loss and improvements in glucose homeostasis than tirzepatide alone. Male and female C57BL/6J mice were fed a high fat diet for 8 weeks and then treated with tirzepatide (10 nmol/kg) or vehicle and exposed, or not, to ICE (4°C, 1 h/day, 5 days/week) for 3 weeks. Body weight/composition, energy expenditure, food intake and glucose homeostasis were assessed. Tirzepatide reduced body weight, food intake, and adiposity in both sexes while ICE, acutely increased energy expenditure and improved glucose homeostasis independent of changes in body weight. There were no additive effects of combining tirzepatide and ICE. Our findings highlight that combining tirzepatide-mediated reduction in energy intake with ICE-induced activation of thermogenesis yields complementary, but not necessarily additive improvements in metabolic health.
items.journal: American journal of physiology. Regulatory, integrative and comparative physiology
items.authors: Bellucci Annalaura, Alfares Hadil, Gale Clara, Akcan Michael, Waters Ben, Eisner Katelyn, Baranowski Bradley J, Jeromson Stewart
items.summary_ja: 肥満マウス（C57BL/6J、高脂肪食8週間）において、tirzepatide（10 nmol/kg）と間欠的寒冷曝露（ICE：4°C、1時間/日、週5日、3週間）の単独および併用効果について体重・体組成、エネルギー消費、食物摂取量、グルコース恒常性に及ぼす影響を評価した。Tirzepatideは両性で体重・食物摂取量・脂肪量を減少させ、ICEは体重変化に依存せずエネルギー消費を急性増加させグルコース恒常性を改善した。両者の併用による相加効果は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Tirzepatideと間欠的寒冷曝露の併用は、tirzepatide単独投与に比べ体重減少の相加効果を示さず、両介入は代謝健康に対して補完的だが必ずしも相加的ではない改善をもたらす。
items.why_matters_ja: 薬物療法（GIP/GLP-1受容体作動薬）と生活習慣介入（寒冷曝露による熱産生促進）の併用が体重減少をさらに増強するかという臨床的に重要な問いに答えており、臨床試験デザインや患者への介入戦略の検討に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（マウスモデル、多群比較介入試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重/体組成、エネルギー消費、食物摂取量、グルコース恒常性
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載されていない。定性的な結果として：tirzepatideは両性で体重・食物摂取量・脂肪量を減少、ICEは体重変化に依存せずエネルギー消費を急性増加させグルコース恒常性を改善、併用による相加効果は認められなかった。

items.title: CARDIOVASCULAR EFFECTS OF INCRETIN RECEPTOR AGONISTS: BEYOND GLYCEMIC CONTROL.
items.abstract: Incretin-based therapies have evolved from selective GLP-1RA to dual GLP-1/ GIP agonists and unimolecular triple GLP-1/GIP/glucagon receptor agonists. This review examines the cardiovascular effects of these three pharmacological tiers, with emphasis on mechanisms that operate beyond glycaemic control. Mediation analyses of major CVOTs indicate that glycaemic improvement accounts for less than 15 to 20 percent of the reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events achieved by these agents. The remainder reflects converging effects on weight reduction, lipid remodelling, blood pressure, systemic inflammation, and direct myocardial protection. At the cellular level, incretin signalling preserves mitochondrial bioenergetics, activates antioxidant defences, and inhibits multiple cardiomyocyte death pathways. At the tissue level, recent investigations in isolated human atrial preparations demonstrate direct positive inotropic effects of both GLP-1RA and the triple agonist retatrutide. Cardiac magnetic resonance evidence from the SUMMIT programme documents reverse left ventricular remodelling with tirzepatide in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. Phase 2 data for triple agonists have produced unprecedented surrogate cardiovascular improvements, while Phase 3 outcome data from the TRIUMPH programme remain awaited. The cardiovascular pharmacology of metabolic disease has been fundamentally reshaped, and ongoing trials will determine whether multi-receptor agonism establishes a new therapeutic standard.
items.journal: Canadian journal of physiology and pharmacology
items.authors: Ravic Marko, Srejovic Ivan M, Milosavljevic Isidora, Novakovic Jovana, Jakovljevic Vladimir, Vucicevic Ksenija, Petrovic Djurdjina, Muric Maja
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、インクレチン系治療薬（選択的GLP-1受容体作動薬、GLP-1/GIP二重作動薬、GLP-1/GIP/グルカゴン三重受容体作動薬）の3つの薬理学的階層における心血管効果を、血糖管理を超えたメカニズムに焦点を当てて考察している。主要なCVOTの媒介解析により、血糖改善は主要心血管不良事象（MACE）減少の15〜20%未満しか説明しておらず、残りは体重減少、脂質再構成、血圧、全身性炎症、直接的な心筋保護の収束効果に帰せられる。細胞レベルではミトコンドリア生エネルギーの維持、抗酸化防御の活性化、心筋細胞死経路の抑制が示され、組織レベルではヒト心房標本でのGLP-1RAおよび三重作動薬retatrutideの直接的な正性変力作用が報告されている。SUMMITプログラムではtirzepatideによる肥満関連HFpEFにおける左室逆リモデリングがCMRで確認された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: インクレチン系治療薬によるMACE減少の大部分（80〜85%以上）は血糖改善ではなく、体重減少・脂質再構成・血圧低下・全身性炎症抑制・直接的な心筋保護の収束効果に由来する。
items.why_matters_ja: 代謝性疾患の心血管薬理学が根本的に再構築されており、多受容体作動性が新たな治療基準を確立するかどうかは進行中の第III相試験（TRIUMPHプログラム）の結果に委ねられている。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 主要心血管不良事象（MACE）、体重減少、脂質再構成、血圧、全身性炎症、直接的な心筋保護、正性変力作用、左室逆リモデリング
items.endpoint_results_ja: 血糖改善はMACE減少の15〜20%未満しか説明しない（主要CVOTの媒介解析）

items.title: Finerenone Use in Heart Failure Patients with Type 2 Diabetes and Kidney Disease: An Analysis of the FINE-TURK Registry.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Finerenone, a non-steroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, improves cardiorenal outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease. However, real-world data on its use in patients with concomitant heart failure remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the baseline characteristics and short-term renal safety and efficacy of finerenone in patients with type 2 diabetes, kidney disease, and heart failure from the FINE-TURK Registry.
METHODS: This was a retrospective, multicenter, observational registry analysis conducted across 56 centers in Türkiye. Among 1,168 patients initially enrolled, 918 patients with available heart failure status and ejection fraction data were included. Patients were categorized according to the presence of heart failure, and heart failure patients were further classified as HFrEF or HFmrEF/HFpEF. Three-month changes in serum potassium, estimated glomerular filtration rate, and albuminuria were assessed. Safety endpoints included serum potassium ≥ 5.5 mEq/L and eGFR ≤ 25 mL/min/1.73 m² at three months. The primary renal efficacy endpoint was a > 30% reduction in albuminuria from baseline.
RESULTS: Of 918 patients, 133 had heart failure. Patients with heart failure were older and had lower baseline eGFR compared with those without heart failure. They were also more likely to receive a lower starting dose of finerenone. At three months, changes in serum potassium, eGFR, and albuminuria were not significantly different between patients with and without heart failure. No excess risk of hyperkalemia or worsening renal function was observed in the heart failure group. In adjusted analyses, heart failure was associated with a greater likelihood of achieving a > 30% reduction in albuminuria. No significant differences in short-term renal safety or efficacy outcomes were observed between HFrEF and HFmrEF/HFpEF subgroups.
CONCLUSIONS: In this nationwide real-world registry, patients with heart failure who were treated with finerenone had a higher-risk baseline profile, including older age and lower eGFR. Despite this, finerenone was not associated with increased short-term renal safety concerns and was linked to a clinically meaningful reduction in albuminuria. These findings support the short-term renal safety and potential efficacy of finerenone in patients with type 2 diabetes, kidney disease, and heart failure.
items.authors: Yadigar Serap, Akgür Suat, Güvenç Tolga Sinan, Sezen Mehmet, Özcan Büşra, Yıldırım Ayaz Elif, Doğantekin Betül, Atay İlker
items.summary_ja: FINE-TURKレジストリ（トルコ56施設）の後ろ向き観察的解析において、2型糖尿病・慢性腎臓病・心不全を合併する患者におけるフィネレノンの短期腎安全性と有効性を評価した。918例中133例が心不全を有し、心不全群は非心不全群より高齢でベースラインeGFRが低かった。3ヶ月時の血清カリウム、eGFR、アルブミン尿の変化は心不全の有無で有意差を認めず、高カリウム血症や腎機能悪化の過剰リスクは観察されなかった。調整解析では心不全はアルブミン尿の30%以上の減少達成と関連した。HFrEFとHFmrEF/HFpEFのサブグループ間では短期腎安全性・有効性アウトカムに有意差は認められなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2型糖尿病・慢性腎臓病・心不全を合併する患者において、フィネレノンは短期の腎安全性上の懸念を増加させず、アルブミン尿の臨床的に意味のある減少と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: フィネレノンは2型糖尿病合併慢性腎臓病患者で心腎アウトカムの改善を示すが、心不全を合併する患者における実世界データは限られていた。本レジストリ解析は、より高リスクなベースラインプロファイル（高齢・低eGFR）を有する心不全患者においてもフィネレノンの短期腎安全性と潜在的有効性を支持する実世界エビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き、多施設、観察的レジストリ解析
items.endpoints_ja: 安全性エンドポイント：3ヶ月時の血清カリウム≥5.5 mEq/L、eGFR≤25 mL/min/1.73 m²。主要腎有効性エンドポイント：ベースラインからアルブミン尿の30%以上の減少。その他：3ヶ月時の血清カリウム、eGFR、アルブミン尿の変化。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値結果（割合、オッズ比、p値など）の記載なし。定性的な記述のみ：心不全群と非心不全群で血清カリウム・eGFR・アルブミン尿の変化に有意差なし、高カリウム血症や腎機能悪化の過剰リスクなし、調整解析で心不全はアルブミン尿30%以上減少の達成率上昇と関連、HFrEFとHFmrEF/HFpEFサブグループ間に有意差なし。
items.sample_size_ja: 当初登録1,168例中、心不全状態と駆出率データが利用可能な918例を含む（うち心不全133例）。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonism in Alzheimer's disease after EVOKE: From single hypothesis to stratified program.
items.abstract: The phase 3 EVOKE and EVOKE + trials of oral semaglutide in early Alzheimer's disease missed their primary endpoint and every cognitive or functional secondary endpoint. A recent article by Hölscher revisits extension-phase data and reports partial separation at later timepoints, attributing the failure to limited brain penetration. We argue that attrited extension cohorts bear limited inferential weight and that the biomarker substudy, read in full, complicates a clean disease-modification reading. EVOKE does not refute the cardiometabolic hypothesis but reframes the open questions: which pathways, which patients, and which disease stages are most likely to benefit.
items.authors: Pereira Da Silva Anderson Matheus, Haddad Santos Diogo
items.summary_ja: EVOKEおよびEVOKE+第III相試験（早期アルツハイマー病における経口セマグルチド）は主要エンドポイントおよびすべての認知・機能二次エンドポイントを未達とした。本稿は、Hölscherらが拡張期データから後期時間点での部分的な分離を報告し脳内浸透性の限界を失敗原因とみなした解釈に対し、脱落した拡張コホートは推論上の重みが限定的であり、バイオマーカーサブスタディを全面的に読めば疾患修飾の単純な解釈は複雑化すると論じる。EVOKEは心代謝仮説を否定するものではなく、どの経路・どの患者・どの病期が最も恩恵を受ける可能性があるかという未解決の問いを再定義するものであると主張する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: EVOKE/EVOKE+試験は主要・二次エンドポイントを未達したが、これは心代謝仮説の否定ではなく、GLP-1受容体作動薬のアルツハイマー病における適用対象（経路・患者層・病期）をより精緻に層別化する必要性を示唆する。
items.why_matters_ja: EVOKE試験の失敗を単純に「GLP-1 RAはアルツハイマー病に無効」と解釈するのではなく、脱落バイアスを含む拡張期データの解釈に注意を促し、バイオマーカーサブスタディの再評価を通じて、今後の層別化プログラム設計への方向性を示す点で意義がある。
items.study_type_ja: Perspective/Commentary（学術的論評・視点記事）

items.title: Pharmacokinetics of novel drugs for the treatment of diabetic nephropathy.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) alters drug pharmacokinetics (PK), affecting exposure, pharmacodynamic response, and toxicity. As newer therapies become central to DKD management, understanding their PK profiles is essential for individualized treatment across stages of kidney impairment.
AREAS COVERED: PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus were searched from database inception through 18 April 2026, for evidence on PK, pharmacodynamics, renal-impairment effects, and drug-drug interactions. Evidence was synthesized for sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA), dual incretin agonists, nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (nsMRA), endothelin receptor antagonists (ERA), aldosterone synthase inhibitors (vicadrostat, baxdrostat, and lorundrostat), avenciguat, and ziltivekimab, emphasizing exposure, clearance, metabolism, elimination, and dosing implications.
EXPERT OPINION: In reduced kidney function, SGLT2i show modest increases in drug exposure but attenuated glucose-lowering effects. Finerenone demonstrates modest exposure increases despite minimal renal clearance. Some ERAs, particularly zibotentan may have larger esposure increases, poentially narrowing the therapeutic window. Newer incretin-based therapies generally maintain stable exposure. However, eGFR alone may not fully capture changes in drug disposition. Factors such as uremia, altered protein binding, and nonrenal clearance can also affect exposure. The next advance will likely be drug-specific decision support integrating eGFR trajectory, potassium levels, dialysis status, body composition, and concomitant medications, rather than universal therapeutic drug monitoring.
items.journal: Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology
items.authors: Mousavi Taraneh, Shaya Fadia T, Munir Kashif M, Davis Stephen N
items.summary_ja: 糖尿病性腎疾患（DKD）における新規治療薬の薬物動態（PK）を総合的にレビューした論文。PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopusをデータベース開始から2026年4月18日まで検索し、SGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）、デュアルインクレチン作動薬、非ステロイド性ミネラルコルチコイド受容体拮抗薬（nsMRA）、エンドセリン受容体拮抗薬（ERA）、アルドステロン合成酵素阻害薬（vicadrostat、baxdrostat、lorundrostat）、avenciguat、ziltivekimabについて、曝露量、クリアランス、代謝、排泄、投与量への影響を統合した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 腎機能低下時、SGLT2iは薬物曝露量の軽度増加と血糖降下効果の減弱を示す。Finerenoneは腎クリアランスが最小限であるにもかかわらず曝露量の軽度増加を示す。一部のERA（特にzibotentan）は曝露量のより大きな増加により治療域が狭まる可能性がある。新規インクレチン系療法は概ね曝露量が安定している。eGFR単独では薬物動態の変化を十分に捉えきれず、尿毒症、タンパク結合の変化、非腎クリアランスも曝露量に影響し得る。
items.why_matters_ja: DKD管理において新規療法が中核を占めるようになり、腎障害の各段階にわたる個別化治療には薬物動態プロファイルの理解が不可欠である。eGFR軌跡、カリウム値、透析状態、体組成、併用薬を統合した薬剤固有の意思決定支援が次の進展になると示唆されている。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（Expert Opinion形式の叙述的レビュー）。PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopusをデータベース開始から2026年4月18日まで検索し、薬物動態、薬力学的効果、腎障害の影響、薬物間相互作用のエビデンスを統合。
items.endpoints_ja: 本レビューは一次臨床試験の主要評価項目を有しない。対象とする薬物動態パラメータ（曝露量、クリアランス、代謝、排泄）および投与量への影響をレビューの焦点としている。

items.title: Renal Safety of Intravitreal Ranibizumab and the Effects of SGLT2 Inhibition in Diabetic Macular Oedema: A Post Hoc Analysis of the COMET Trial.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To evaluate whether intravitreal ranibizumab (IVR) frequency is associated with longitudinal renal markers in diabetic macular oedema (DMO) and whether the expected systemic renal and haematological effects of SGLT2 inhibition are reproduced.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this post hoc sub-analysis of the prospective COMET randomised controlled trial, 53 participants were analysed. The estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), haematocrit (Hct), and urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) were assessed over 48 weeks using linear mixed-effects models with the treatment group, week, group-by-week interaction, and cumulative IVR as fixed effects.
RESULTS: Baseline eGFR was preserved (72.2 ± 18.5 mL/min/1.73 m2) despite common albuminuria (median UACR 50.6 mg/gCr); mean cumulative IVR at week 48 was 7.00 ± 4.42. Cumulative IVR was not significantly associated with eGFR (-0.22 mL/min/1.73 m2 per injection; 95% CI -0.59 to 0.15; p = 0.25), ln(UACR), or Hct. The SGLT2 inhibitor reproduced an early eGFR dip and Hct rise.
CONCLUSIONS: No statistically significant exposure-response association was detected between cumulative IVR and renal markers within the COMET trial cohort and dosing range. Because all participants received IVR and the sample size was modest, small cumulative renal effects cannot be excluded.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: University Hospital Medical Information Network Center (UMIN000057674); Japan Registry of Clinical Trials (jRCTs031180210, parent COMET trial).
items.authors: Sakai Toshiki, Ishibashi Ryoichi, Koshizaka Masaya, Takatsuna Yoko, Tatsumi Tomoaki, Baba Takayuki, Sakurai Kenichi, Maezawa Yoshiro
items.summary_ja: COMET試験（前向きランダム化比較試験）のpost hocサブ解析として、糖尿病性黄斑浮腫（DMO）患者における硝子体内ランビズマブ（IVR）の投与頻度が腎機能マーカー（eGFR、ヘマトクリット、尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比）に与える影響を48週間にわたり評価し、SGLT2阻害薬による腎・血液学的効果の再現性を確認した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: COMET試験コホートおよび投与範囲内では、累積IVR投与量と腎機能マーカー（eGFR、UACR、Hct）の間に統計的に有意な曝露-反応関連は検出されなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 硝子体内抗VEGF療法はDMO患者の標準治療であり、その全身的安全性（特に腎機能への影響）は臨床開発上重要な安全性評価項目である。本解析はIVRの腎安全性に関するエビデンスを提供するとともに、SGLT2阻害薬の既知の腎・血液学的効果（初期eGFR低下、Hct上昇）をDMO患者でも再現できることを示し、SGLT2阻害薬の腎保護効果の臨床開発におけるバイオマーカー検証に参考となる。
items.study_type_ja: 前向きランダム化比較試験（COMET試験）のpost hocサブ解析
items.endpoints_ja: 推定糸球体濾過量（eGFR）、ヘマトクリット（Hct）、尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比（UACR）を48週間にわたり線形混合効果モデルで評価
items.endpoint_results_ja: ベースラインeGFR: 72.2 ± 18.5 mL/min/1.73 m²；中央値UACR: 50.6 mg/gCr；48週時平均累積IVR投与量: 7.00 ± 4.42；累積IVRとeGFRの関連: -0.22 mL/min/1.73 m² per injection（95% CI -0.59〜0.15; p = 0.25）；累積IVRとln(UACR)およびHctの関連は統計的に有意でなかった；SGLT2阻害薬群で初期eGFR低下（dip）とHct上昇が再現された

items.title: Cell death-induced chronic inflammation as a therapeutic target for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) is a progressive liver disease characterized by hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis, which can ultimately lead to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Although recent Food and Drug Administration approvals of resmetirom and semaglutide mark a milestone in MASH therapy, no approved agents directly target hepatic inflammation or fibrosis, underscoring the urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies. Hepatocyte death is a histological hallmark that distinguishes MASH from simple steatosis, yet the mechanisms by which it drives chronic inflammation and fibrosis remain incompletely understood. We identified hepatic crown-like structures (CLSs), aggregates of macrophages surrounding dead hepatocytes, as the histological hub of this process. In steatotic livers, impaired dead cell clearance allows sustained macrophage-dead cell interactions within CLSs, where tissue-resident macrophages acquire profibrotic properties. Cholesterol accumulation in hepatocytes promotes cholesterol crystallization, triggering hepatocyte death and subsequent lysosomal cholesterol overload in CLS-constituting macrophages, thereby accelerating inflammation and fibrosis. Targeting this pathway using a liver-tropic supramolecular β-cyclodextrin polyrotaxane (βCD-PRX), which selectively delivers βCD to lysosomes via endocytosis, ameliorated macrophage lysosomal stress and hepatic fibrosis in murine MASH models without affecting body weight or steatosis. Beyond the liver, CLS-driven chronic inflammation contributes to adipose tissue dysfunction in obesity and the transition from acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease, suggesting broad therapeutic relevance. Continued investigation of CLSs as a shared pathological microenvironment across metabolic diseases may pave the way for novel diagnostic and therapeutic modalities for MASH and related conditions.
items.authors: Suganami Takayoshi, Tanaka Miyako, Itoh Michiko
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎（MASH）における細胞死誘導性慢性炎症を治療標的として論じる。肝臓クラウン様構造（CLSs）を、死んだ肝細胞を囲むマクロファージの集塊として同定し、これがMASHにおける慢性炎症と線維化の組織学的ハブであることを示した。脂肪変性肝臓では死細胞の除去障害によりCLSs内でマクロファージ-死細胞の相互作用が持続し、組織residentマクロファージが線維化促進性性質を獲得する。肝細胞内のコレステロール蓄積がコレステロール結晶化を誘導し、肝細胞死およびCLSs構成マクロファージの溶胞内コレステロール過負荷を引き起こすことで炎症と線維化を加速する。肝臓特異的超分子β-シクロデキストリンポリロタキサン（βCD-PRX）を用いたこの経路の標的化により、マウスMASHモデルでマクロファージ溶胞ストレスと肝線維化が改善し、体重や脂肪変性には影響しなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CLSsはMASHにおいて肝細胞死から慢性炎症・線維化への移行を媒介する組織学的ハブであり、βCD-PRXによるこの経路の標的化がマウスモデルで肝線維化を改善した。
items.why_matters_ja: 現在、肝炎症や線維化を直接標的とする承認薬が存在せず、MASH治療において未充足の臨床ニーズがある。CLSsを治療標的とすることで、このギャップを埋める新たな治療戦略の道が開かれる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: マクロファージ溶胞ストレス、肝線維化、体重、脂肪変性（マウスMASHモデル）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし（βCD-PRXによりマクロファージ溶胞ストレスと肝線維化が改善、体重・脂肪変性には影響なし、と定性的に記述されているが、具体的な数値は記載されていない）

items.title: Orforglipron and the Kidney: A Promise or Disappointment? The Need for Trials Examining Renal Outcomes.
items.abstract: Orforglipron, the first oral non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist, has a pharmacokinetic and formulation profile that may be theoretically attractive for patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) including hepatic metabolism with minimal renal excretion and removal of potential barriers associated with current injectable and other oral formulations. We utilized a literature search utilizing PubMed/MEDLINE and ClinicalTrials. gov from their respective inceptions through May 2026 to synthesize a review on orforglipron. Phase 3 trials demonstrated significant reductions in hemoglobin A1c, body weight, and cardiovascular risk markers with stable eGFR and no indications of significant renal toxicity. These trials however were not designed or powered to evaluate renal outcomes including eGFR, albuminuria, and kidney failure progression. Additionally, previous trials were noted to have underrepresented or excluded populations of patients with advanced CKD, thus renal effects are inferential barring further clinical investigation, though a current trial examining kidney and cardiovascular outcomes in patients with both atherosclerosis and CKD is underway. Future CKD-specific trials are necessary to determine the safety, efficacy, and potential integration of orforglipron into nephrology treatment algorithms.
items.authors: Shah Joel, Luna Ceron Eder, Payan-Schober Fernanda, Hechanova Lisa Aimee, Clegg Deborah Joy, Palmer Biff F
items.summary_ja: Orforglipronは初の経口非ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬であり、肝代謝を主とし腎排泄が最小限である薬物動態プロファイルにより、慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者に対して理論的に魅力的である。PubMed/MEDLINEおよびClinicalTrials.govからの文献検索により、Phase 3試験ではヘモグロビンA1c、体重、心血管リスクマーカーの有意な低下とeGFRの安定、有意な腎毒性の所見なしが示された。しかし、これらの試験はeGFR、アルブミン尿、腎不全進行などの腎転帰を評価する目的で設計・パワー計算されておらず、高度CKD患者が過小代表または除外されていた。現在、動脈硬化とCKDを併せ持つ患者における腎・心血管転帰を評価する試験が進行中である。
items.key_takeaway_ja: OrforglipronのPhase 3試験ではeGFRの安定と有意な腎毒性の欠如が示されたが、腎転帰を評価する目的で設計・パワー計算された試験ではなかった。高度CKD患者が過小代表または除外されており、CKD特異的な試験が安全・有効性の確認に不可欠である。
items.why_matters_ja: Orforglipronは肝代謝を主とし腎排泄が最小限であるため、CKD患者への適用が理論的に有望であるが、現在のところ腎転帰を評価する十分なパワーを持つ試験が欠如しており、腎科治療アルゴリズムへの統合可否は未確定である。
items.study_type_ja: Review（文献レビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: Phase 3試験で評価された転帰：ヘモグロビンA1c、体重、心血管リスクマーカー、eGFR。レビューで言及された未評価の腎転帰：eGFR、アルブミン尿、腎不全進行。
items.endpoint_results_ja: Phase 3試験でヘモグロビンA1c、体重、心血管リスクマーカーの有意な低下、eGFRの安定、有意な腎毒性の所見なしが報告された（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: Semaglutide and Tirzepatide for the treatment of MASH: What Works, What's Coming, and What's Missing.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and its progressive form, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), are increasingly prevalent conditions closely linked to obesity, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic diseases. Although lifestyle modification remains the cornerstone of management, it frequently fails to achieve sustained histologic improvement, suggesting that patients require effective pharmacologic therapies.
SUMMARY: Incretin-based treatments, including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and newer dual agonists additionally targeting glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP), have emerged as promising disease-modifying options. These agents improve hepatic steatosis primarily through weight reduction and enhanced insulin sensitivity, while also exerting pleiotropic effects on inflammation, and lipid metabolism. Phase 2 clinical trials consistently demonstrate improvement in steatohepatitis with GLP-1 receptor agonists, with encouraging signals of fibrosis improvement observed with dual agonists such as tirzepatide. Interim data from a phase 3 clinical trial with semaglutide show clinically meaningful benefits in both MASH resolution and fibrosis regression. These findings have led to accelerated regulatory approval of semaglutide for the treatment of non-cirrhotic MASH with stage F2-F3 fibrosis. In addition to hepatic effects, incretin-based therapies provide substantial cardiometabolic benefits, reinforcing their relevance in a disease strongly associated with cardiovascular risk.
KEY MESSAGES: Overall, mono- and dual-incretin agonist therapies represent a significant advance in the treatment landscape of MASLD/MASH, although long-term outcome data are required to confirm durability, safety, and impact on major adverse liver-related outcomes.
items.authors: Chirapongsathorn Sakkarin, Tacke Frank
items.summary_ja: MASLD/MASHは肥満・インスリン抵抗性・心代謝疾患と密接に関連する増加傾向にある疾患であり、生活習慣改善だけでは持続的な組織学的改善が得られないことが多い。本レビューは、GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIPを併用標的とするデュアルアゴニスト（tirzepatideなど）を含むインクレチン系治療のMASHに対する有効性を概観する。Phase 2試験ではGLP-1受容体作動薬によるsteatohepatitisの改善が一貫して示され、tirzepatideでは線維化改善の有望なシグナルが観察された。SemaglutideのPhase 3試験の中間データでは、MASHの解決と線維化の回帰の両方に臨床的に有意な効果が示され、非肝硬変性MASH（F2-F3線維化）に対するsemaglutideの加速承認に至った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: モノインクレチンおよびデュアルインクレチンアゴニスト療法はMASLD/MASHの治療において重要な進歩を代表するが、耐久性・安全性・主要肝関連不良転帰への影響を確認するには長期アウトカムデータが必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: MASHは増加傾向にあり、生活習慣改善だけでは不十分な場合が多い。インクレチン系療法は肝臓効果に加え、心血管リスクと強く関連する疾患において心代謝面でも有意な利益を提供するため、臨床的に重要な治療選択肢となる。
items.study_type_ja: Review
items.endpoints_ja: MASHの解決（resolution）、線維化の回帰（fibrosis regression）、肝脂肪症（steatosis）の改善、主要肝関連不良転帰（major adverse liver-related outcomes）

items.title: Impact of nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonism on cardiorenal outcomes in diabetic kidney disease: a systematic review.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a major complication of type 2 diabetes and a leading cause of kidney failure and cardiovascular death. This review evaluated the cardiorenal effects and safety of nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs), particularly finerenone, in DKD.
METHODS: PubMed, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched through October 2024 for randomized controlled trials and prospective studies in adults with DKD. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Because eligible analyses were derived predominantly from the same two parent trials, quantitative pooling was avoided to prevent double-counting of participants.
RESULTS: Seven analyses from the FIDELITY programme (FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD), representing 13,026 unique participants, were included. Finerenone reduced composite renal outcomes by 23% (HR 0.77, 95% CI 0.67-0.88) and cardiovascular outcomes by 14% (HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.78-0.95). Over approximately three years, absolute risk reductions were 1.6% for the kidney composite (5.5% vs 7.1%; NNT ≈60) and 1.7% for the cardiovascular composite (12.7% vs 14.4%). Benefits were generally consistent across subgroups and accompanied by reduced albuminuria and slower eGFR decline. Hyperkalemia was more frequent with finerenone (14.0% vs 6.9%) but rarely resulted in discontinuation (1.7% vs 0.6%).
CONCLUSION: Finerenone provides meaningful cardiorenal protection in DKD with a manageable safety profile. However, evidence is largely limited to finerenone within a single trial programme; therefore, these findings should not be generalized to the entire nonsteroidal MRA class.
items.authors: Musa Rabih Maram Rabih, Gharbawi Sara Elsayed Saeed, Mohamed Abdalla Samih Abdelmutalab, Suliman Said Amal Abdallah, Abdelmajed Ahmed Amel Babekir, Elsamani Elkhansaa Ali Elsheikh Mohamed, Mahmoud Hussein Alaa Abuagla
items.summary_ja: 糖尿病性腎症（DKD）における非ステロイド性鉱質コルチコイド受容体拮抗薬（特にフィネレノン）の心腎保護効果と安全性を評価した系統的レビュー。PubMed、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science、ClinicalTrials.govを2024年10月まで検索し、DKD成人を対象としたランダム化比較試験と前向き研究を対象とした。FIDELITYプログラム（FIDELIO-DKDとFIGARO-DKD）の7つの解析、13,026名のユニーク参加者が含まれた。同一の親試験から派生した解析が主体であったため、被験者の二重カウントを避ける目的で定量プーリングは行われなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンはDKDにおいて有意な心腎保護効果を示すが、高カリウム血症の頻度増加を伴う。ただし、証拠は単一の試験プログラム内のフィネレノンに限定されるため、非ステロイド性MRAクラス全体への一般化はできない。
items.why_matters_ja: DKDは2型糖尿病の主要な合併症であり、腎不全および心血管死の主要な原因である。フィネレノンは複合腎事象を23%、心血管事象を14%減少させ、DKD患者の心腎予後改善に寄与する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 系統的レビュー（ランダム化比較試験および前向き研究を対象）
items.endpoints_ja: 複合腎事象、複合心血管事象、アルブミン尿、eGFR減少速度、高カリウム血症、高カリウム血症による中止

items.title: Current and forthcoming pharmacotherapies for adolescent obesity: Evidence-based review.
items.abstract: The prevalence of adolescent obesity has increased substantially in recent decades. This disease affects more than 20% of young people. Obesity is associated with metabolic disorders and heart disease. Conservative treatments are not effective in severe obesity. Therefore, this minireview aims to compare and clarify the effectiveness of treatments. It also seeks to identify areas requiring attention to guide clinical practice and future research. A literature search was conducted in databases including PubMed and Scopus. The study focused on randomised trials and meta-analyses in patients aged 12 to 18 years and lasting more than 12 weeks. The results show an improvement induced by glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists, such as semaglutide. Semaglutide reduces body mass index by 16.1%. It is more effective than liraglutide in improving insulin sensitivity. The use of these drugs faces challenges, such as cost. There are also social inequalities that affect health equity. Although no short-term safety issues have been reported, there is still little information available on Tirzepatide and CagriSema in adolescents, compared to their known effect on adults. Therefore, we conclude that semaglutide is the current gold standard, but that there is an urgent need for longer-term studies, comparative evaluations, and safety trials that include paediatric cohorts in order to ensure safe access to pharmacological innovations.
items.authors: Fuentes-Mendoza Jenyfer M, Concepción-Zavaleta Marcio J, Dongo-Dueñas Luisa Graciela, Jara-Pianto Jose Mariano J, Sierra-Martel Jhosmar Angel, Medina-Angulo Claudio Aldahir, Virú-Flores Horus Michael, Mendoza-Godoy Jeny J
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、12〜18歳の思春期肥満を対象とした無作為化試験およびメタ解析をレビューしたミニレビューである。PubMedおよびScopusを用いた文献検索により、治療の有効性を比較・明確化することを目的とした。結果として、セマグルチドなどのGLP-1受容体作動薬による改善が示され、セマグルチドはBMIを16.1%減少させ、リラグルチドよりインスリン感受性の改善に優れていた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 思春期肥満に対する現在のゴールドスタンダードはセマグルチドであるが、小児コホートを含む長期研究、比較評価、安全性試験の緊急な実施が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（セマグルチド、リラグルチド）やTirzepatide、CagriSemaなどCardio-Renal-Metabolic領域の主要な薬剤が思春期肥満で有効性を示す一方、小児コホートにおける長期安全性や比較データが不足していることを示している。
items.study_type_ja: ミニレビュー（無作為化試験およびメタ解析のレビュー）
items.endpoints_ja: BMI（体重指数）の減少、インスリン感受性の改善
items.endpoint_results_ja: セマグルチド: BMIを16.1%減少。リラグルチドよりインスリン感受性の改善に優れていた

items.title: Weight regain following discontinuation of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in adults who are overweight or obese: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aims to explore the effects of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) on weight changes and the occurrence of adverse reactions in overweight or obese adults after drug withdrawal.
METHODS: Computerized searches were conducted in evidence-based databases such as PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Scopus. The search period was from the establishment of the database to December 2025. Collect randomised controlled trials (RCTs) and controlled trials on GLP-1RAs, including tirzepatide, semaglutide, liraglutide, and dulaglutide, for the treatment of overweight or obese adult patients. The risk of bias in the included studies was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias V2.0 tool provided by the Cochrane Collaboration, and meta-analysis was performed using the R programming language.
RESULTS: A total of 699 studies were initially retrieved. Eventually, six studies involving 8,993 patients were included in the quantitative analysis, comprising 5,553 patients in the discontinuation group and 3,440 in the continued treatment group. The results of the meta-analysis showed that, compared with the continued treatment group, the weight difference in the discontinuation group was mean difference (MD) = 17.90%, 95% confidence interval (CI) [14.11-21.69], P < 0.0001. It can be seen that there was a significant rebound in weight after drug withdrawal, and there was statistical heterogeneity among the studies (P = 0.0082). Subgroup analysis further revealed that the weight rebound amplitude after discontinuation of tirzepatide was significantly higher than that of semaglutide. This result suggests that the differences in the mechanism of action of different GLP-1RAs may be the reason for the differences in weight changes after discontinuation. In addition, the percentage difference in body weight between after and before drug withdrawal was MD = 9.11%, 95% CI [7.91-10.30], P < 0.0001, further verifying the trend of weight rebound after drug withdrawal. The summary of adverse reaction reports analyzed and studied indicates that after drug withdrawal, the overall adverse reactions of patients decreased, gastrointestinal adverse reactions decreased, and the incidence of cardiovascular events was not affected by drug withdrawal.
CONCLUSION: There is a significant weight rebound phenomenon after discontinuation of GLP-1RAs, and the rebound magnitudes vary among different types of drugs. At the same time, there is a risk of adverse reactions during the use of such drugs.
items.authors: Qi Huaji, Gao Qiang, Chen Haiyan, Du Xiaodan, Pan Bobo
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（tirzepatide、semaglutide、liraglutide、dulaglutide）の投与中止後の体重変化と有害事象について、肥満・過体重成人を対象に体系的レビューとメタ分析を行った。6研究・8,993例（中止群5,553例、継続治療群3,440例）を定量分析に含めた。中止群は継続治療群と比較して体重差MD=17.90%（95%CI [14.11-21.69]、P<0.0001）で有意な体重リバウンドを認めた。サブグループ解析ではtirzepatide中止後のリバウンド幅がsemaglutideより有意に大きかった。投与中止後の有害事象は全体的に減少し、消化管有害事象も減少、心血管事象の発生率は投与中止の影響を受けなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の中止後には有意な体重リバウンドが生じ、薬剤間でリバウンドの大きさに差がある（tirzepatide > semaglutide）。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の長期使用や中止時の体重増加リスクに関する臨床判断や患者説明に直接的なエビデンスを提供する。薬剤ごとのリバウンド幅の差は、中止時の薬剤選択やフォローアップ戦略の設計に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 体系的レビュー・メタ分析
items.endpoints_ja: 中止群と継続治療群の体重差（平均差）、投与中止前後の体重パーセンテージ差、有害事象（全体的有害事象、消化管有害事象、心血管事象の発生率）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 中止群 vs 継続治療群の体重差：MD = 17.90%、95% CI [14.11-21.69]、P < 0.0001（研究間異質性 P = 0.0082）。投与中止前後の体重パーセンテージ差：MD = 9.11%、95% CI [7.91-10.30]、P < 0.0001。サブグループ解析：tirzepatide中止後のリバウンド幅はsemaglutideより有意に大。有害事象：投与中止後、全体的有害事象は減少、消化管有害事象は減少、心血管事象の発生率は投与中止の影響を受けなかった。

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Post-Bariatric Surgery (GRABS) Trial: Rationale, Design and Baseline Characteristics.
items.abstract:
AIMS: No studies have investigated the synergistic effectiveness of Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists (GLP1RAs) in patients with persistent obesity following bariatric surgery. The GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Post-Bariatric Surgery (GRABS) Trial aims to investigate the effectiveness of tirzepatide (TRZ) versus standard of care (SOC) after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) in patients with persistent obesity (body mass index [BMI] ≥ 30 kg/m2).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This randomized, open-label proof-of-concept trial compares 24 weeks of TRZ with SOC versus SOC alone after RYGB. The primary outcome is total percent weight change from baseline to 24 weeks after trial initiation. Patients aged 25-65 with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2 enroled 12 months after RYGB are randomized 1:1 to 24 weeks of TRZ or SOC. Exclusion criteria include: type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes treatment other than metformin, conversion to RYGB from prior bariatric surgery, and GLP1RA use in the past 3 months.
RESULTS: The study enroled 33 patients, with 5 withdrawals prior to completing a baseline visit, resulting in a final sample of 28 patients. The final cohort is 82% female, 75% white, median age 42.0 years, pre-surgery BMI of 48.3 kg/m2, baseline BMI at randomization of 36.0 kg/m2 and baseline weight of 95.6 kg.
CONCLUSIONS: GRABS is the first randomized trial to investigate GLP1RA effectiveness in patients with persistent obesity following RYGB, with the potential to inform synergistic adjuvant strategies to enhance surgical weight loss.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06162715.
items.authors: Samuels J M, Williams C R, Patel M B, Self W H, Funk L M, Roumie C, Spann M D, Northup C J
items.summary_ja: GRABS試験は、Roux-en-Y胃バイパス（RYGB）術後に持続性肥満（BMI≥30 kg/m2）を有する患者において、tirzepatide（TRZ）＋標準治療（SOC）とSOC単独を比較する、無作為化・オープンラベルの概念実証試験である。主要評価項目は試験開始から24週時点の体重変化率（total percent weight change）である。33名が登録され、5名がベースライン訪問前に離脱し、最終的に28名が解析対象となった。本論文は試験の背景・デザイン・ベースライン特性を報告するものである。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文はプロトコル・ベースライン特性の報告であり、有効性結果は示されていない。RYGB術後の持続性肥満患者におけるGLP1RAの効果を評価する初の無作為化試験のデザインとベースライン特性が提示された。
items.why_matters_ja: RYGB術後の持続性肥満患者におけるGLP1RAの相乗的有効性を評価した研究はこれまで存在しなかった。本試験は、外科的減量を強化する補完的戦略の根拠を提供する可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 無作為化・オープンラベル・概念実証試験（rationale, design and baseline characteristics）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：試験開始から24週時点の体重変化率（total percent weight change from baseline to 24 weeks）
items.sample_size_ja: 登録33名、ベースライン訪問前の離脱5名、最終サンプル28名

items.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients With Fabry Disease: Observations From a Federated Research Network.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIM: Fabry disease (FD) is frequently complicated by renal impairment and cardiovascular events; however, evidence on sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) in this population is scarce. Accordingly, we assessed the association between SGLT2i exposure and cardiovascular outcomes in adults with FD.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX Global Collaborative Network, including adults with Fabry disease and eGFR ≥ 20 mL/min/1.73 m2, excluding Type 1 diabetes. Patients were stratified by SGLT2 inhibitor exposure. The primary outcome was a composite of all-cause death, acute myocardial infarction and acute or acute-on-chronic heart failure at 2 and 5 years; secondary outcomes included individual components and progression to advanced kidney disease. Patients with prior non-fatal outcomes were excluded from the respective analyses. Propensity score matching (1:1) and Cox proportional hazards models were used. Sensitivity analyses included alternative follow-up periods, restriction to Fabry disease diagnosed from 2013 onwards and a stricter Fabry disease definition requiring ≥ 2 diagnoses; subgroup analyses were performed by sex and age.
RESULTS: Among 14 940 FD patients, 1028 (6.9%) had recorded exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors (mean age: 65.5 ± 12.0 years; 53.0% male), who were older and had a higher comorbidity burden and worse baseline renal profile than non-exposed patients. After PSM, 732 patients per group (exposed and non-exposed patients) were available for analysis. At 2 years, SGLT2i exposure was associated with a lower risk of the composite outcome (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.38-0.97) and all-cause death (HR 0.56; 95% CI 0.33-0.95). At 5 years, results were consistent for the composite outcome (HR 0.56; 95% CI 0.39-0.79) and all-cause death (HR 0.62; 95% CI 0.42-0.93), with reduced myocardial infarction risk (HR 0.53; 95% CI 0.30-0.90).
CONCLUSIONS: In a large real-world FD cohort, SGLT2i exposure was associated with lower cardiovascular risk and mortality, supporting further prospective investigation.
items.authors: Serio Leandra, Rossi Michele, Askarinejad Amir, Tartaglia Enrico, Bucci Tommaso, Marrone Enrica, Kalra Dinesh K, Ferri Claudio
items.summary_ja: Fabry病（FD）成人患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）曝露と心血管アウトカムの関連を評価した後方視コホート研究。TriNetX Global Collaborative Networkを用い、eGFR≥20 mL/min/1.73m2のFD成人患者（1型糖尿病除外）を対象に、SGLT2i曝露群と非曝露群を比較した。14,940例中1,028例（6.9%）がSGLT2i曝露あり、傾向スコアマッチング（1:1）後、各群732例で解析可能となった。2年・5年時点の主要複合アウトカム（全死因死亡、急性心筋梗塞、急性または急性増悪性心不全）および全死因死亡において、SGLT2i曝露群でリスク低下が認められた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 大規模な実世界FDコホートにおいて、SGLT2i曝露は心血管リスクおよび死亡率の低下と関連し、前向き研究によるさらなる検証を支持する。
items.why_matters_ja: Fabry病は腎機能障害や心血管イベントを頻繁に合併するが、この患者集団におけるSGLT2iの証拠は乏しかった。本研究は実世界データを用いてSGLT2iの心血管保護効果を示唆し、FD患者におけるSGLT2iの適応拡大や前向き試験の設計に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（TriNetX Global Collaborative Network、傾向スコアマッチング1:1、Cox比例ハザードモデル）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：全死因死亡、急性心筋梗塞、急性または急性増悪性心不全の複合（2年・5年時点）。二次アウトカム：各構成要素（全死因死亡、急性心筋梗塞、急性または急性増悪性心不全）および進行性腎疾患への進行。

items.title: A Biweekly GLP-1R Agonist Designed With Drug-Free Intervals for Enhanced Efficacy, Receptor Homeostasis and Gastrointestinal Tolerability.
items.abstract:
AIM: To develop a next-generation, longer-acting, more-clinical-benefits agonist to achieve sustained efficacy with improved tolerability.
METHODS: CT130 was designed from semaglutide. Binding affinity was validated via molecular dynamics and cellular assays. Pharmacokinetics were profiled in SD rats; metabolic efficacy was evaluated in B6/ob and DIO mice (CT130 biweekly vs semaglutide weekly). Receptor trafficking dynamics and cholesterol regulation were dissected mechanistically. Toxicology was assessed in rodents and a primate pilot study.
RESULTS: CT130 retained high GLP‑1R affinity (EC50 = 21 pM) and exhibited a prolonged half‑life (13.9 h, 1.4‑fold vs semaglutide). Biweekly CT130 outperformed weekly semaglutide in body weight reduction, glucose tolerance, TC, LDL‑C, body fat percentage and other metabolic indicators. Drug‑free intervals enabled near‑complete GLP‑1R recycling, termed "GLP‑1R recovery", preserving receptor homeostasis, whereas semaglutide drove progressive internalization. CT130 also alleviated constipation risk (increased fecal water) and uniquely lowered cholesterol by suppressing SREBP‑2, which upregulated LDLR while decoupling from PCSK9 induction, thereby promoting fecal cholesterol excretion without altering bile acid flux. No pathological changes were observed even at tens to 200 times the semaglutide dose. In monkeys, two biweekly doses induced > 10% weight loss with good safety.
CONCLUSIONS: CT130 is a safe, once biweekly preclinical candidate that incorporates drug free intervals to allow GLP 1R restore. It delivers robust, lasting metabolic benefits with improved gastrointestinal tolerability, and offering a template for next generation long acting GLP 1R agonists.
items.authors: Ding Wei, Liu Qing, Luo Qiong, Yao Xiaojun, Fan Xingxing
items.summary_ja: CT130はセマグルチドを基盤に設計された隔週投与GLP-1Rアゴニストであり、薬物フリー間隔を設けることで受容体ホメオスタシスと胃腸耐容性の向上を目的としている。分子動力学シミュレーションおよび細胞アッセイにより結合親和性（EC50 = 21 pM）を確認し、SDラットで薬物動態をプロファイリングした。B6/obマウスおよびDIOマウスにおいて、隔週CT130は週1回セマグルチドを上回る体重減少、グルコース耐性、総コレステロール（TC）、LDL-C、体脂肪率の改善を示した。薬物フリー間隔によりGLP-1Rのほぼ完全なリサイクル（「GLP-1R recovery」）が実現し、セマグルチドによる進行性内部化とは対照的であった。また、糞便水分量増加による便秘リスクの軽減、SREBP-2抑制を介したLDLRの上昇とPCSK9誘導からの解離による胆汁酸フラックス変化なしでの糞便コレステロール排泄促進も確認された。セマグルチドの10〜200倍の用量でも病理学的変化は観察されず、サルでは隔週2回投与で10%以上の体重減少と良好な安全性が示された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CT130は薬物フリー間隔を設計に組み込むことでGLP-1Rの回復を可能にし、隔週投与でセマグルチドを上回る代謝効果と胃腸耐容性の向上を同時に実現する前臨床段階の次世代GLP-1Rアゴニスト候補である。
items.why_matters_ja: 長期作用型GLP-1Rアゴニストの臨床的課題である胃腸副作用と受容体脱感作を、薬物フリー間隔という設計原理で同時に解決する新たなテンプレートを提示しており、次世代GLP-1Rアゴニスト開発の方向性を示す。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床研究（分子動力学シミュレーション、細胞アッセイ、ラット薬物動態、マウス代謝効果評価、rodentおよびサル毒性試験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少、グルコース耐性、総コレステロール（TC）、LDL-C、体脂肪率、その他の代謝指標、GLP-1Rトラフィック動態、コレステロール調節（SREBP-2、LDLR、PCSK9）、糞便水分量（便秘リスク）、安全性・毒性、サルにおける体重減少
items.endpoint_results_ja: EC50 = 21 pM；半減期 13.9 h（セマグルチド比1.4倍）；隔週CT130は週1回セマグルチドを上回る体重減少、グルコース耐性、TC、LDL-C、体脂肪率の改善（具体的な数値は記載なし）；セマグルチドの10〜200倍用量でも病理学的変化なし；サル：隔週2回投与で10%以上の体重減少、良好な安全性

items.title: Finerenone-Based Dual Versus Triple Therapy with SGLT2 Inhibitors and GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Associated Chronic Kidney Disease: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Finerenone reduces Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) risk in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM)-related chronic kidney disease (CKD). Evidence on its combined use with sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RA) in routine care remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate 6-month estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR), and adverse outcomes among adults with T2DM-related CKD receiving finerenone + SGLT2i, with or without concomitant GLP-1RA.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort evaluated electronic medical records (EMR) from a UAE-based teaching hospital (November 2023 - January 2025). Adults with T2DM-related CKD receiving finerenone for ≥6 months were categorized at initiation into dual-therapy (Finerenone+SGLT2i), and triple-therapy (Finerenone+SGLT2i+GLP-1 RA), Patients receiving finerenone + GLP-1RA alone were excluded. Outcomes were 6-months eGFR, UACR and adverse events. Via Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS), means were analysed using paired t-tests, and between-group comparisons using adjusted analysis.
FINDINGS: Eighty-three patients were included after excluding 6 patients receiving finerenone + GLP-1RA only. Within-group ln(UACR) decreased in both regimens [dual-therapy (50.6%, 28.3-65.9; P < 0.001) and triple-therapy (46.9%, 27.0-61.3; P < 0.001)]. Mean 6-month eGFR changes were variable [dual-therapy (-6.12, -10.66 to -1.59; P = 0.010) and triple-therapy (-1.49, -5.19 to +2.21; P = 0.424)]. On adjusted analysis, triple-therapy was associated with higher 6-month eGFR compared with dual therapy (+6.407 mL/min/1.73 m²; 95% CI: +0.297 to +12.52; P = 0.040), whereas for ln(UACR) was not statistically significant (-0.323; 95% CI: -0.912 to +0.266; P = 0.277). Interpretation was limited by baseline imbalance and the retrospective observational design.
IMPLICATIONS: Triple-therapy was associated with higher adjusted 6-month eGFR than dual-therapy, while UACR decreased without significant adjusted between-group differences. Findings were interpreted as associative rather than comparative superiority, given the observational design, baseline imbalance, and short follow-up. These results should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating associations, and future multicenter longitudinal studies with longer follow-up and assessment of medication continuation, and time-updated exposure are warranted.
