items.title: Prognostic impact of an extravascular congestion score and its interaction with SGLT2 inhibitor therapy in patients hospitalized for acute heart failure.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION AND OBJECTIVES: Congestion is the main driver of hospitalization and adverse outcomes in acute heart failure (AHF), with tissue-predominant volume expansion frequently persisting despite loop diuretic therapy. We evaluated whether an extravascular congestion score (ECS) identifies high-risk patients and modifies the prognostic effect of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i).
METHODS: We prospectively studied 821 patients hospitalized for AHF. ECS at discharge was defined as the sum of 3 variables: antigen carbohydrate 125 > 35 U/mL, peripheral edema, and pleural effusion (range 0-3). The primary endpoint was a composite of all-cause mortality or heart failure rehospitalization at 1 year. Multivariable Cox models assessed associations between ECS and outcomes and tested the interaction with SGLT2i use at discharge.
RESULTS: During follow-up, the primary endpoint occurred in 436 patients (53.5%). Higher ECS was associated with a stepwise increase in risk. Compared with ECS 0, adjusted HRs were 1.72 (95%CI, 1.04-2.85; P = .034) for ECS 1 and 2.39 (95%CI, 1.29-4.43; P = .006) for ECS 2. A significant interaction was observed between ECS and SGLT2i use (P for interaction = .029). SGLT2i use was not associated with improved outcomes in ECS 0 (HR, 1.21; P = .462) but was associated with numerically lower risk in ECS 1 (HR, 0.76; P = .065), and with a marked risk reduction in ECS 2 (HR, 0.45; P = .003).
CONCLUSIONS: ECS identifies AHF patients at high risk due to residual tissue congestion. The association between SGLT2i use and improved outcomes was more pronounced with increasing extravascular congestion burden.
items.authors: Llàcer Pau, Pisón Esteban Pérez, Croset François, Nieva Alberto Pérez, Campos Jorge, Melero Marina García, Pérez Carlos, Vergara Marina
items.summary_ja: 急性心不全（AHF）で入院した821例を前向きに観察し、退院時の血管外うっ血スコア（ECS：抗原炭水化物125＞35 U/mL、末梢浮腫、胸水の3項目の合計、範囲0-3）が1年後の全死因死亡または心不全再入院の複合エンドポイントに与える影響、およびSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）使用との相互作用を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ECSは残存組織うっ血による高リスクAHF患者を同定し、SGLT2i使用による予後改善の関連は血管外うっ血負荷が増すほど顕著であった（ECS 2でHR 0.45、P=.003）。
items.why_matters_ja: AHF患者の退院時のうっ血状態を簡易なスコアで定量化し、SGLT2iの予後効果の恩恵がうっ血負荷の高い患者で大きいことを示すことで、個別化治療の根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前向きコホート研究
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：1年後の全死因死亡または心不全再入院の複合エンドポイント
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要エンドポイントは436例（53.5%）で発生。ECS 0と比較して、ECS 1の調整HRは1.72（95%CI, 1.04-2.85; P=.034）、ECS 2の調整HRは2.39（95%CI, 1.29-4.43; P=.006）。ECSとSGLT2i使用の間に有意な相互作用（P for interaction = .029）。SGLT2i使用はECS 0では予後改善と関連しなかった（HR, 1.21; P=.462）が、ECS 1では数値上リスク低下（HR, 0.76; P=.065）、ECS 2では顕著なリスク低下（HR, 0.45; P=.003）と関連した。

items.title: Efficacy of Cardioprotective Drugs in Cancer Patients Receiving Anthracyclines: A Pairwise Meta-Analysis and Network Meta-Analysis.
items.abstract: Anthracyclines are cornerstone chemotherapeutic agents for several cancers but carry a substantial risk of cardiotoxicity. Multiple cardioprotective drugs have been investigated to prevent cardiac dysfunction in patients receiving anthracycline-based chemotherapy. This study evaluated and ranked the cardioprotective effects of these agents using network meta-analysis. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Cochrane, Scopus, and Web of Science from inception to September 22, 2024 identified randomized clinical trials and cohort studies assessing cardioprotective agents in cancer patients treated with anthracyclines. Interventions included angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEIs), angiotensin receptor blockers, beta-blockers, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, statins, sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, and metformin. The primary outcome was change in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). Secondary outcomes were left ventricular end-diastolic diameter (LVEDD), chemotherapy-related cardiac dysfunction (CTRCD), heart failure (HF), HF hospitalization, and all-cause mortality. Thirty-five studies were included, comprising 31 randomized controlled trials and 4 retrospective studies. Overall, cardioprotective therapy significantly improved LVEF, reduced CTRCD, all-cause mortality, HF incidence, and LVEDD, but had no significant effect on HF hospitalization. Subgroup and network meta-analyses showed that ACEIs plus beta-blockers, beta-blockers alone, statins, and ACEIs significantly improved LVEF versus controls, with ACEIs ranking highest. For CTRCD prevention, statins and beta-blockers significantly reduced risk, whereas ACEIs plus beta-blockers had the most favorable ranking. For mortality, the available retrospective SGLT2 inhibitor studies suggested an association with lower risk; however, because no randomized anthracycline-specific SGLT2 inhibitor trials were available and follow-up duration differed from the RCT evidence for other agents, this finding should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than definitive comparative evidence. ACEIs, beta-blockers, and statins appear effective for preserving cardiac function during anthracycline therapy. Treatment rankings, particularly for outcomes supported by sparse or observational evidence, should be interpreted cautiously, and further randomized trials are needed, particularly to evaluate SGLT2 inhibitors.
items.authors: Maliha Maisha, Satish Vikyath, Kumar Sriram Sunil, Nandy Sneha, Kharawala Amrin, Gonzales-Uribe Antony, Li Wing Fai, Kaushik Sharanya
items.summary_ja: アンササイクリン系抗がん剤による心毒性を予防する目的で、ACE阻害薬（ACEI）、アンジオテンシン受容体拮抗薬（ARB）、β遮断薬、鉱質コルチコイド受容体拮抗薬、スタチン、SGLT2阻害薬、メトホルミンの心保護効果をネットワークメタ解析により評価・順位付けした。PubMed、Cochrane、Scopus、Web of Scienceから2024年9月22日までに公開された無作為化臨床試験およびコホート研究を包括的に検索し、35研究（無作為化対照試験31件、後方視的コホート研究4件）を包含した。主要評価項目は左室駆出率（LVEF）の変化、副次評価項目は左室拡張期末径（LVEDD）、化学療法関連心機能障害（CTRCD）、心不全（HF）、HF入院、全死因死亡率であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ACEI＋β遮断薬、β遮断薬単独、スタチン、ACEIが対照群と比較してLVEFの改善に有意な効果を示し、ACEIが最も高い順位であった。CTRCD予防ではスタチンとβ遮断薬が有意にリスクを低減し、ACEI＋β遮断薬が最も有利な順位であった。SGLT2阻害薬の死亡率低減効果は後方視的研究からの仮説生成レベルの知見にとどまる。
items.why_matters_ja: アンササイクリン系抗がん剤は複数の癌治療の基幹薬剤であるが、心毒性のリスクが大きい。本メタ解析は、複数の心保護薬の相対的な有効性をネットワークメタ解析により順位付けし、臨床現場での薬剤選択の根拠を提供する。特にACEI、β遮断薬、スタチンの有効性が示された一方、SGLT2阻害薬については無作為化試験の欠如が指摘され、今後の研究の方向性を示す点で重要である。
items.study_type_ja: ペアワイズメタ解析およびネットワークメタ解析（無作為化対照試験31件、後方視的コホート研究4件を含む35研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要評価項目：左室駆出率（LVEF）の変化。副次評価項目：左室拡張期末径（LVEDD）、化学療法関連心機能障害（CTRCD）、心不全（HF）、HF入院、全死因死亡率。

items.title: Tirzepatide Benefit for Early Glycemic and Weight Management in People with T2D in Japan: Rationale, Design, and Baseline Characteristics of T-BEAT Study.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Tirzepatide has demonstrated good efficacy and safety in the management of type 2 diabetes (T2D) in clinical trials. As the importance of early intensive intervention is known, the tirzepatide benefit for early glycemic and weight management (T-BEAT) study investigated the real-world effectiveness of tirzepatide in participants with early stage T2D in Japan.
METHODS: This in-progress, noninterventional, multicenter, observational study assesses the glycemic control of tirzepatide (5-15 mg once weekly) or oral semaglutide (7-14 mg once daily) in participants with T2D who were naive to oral antidiabetes drugs (OADs) (diet and exercise only) or received OAD monotherapy, excluding oral semaglutide. The primary endpoint is the mean change in glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) from baseline after up to 12 months of treatment. Patient-reported treatment satisfaction and other secondary endpoints are also being investigated. Baseline characteristics of the participants are reported.
RESULTS: In the tirzepatide group (N = 290), mean participant age was 55.2 (standard deviation [SD] 13.4) years, 45.2% were female, and the mean body weight, body mass index (BMI), and baseline HbA1c were 79.6 (SD 13.2) kg, 29.3 (SD 3.5) kg/m2, and 8.0% (SD 0.8), respectively. In the oral semaglutide group (N = 279), the mean participant age was 58.8 (SD 13.3) years, 35.5% were female, and the mean body weight, BMI, and baseline HbA1c were 77.2 (SD 12.3) kg, 28.2 (SD 3.0) kg/m2, and 7.8% (SD 0.7), respectively. In both groups, dyslipidemia was the most common comorbidity (62.1% and 67.7%); 40.7% and 38.0% of participants, respectively, concomitantly used OADs; and sodium glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors and biguanides were the most common OADs.
CONCLUSIONS: The T-BEAT study assesses the real-world effectiveness of tirzepatide over a 12-month treatment period in participants with early stage T2D. This study's results are expected to provide valuable information to physicians, enabling them to make informed decisions in routine clinical practice.
items.journal: Diabetes therapy : research, treatment and education of diabetes and related disorders
items.authors: Waki Hironori, Kagitani Hideaki, Osaga Satoshi, Inoue Mariko, Yabe Daisuke
items.summary_ja: T-BEAT研究は、日本の早期T2D患者におけるtirzepatide（5-15 mg 週1回）またはoral semaglutide（7-14 mg 毎日1回）のリアルワールド有効性を評価する、進行中の非介入型多施設観察研究である。本論文は研究の根拠、デザイン、およびベースライン特性を報告する。対象はOAD未使用（食事・運動のみ）またはOAD単剤療法（oral semaglutideを除く）のT2D患者。主要エンドポイントは治療開始後最大12ヶ月のHbA1cのベースラインからの平均変化。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 本研究は進行中の観察研究であり、本論文ではベースライン特性のみが報告されている。主要エンドポイント（HbA1c変化）の結果は未報告である。
items.why_matters_ja: 早期T2D患者におけるtirzepatideのリアルワールド有効性データを日本から提供し、臨床現場での治療判断に有用な情報を与えることが期待される。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：治療開始後最大12ヶ月のHbA1cのベースラインからの平均変化。二次エンドポイント：患者報告の治療満足度およびその他。

items.title: Association of Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide with Risk of Asthma Exacerbation in Patients with Asthma and Type 2 Diabetes: A US Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: While glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) show promise in improving respiratory outcomes, the comparative effectiveness of dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide/GLP-1 RA versus GLP-1 RA alone remains unclear.
OBJECTIVE: To assess the association of tirzepatide versus semaglutide with the risk of asthma exacerbation among patients with asthma and type 2 diabetes (T2D).
METHODS: Data from the TriNetX US Collaborative Network were used. Adults with asthma and T2D who initiated tirzepatide or semaglutide between June 01, 2022, and December 31, 2024, were included. The study period ended on December 1, 2025. The primary outcome was time to first asthma exacerbation over a 12-month follow-up. Secondary outcomes included systemic corticosteroid and short-acting beta-agonist (SABA) use. Propensity score matching was used to balance baseline covariates. Kaplan-Meier curves and Cox regression models were used to estimate comparative effectiveness.
RESULTS: After 1:1 matching, 8176 patients were included in each group. The risk of asthma exacerbation was similar between tirzepatide and semaglutide (11.0% vs 11.1%; HR, 1.00; 95% CI, 0.91-1.10). This finding remained consistent across sensitivity and subgroup analyses. For secondary outcomes, tirzepatide was associated with a lower risk of SABA use (HR, 0.92; 95% CI, 0.88-0.96) and a similar risk of systemic corticosteroid use (HR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.96-1.05) compared with semaglutide.
CONCLUSION: Among patients with asthma and T2D, no difference in the risk of asthma exacerbation between tirzepatide and semaglutide was observed. Further investigation through randomized controlled trials is warranted to clarify the potential role of GLP-1 RA-based therapies in patients with asthma and T2D.
items.authors: Hung Chun-Tse, An Chen-Yen, Suk Chi-Won, Lee Ting-Wei, Hung Shun-Hsing
items.summary_ja: 米国のTriNetX共同ネットワークデータを用いた多施設後ろ向きコホート研究。喘息と2型糖尿病を併せ持ち、2022年6月1日から2024年12月31日の間にtirzepatideまたはsemaglutideを新規開始した成人を対象とした。傾向スコアマッチング（1:1）により各群8,176例を解析し、12ヶ月間の初回喘息増悪までの時間を主評価項目、全身性コルチコステロイド使用と短時間作用型β2刺激薬（SABA）使用を副次評価項目として比較した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 喘息と2型糖尿病を併せ持つ患者において、tirzepatideとsemaglutideの間で喘息増悪リスクに有意な差は認められなかった（HR 1.00; 95% CI 0.91-1.10）。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は呼吸器アウトカムの改善に期待されているが、GIP/GLP-1二重作動薬（tirzepatide）とGLP-1単独作動薬（semaglutide）の比較効果は不明であった。本研究は実世界データに基づく比較効果の証拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 米国の多施設後ろ向きコホート研究（TriNetX US Collaborative Network）
items.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：12ヶ月間の初回喘息増悪までの時間。副次評価項目：全身性コルチコステロイド使用、短時間作用型β2刺激薬（SABA）使用。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 喘息増悪：tirzepatide群 11.0% vs semaglutide群 11.1%（HR 1.00; 95% CI 0.91-1.10）。SABA使用：HR 0.92; 95% CI 0.88-0.96（tirzepatideがsemaglutideより低リスク）。全身性コルチコステロイド使用：HR 1.01; 95% CI 0.96-1.05（両群で類似）。

items.title: Screening for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis in Adults with Type 2 Diabetes in the U.S. and 5 European Countries: A Cost-Utility Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Despite growing consensus of guidelines supporting screening for MASLD using non-invasive tests (NITs) in high-risk populations, access to NITs remains limited across the U.S. and E.U. Cost-effectiveness analyses of multimodal NIT strategies are needed to support implementation, address access challenges and inform coverage decisions.
METHODS: A decision-analytic Markov model was developed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of five multimodal NIT strategies for MASLD in hypothetical cohorts of patients with type 2 diabetes across six U.S. and European markets, compared with no screening; univariate and probabilistic sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess uncertainty.
RESULTS: Multi-step non-invasive screening strategies were cost-effective compared with no screening across all countries, with ICERs ranging from dominance to £18,572 per QALY gained. In Germany, France, Italy and the US, at least one strategy dominated no screening. Probabilistic sensitivity analysis demonstrated robust cost-effectiveness, with multi-step non-invasive strategies demonstrating a 90-100% probability of cost-effectiveness across countries. Screening strategies involving liver biopsy were dominated by no screening in all settings.
CONCLUSION: Multi-step non-invasive screening strategies represent a cost-effective approach to improving adherence to guideline-based MASLD care in high-risk populations. As therapeutics capable of reversing fibrosis stages enter the market, the value of screening may increase further. Future research should focus on evaluating the economic impacts of longer-term care and emerging MASH therapeutics.
IMPACT AND IMPLICATIONS: This paper uses a Markov model to evaluate five strategies for the screening and treatment of MASH in a hypothetical cohort of patients with T2DM in the UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, and the US. Despite professional guidelines recommending the use of non-invasive tests to screen and inform care delivery for patients high-risk for advanced fibrosis due to MASH, adoption and payer coverage of non-invasive tests remain limited in many markets. Clinicians, payers, and policymakers may consider the findings presented within this paper, which validate the cost-utility of guidelines-recommended non-invasive screening approaches in high-risk populations, when developing institutional protocols or coverage policies. As approved therapeutics (e.g., resmetirom, semaglutide) enter the market, the value proposition for cost-effective screening strategies will likely continue to grow.

items.summary_ja: 米国および5つの欧州諸国（英国、フランス、ドイツ、スペイン、イタリア）の2型糖尿病患者において、MASLD（代謝機能異常関連脂肪肝）のスクリーニングとして5つの多段階非侵襲的検査（NIT）戦略のコスト効果性を、スクリーニングなしと比較して評価した決定分析型Markovモデルによるコスト・ユーティリティ分析である。単変量および確率的感度分析も実施した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 多段階非侵襲的スクリーニング戦略は、すべての国においてスクリーニングなしと比較してコスト効果があり、ICERは優越（dominance）から£18,572/QALY増の範囲であった。確率的感度分析では、すべての国で90〜100%のコスト効果確率が示された。肝生検を含む戦略はすべての設定でスクリーニングなしに優越された。
items.why_matters_ja: ガイドラインは高リスク集団におけるNITによるMASLDスクリーニングを支持しているが、米国・EUにおいてNITへのアクセスは依然として限られている。本分析は、実施の推進、アクセス課題の解決、および保険適用（coverage）決定を支援する根拠を提供する。さらに、線維化を逆転させる治療薬（resmetirom、semaglutide等）が市場に登場するにつれ、スクリーニングの価値はさらに高まると考えられる。

items.title: Impact of GLP-1 Dose Intensity on Perioperative and Long-Term Fusion Outcomes Following ACDF.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND CONTEXT: High-dose glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are increasingly used for obesity management, but their perioperative safety and potential effects on fusion-related outcomes after anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) remain unclear.
PURPOSE: To compare short-term postoperative outcomes and longer-term fusion-related outcomes after ACDF among patients receiving high-dose versus standard-dose GLP-1 RA therapy.
STUDY DESIGN/SETTING: Retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX Research Network.
PATIENT SAMPLE: Adult patients undergoing ACDF were identified within TriNetX and stratified into 3 pairwise comparison groups: standard-dose GLP-1 RA versus no GLP-1 exposure, high-dose GLP-1 RA versus no GLP-1 exposure, and high-dose versus standard-dose GLP-1 RA use. A total of 112,065 patients met inclusion criteria across all 3 comparisons. In the primary dose-intensity comparison, 921 patients remained in each cohort after 1:1 propensity score matching.
OUTCOME MEASURES: Outcomes included 90-day healthcare utilization (readmission, emergency department visits, outpatient visits, physical therapy utilization), 90-day medical and acute postoperative complications, 90-day opioid exposure, and long-term fusion-related outcomes from 180 to 720 days, including pseudarthrosis and posterior cervical fusion.
METHODS: Data were queried on March 9, 2026. Adults undergoing ACDF were identified and stratified by preoperative GLP-1 RA dose intensity. Exposure was defined by recorded GLP-1 RA prescription strength from 1 year to 1 week before the index ACDF procedure. Separate 1:1 propensity score matching was performed for each pairwise comparison. Outcomes were evaluated at 1 to 90 days for healthcare utilization, short-term complications, and opioid exposure, and at 180 to 720 days for long-term fusion-related outcomes.
FUNDING/CONFLICTS OF INTEREST: No funding was received for this study. The authors report no study-specific conflicts of interest or associated biases.
RESULTS: In the primary high-dose versus standard-dose comparison, 90-day healthcare utilization was similar, including readmission (11.4% vs 10.0%; p = 0.327), emergency department visits (11.4% vs 12.3%; p = 0.564), outpatient visits (49.8% vs 52.1%; p = 0.328), and physical therapy utilization (42.0% vs 44.0%; p = 0.397). Short-term complications were also similar, including composite medical complications (9.6% vs 8.9%; p = 0.629), dysphagia (10.6% vs 11.2%; p = 0.709), hematoma (6.8% vs 6.3%; p = 0.638), dysphonia (1.8% vs 1.6%; p = 0.721), and acute respiratory failure (2.3% vs 1.7%; p = 0.406). Opioid exposure did not differ between cohorts (85.2% vs 83.1%; p = 0.202). Long-term outcomes were likewise similar, including pseudarthrosis (4.0% vs 3.8%; p = 0.822) and posterior cervical fusion (3.0% vs 3.7%; p = 0.398). Compared with matched non-users, both standard-dose and high-dose GLP-1 RA users had lower pseudarthrosis rates, although no additional long-term benefit was observed with higher-dose therapy.
CONCLUSIONS: High-dose GLP-1 RA therapy was not associated with increased short-term healthcare utilization, postoperative complications, opioid exposure, or long-term fusion-related risk after ACDF compared with standard-dose therapy. These findings provide reassurance that higher-dose GLP-1 regimens do not appear to confer excess perioperative or fusion-related risk in this population.

items.summary_ja: TriNetX研究ネットワークを用いた後ろ向きコホート研究であり、前頸部椎間板摘出術併用固定術（ACDF）を受けた成人患者において、高用量GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）と標準用量GLP-1 RAの術前後の転帰を比較した。1:1プロパティスコアマッチング後、主比較（高用量 vs 標準用量）では各コホート921例が解析対象となった。90日間の医療利用（再入院、救急外来受診、外来受診、理学療法利用）、90日間の医学的・急性術後合併症、90日間のオピオイド曝露、および180〜720日の長期融合関連転帰（偽関節、後方頸部固定術）を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ACDF後、高用量GLP-1 RA療法は標準用量療法と比較して、90日間の医療利用、術後合併症、オピオイド曝露、長期融合関連リスクのいずれにおいても有意な増加とは関連しなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 高用量GLP-1 RAは肥満管理にますます使用されているが、ACDFにおける術前後の安全性および融合関連転帰への影響は不明であった。本結果は、高用量GLP-1レジメンがこの患者集団において術前後または融合関連の過剰リスクをもたらさないことを示し、手術計画時の安心材料となる。

items.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists vs DPP-4 inhibitors and neuropathic complications in type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy is a debilitating complication of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) associated with foot ulceration, amputation, Charcot neuroarthropathy, and reduced quality of life. Although glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitors are widely used therapies for T2DM, their comparative effects on neuropathy-related lower-extremity complications remain unclear.
OBJECTIVE: To compare diabetic foot ulcers, lower-extremity amputations, foot/ankle osteomyelitis, Charcot neuroarthropathy, and all-cause mortality in T2DM patients with neuropathy treated with GLP-1 RAs versus DPP-4 inhibitors.
METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network, we identified adults with T2DM and diabetic neuropathy, unspecified (ICD-10-CM E11.40), initiating either a GLP-1 RA or a DPP-4 inhibitor. After exclusions and 1:1 propensity score matching for demographics, comorbidities, and medications, 19,770 patients per cohort were balanced. Outcomes were assessed over 1 year and 2 years using Kaplan-Meier and Cox proportional hazards models, with Bonferroni correction (p < 0.01).
RESULTS: After matching, GLP-1 RAs were associated with a 1-year lower risk of diabetic foot ulcers (2.2% vs 2.7%; HR 0.813, 95% CI 0.716-0.922) and lower all-cause mortality, though the mortality finding was interpreted as hypothesis-generating. Amputation (0.5% vs 0.5%; HR 1.073, 95% CI 0.810-1.421) and foot/ankle osteomyelitis (0.4% vs 0.4%; HR 0.978, 95% CI 0.708-1.349) rates were similar. Charcot neuroarthropathy incidence was higher with GLP-1 RAs (0.3% vs 0.2%; HR 1.993, 95% CI 1.297-3.064).
DISCUSSION: In T2DM patients with neuropathy, GLP-1 RA therapy was associated with lower risk of diabetic foot ulcers and higher Charcot neuroarthropathy risk compared with DPP-4 inhibitors, while amputation and osteomyelitis risks were similar. These findings support further study of GLP-1 RAs in this population and highlight the need for careful foot monitoring during therapy.
items.authors: Tawfik Fady, Yalley Eric, Sienkaniec Justyna, Mendoza Marshall, Bhatia Ronak, Boulis Michael, Hashmi Humzah, Mohamed Khalid
items.summary_ja: TriNetX US Collaborative Networkを用いた観察研究であり、2型糖尿病（T2DM）かつ糖尿病性神経障害（ICD-10-CM E11.40）を有し、GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）またはDPP-4阻害薬を新規に開始した成人を対象とした。人口統計、合併症、併用薬について1:1プロパensityスコアマッチングを行い、コホートごとに19,770例を均衡させた。1年および2年間の糖尿病性足潰瘍、下肢切断、足/足関節骨髄炎、Charcot神経性関節症、全死因死亡率をKaplan-Meier法およびCox比例ハザードモデル（Bonferroni補正、p<0.01）で比較した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: T2DM合併糖尿病性神経障害患者において、GLP-1 RAはDPP-4阻害薬と比較して糖尿病性足潰瘍のリスクが低かった（1年：2.2% vs 2.7%；HR 0.813, 95% CI 0.716-0.922）一方、Charcot神経性関節症のリスクが高かった（0.3% vs 0.2%；HR 1.993, 95% CI 1.297-3.064）。切断および骨髄炎のリスクは両群で同程度であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 糖尿病性末梢神経障害は足潰瘍、切断、Charcot神経性関節症、QOL低下と関連する重大な合併症であり、GLP-1 RAとDPP-4阻害薬の神経障害関連下肢合併症への比較的影響は不明であった。本結果はGLP-1 RA使用该集団におけるさらなる研究の必要性と、治療中の慎重な足モニタリングの重要性を示唆する。

items.title: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Malnutrition and Metabolic Failure in High-Potency Incretin Therapy.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: High-potency incretin therapy achieved substantial weight loss, but the extreme energy deficits it induced may obscure the underlying nutritional deterioration. This meta-analysis synthesized data from 19 randomized trials across the SURMOUNT, STEP, SCALE, and OASIS programs to quantify the nutritional and body composition consequences of these agents in adults with obesity.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis followed PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane RoB2 tool, and certainty of evidence was rated using the GRADE approach. Continuous outcomes were pooled using mean differences within a random-effects model.
RESULTS: Daily energy intake declined by 24.00%-39.20% across drug classes, with model-estimated daily deficits reaching 1200 kcal. Tirzepatide 15 mg was associated with a mean fat-free mass (FFM) reduction of 1.60 kg, representing 2.80% of body weight. Investigator-reported malnutrition occurred in only 0.12% of participants. Objective laboratory screening identified low total lymphocyte counts below 910 per microliter in 2.90% of active-therapy participants, nearly double the 1.77% in placebo arms, indicating that standard adverse event reporting underestimates true nutritional risk. Pancreatic lipase increased by a mean of 31% in the SCALE program, representing a secondary metabolic signal.
CONCLUSIONS: Given these findings, a Tiered Stepped-Care Algorithm is proposed, mandating baseline screening of albumin and total lymphocyte count, periodic monitoring at weeks 12, 24, and 52, and defined intervention thresholds to prevent sarcopenia and frailty, particularly in adults aged 65 years and older.
items.authors: Ampofo Eugene, Apprey Charles, Amoako Mary, Turkson Fiifi Derrick
items.summary_ja: 高用量インクレチン療法（SURMOUNT、STEP、SCALE、OASISプログラムの19件のランダム化試験）における栄養状態および体組成への影響を定量化したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。PRISMA 2020ガイドラインに従い、Cochrane RoB2ツールでバイアスリスクを評価し、GRADEアプローチでエビデンスの確実性を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 調査員報告の栄養失調は参加者の0.12%にしか見られなかったが、客観的な検査スクリーニングでは活性療法群で総リンパ球数910/μL未満が2.90%に認められ、プラセボ群の1.77%のほぼ2倍であった。標準的な有害事象報告は真の栄養リスクを過小評価している。
items.why_matters_ja: 高用量インクレチン療法は大幅な減量をもたらすが、それに伴う極端なエネルギー欠乏が潜在的な栄養状態の悪化を隠蔽する可能性がある。標準的な有害事象報告では栄養リスクが過小評価されるため、段階的ステップケアアルゴリズム（ベースラインスクリーニング、週12・24・52での定期モニタリング、介入閾値の定義）の提案が臨床的に重要である。

items.title: Circadian reprogramming of inflammation and metabolism in chronic kidney disease.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is driven by inflammation, fibrosis, and metabolic dysfunction. While circadian rhythm dysregulation is well documented in chronic disorders, its specific impact on CKD pathogenesis remains elusive.
METHODS: We performed four-hour interval time-series RNA sequencing on renal tissues from control and CKD mice. We used the JTK_CYCLE algorithm to identify rhythmic genes and categorize them as lost, acquired, or sustained in CKD; we subsequently performed focused bioinformatic analyses.
RESULTS: The renal circadian profile was substantially altered; acquired rhythmicity emerged as the dominant pattern, and core clock gene expression was disrupted. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analysis revealed that upregulated acquired-rhythmic genes in CKD were enriched in immune-inflammatory pathways; the expression of these genes peaked at Zeitgeber time (ZT) 12-16, consistent with a higher level of renal macrophage infiltration at ZT16 than at ZT0. Conversely, genes associated with nutrient and energy metabolism pathways were downregulated but acquired rhythmicity in CKD. Dapagliflozin improved renal function and restored the circadian expression rhythms of NR1D1 and p-BMAL1.
CONCLUSIONS: CKD profoundly remodels the renal circadian transcriptome, driving immune-inflammatory and metabolic pathways into maladaptive rhythmicity. Furthermore, dapagliflozin can partially restore the expression of renal core clock genes.
items.authors: Li Xiao-Qian, Cheng Lei, Chen Tian-Fen, Ma Yi-Nuo, Li Xiao-Hui, Fu Ting-Yu, Xiao Jing, Zhao Zhan-Zheng
mesh_terms: Nuclear Receptor Subfamily 1, Group D, Member 1
items.summary_ja: CKDマウスの腎組織に対して4時間間隔の時間系列RNAシーケンシングを行い、JTK_CYCLEアルゴリズムを用いてCKDにおけるリズム遺伝子の喪失・獲得・維持を分類した。CKDでは獲得リズムが支配的なパターンであり、核心時計遺伝子の発現が破壊されていた。KEGG解析により、CKDで発現上昇した獲得リズム遺伝子は免疫・炎症経路に富み、ZT12-16にピークを示した。一方、栄養・エネルギー代謝経路関連遺伝子は発現低下しながらもリズムを獲得していた。Dapagliflozinは腎機能を改善し、NR1D1およびp-BMAL1の概日発現リズムを回復させた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CKDは腎概日トランスクリプトームを大きく再編成し、免疫・炎症経路および代謝経路を不適応的なリズムに駆動する。Dapagliflozinは腎核心時計遺伝子の発現を部分的に回復させる。
items.why_matters_ja: CKDにおける概日リズムの再プログラミングを解明することで、CKDの炎症・線維化・代謝異常の病態機序に対する新たな治療標的の発見に寄与する可能性がある。

items.title: Dapagliflozin as an adjunct to insulin improves glycemic control, weight, and lipid profile with a superior safety profile in type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the efficacy and safety of dapagliflozin-insulin combination in patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM).
METHODS: In this 3-month, randomized controlled trial, 86 T2DM patients were allocated to either insulin monotherapy (Group A) or dapagliflozin-insulin combination (Group B). Primary endpoints included glycemic control (Fasting Blood Glucose [FBG], 2-hour Postprandial Blood Glucose [2hPBG], Hemoglobin A1c [HbA1c]), lipid profile (Total Cholesterol [TC], Triglycerides [TG], Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol [LDL-C], High-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol [HDL-C]), anthropometrics (Body Mass Index [BMI], Body Weight [BW]), blood pressure (Systolic Blood Pressure [SBP], Diastolic Blood Pressure [DBP]), and adverse events.
RESULTS: After treatment, the combination therapy (Group B) demonstrated significantly greater improvements than insulin alone (Group A). Reductions in Group B versus Group A were: HbA1c (24.9%vs. 10.3%), FBG (23.6%vs. 5.6%), 2hPBG (25.1%vs. 13.7%), TC (35.1%vs. 16.9%), TG (15.9%vs. 11.0%), LDL-C (15.7%vs. 6.5%), SBP (7.3%vs. 3.2%), DBP (12.6%vs. 7.8%), BMI (9.8%vs. 4.3%), and BW (5.4%vs. 3.3%); while HDL-C increased more in Group B (16.3%vs. 9.9%). Group B demonstrated superior benefits in glycemic control, lipid profile, anthropometrics parameters and blood pressure reductions. All post-treatment between-group comparisons were statistically significant (p < 0.05). Critically, the incidence of adverse events was 71.4% lower in Group B, a statistically significant difference (p = 0.007).
CONCLUSIONS: Dapagliflozin as an adjunct to insulin provides superior multi-faceted metabolic benefits encompassing glycemic control, weight reduction, lipid improvement, and blood pressure lowering, coupled with a more favorable safety profile, supporting its inclusion in standard insulin regimens for T2DM.
items.authors: Sun Lili, Liu Guiling, Liang Baozhong, You Houmei
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者86名を対象に、インスリン単独療法（Group A）とダパグリフロジン＋インスリン併用療法（Group B）を比較した3ヶ月間のランダム化比較試験。血糖コントロール（FBG、2hPBG、HbA1c）、脂質プロファイル（TC、TG、LDL-C、HDL-C）、身体計測（BMI、体重）、血圧（SBP、DBP）、有害事象を主要評価項目として検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ダパグリフロジンのインスリン併用は、インスリン単独療法と比較して血糖コントロール、体重減少、脂質改善、血圧低下の多面的な代謝的優位性を示し、有害事象の発生率も71.4%低く（p=0.007）、より良好な安全性プロファイルを示した。
items.why_matters_ja: ダパグリフロジンのインスリン併用がT2DMにおける標準的インスリンレジメンへの組み入れを支持する根拠を提供する。多面的な代謝的有益性と安全性の両面で優位性を示したことは、臨床実践における治療戦略の選択肢を広げる意義を持つ。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（3ヶ月間）
items.endpoints_ja: 血糖コントロール（FBG、2hPBG、HbA1c）、脂質プロファイル（TC、TG、LDL-C、HDL-C）、身体計測（BMI、体重）、血圧（SBP、DBP）、有害事象
items.endpoint_results_ja: Group B（併用療法）vs Group A（インスリン単独）の減少率：HbA1c（24.9% vs 10.3%）、FBG（23.6% vs 5.6%）、2hPBG（25.1% vs 13.7%）、TC（35.1% vs 16.9%）、TG（15.9% vs 11.0%）、LDL-C（15.7% vs 6.5%）、SBP（7.3% vs 3.2%）、DBP（12.6% vs 7.8%）、BMI（9.8% vs 4.3%）、体重（5.4% vs 3.3%）。HDL-CはGroup Bでより増加（16.3% vs 9.9%）。有害事象の発生率はGroup Bで71.4%低く（p=0.007）。全群間比較は統計的に有意（p<0.05）。
items.sample_size_ja: T2DM患者86名（Group A：インスリン単独療法、Group B：ダパグリフロジン＋インスリン併用療法。各群の具体的な人数は抄録に記載なし）

items.title: Primary Care Recognition of Rabson-Mendenhall Syndrome Despite Absence of Classical Diabetic Symptoms.
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Rabson-Mendenhall syndrome (RMS) is an extremely rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the insulin receptor gene, leading to severe insulin resistance and compensatory hyperinsulinemia. Classical features include acanthosis nigricans, non-obese or underweight body habitus, hirsutism, dental abnormalities, dysmorphic features, and variable growth abnormalities. Early recognition may be difficult when the initial presentation is dominated by non-specific symptoms rather than classical metabolic complaints. CASE REPORT A 10-year-old Saudi girl presented to a family medicine clinic with intermittent bilateral leg pain and excessive hunger, without polyuria or polydipsia. Examination revealed extensive acanthosis nigricans, moderate hirsutism, deep voice, high-arched palate, and dental enamel defects. Laboratory evaluation showed severe hyperinsulinemia with insulin level of 3522.5 µU/mL, elevated HbA1c of 8.4% (68 mmol/mol), and biochemical hyperandrogenism. Although RMS is classically associated with growth restriction, the patient was tall for age and had a family history of tall stature, requiring cautious interpretation of growth-related findings. Whole-exome sequencing confirmed a homozygous pathogenic insulin receptor variant (c.433C>T, p.Arg145Cys), establishing the diagnosis of RMS. Treatment included vitamin D supplementation, metformin, basal-bolus insulin therapy, dapagliflozin, home glucose monitoring, diabetes education, dietary counseling, and multidisciplinary follow-up. Glycemic control remained suboptimal despite treatment intensification, reflecting the severe receptor-level insulin resistance associated with RMS. CONCLUSIONS In this patient, marked acanthosis nigricans, severe hyperinsulinemia, hyperglycemia, and hyperandrogenic features supported evaluation for a genetic insulin resistance syndrome despite the absence of classical diabetic symptoms.
items.journal: The American journal of case reports
items.authors: Al Eisa Abdullah, Aldayhani Atheer Humoud
items.summary_ja: 10歳のサウジアラビア人少女が、多尿・多飲を伴わない間歇性両側下肢痛と過剰な空腹感で一次医療クリニックを受診した。診察で広範な黒色棘皮症、中等度の多毛症、深部声、高口蓋、歯エナメル欠損を認め、検査でインスリン3522.5 µU/mL、HbA1c 8.4%（68 mmol/mol）、生化学的ハイパーアンドロゲニズムが検出された。全エクソーム解析によりインスリン受容体遺伝子のホモ接合性病的変異（c.433C>T, p.Arg145Cys）が確認され、Rabson-Mendenhall症候群（RMS）と診断された。ビタミンD補充、メトホルミン、basal-bolusインスリン療法、ダパグリフロジン、家庭血糖モニタリング、糖尿病教育、食事指導、多職種フォローアップを施行したが、治療強化後も血糖管理は不十分であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 古典的な糖尿病症状（多尿・多飲）を欠く場合でも、顕著な黒色棘皮症、重度のハイパーインスリン血症、高血糖、ハイパーアンドロゲニック所見を認める場合は、遺伝性インスリン抵抗症候群の評価を検討すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: RMSは極めて稀な常染色体劣性疾患であり、初期症状が非特異的な場合、早期認識が困難である。一次医療段階での認識が診断の早期確立に重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 症例報告
items.endpoints_ja: 血糖管理（HbA1c）、インスリン値、ハイパーアンドロゲニズム
items.endpoint_results_ja: インスリン 3522.5 µU/mL、HbA1c 8.4%（68 mmol/mol）、血糖管理は治療強化後も不十分（suboptimal）

items.title: Efficacy and Safety of Luseogliflozin (TS-071) in Japanese Children and Adolescents with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-masked, Placebo-controlled Phase 3 Study.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of luseogliflozin (TS-071), a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, in Japanese children and adolescents with type 2 diabetes (T2D).
METHODS: In this multicenter, randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial, patients aged 10-17 years with hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) levels of 7.0%-12.0%, with or without prior metformin use, were enrolled. Participants were randomized (2:1) to receive luseogliflozin 2.5 mg or placebo for 12 weeks (period I), followed by a 40-week open-label extension (period II), allowing dose escalation to 5 mg.
RESULTS: Forty-eight participants were randomized and received luseogliflozin (n = 31) or placebo (n = 17). The primary endpoint-change in HbA1c from baseline at the end of period I-was -1.45% (95% CI, -1.78% to -1.11%) in the luseogliflozin group. The between-group difference in HbA1c change was -1.76% (95% CI, -2.49% to -1.02%). Luseogliflozin maintained efficacy through 52 weeks, with a mean HbA1c change of -0.92% ± 1.74% at the end of period II. Adverse events (AEs) and adverse drug reactions (ADRs) occurred in 85.4% and 29.2% of patients, respectively. No deaths occurred; three serious AEs and one mild hypoglycemic event were reported. Urinary and genital infections were the most frequent ADRs.
CONCLUSION: Luseogliflozin significantly improved glycemic control and was well tolerated, supporting its potential as an effective and safe treatment option for children and adolescents with T2D.
items.authors: Kikuchi Toru, Nakamura Hidefumi, Umeuchi Hideo, Kitajima Iwao, Yamasaki Hironori, Urakami Tatsuhiko
items.summary_ja: 日本小児・思春期（10〜17歳）の2型糖尿病（T2D）患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬ルセオグリフロジン（TS-071）の有効性及び安全性を評価した多施設共同、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照第III相試験。HbA1c 7.0%〜12.0%の患者を2:1でルセオグリフロジン2.5 mg群またはプラセボ群に無作為化し、12週間（第I期）の投与後、40週間のオープンラベル延長（第II期）を行い、5 mgへの増量が可能であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ルセオグリフロジンは日本小児・思春期T2D患者においてHbA1cを有意に低下させ、52週間まで有効性を維持し、忍容性も良好であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 小児・思春期T2D患者に対する有効かつ安全な治療選択肢が限られている中、本試験はルセオグリフロジンが同集団における治療選択肢として有望であることを示した。
items.study_type_ja: 多施設共同、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照第III相試験
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：第I期（12週間）終了時のベースラインからのHbA1c変化。安全性評価：有害事象（AE）、有害薬物反応（ADR）、重篤な有害事象、低血糖事象。第II期（52週間）終了時のHbA1c変化。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 主要エンドポイント（第I期終了時のベースラインからのHbA1c変化）：ルセオグリフロジン群 -1.45%（95% CI, -1.78%〜-1.11%）。群間差：-1.76%（95% CI, -2.49%〜-1.02%）。第II期終了時の平均HbA1c変化：-0.92% ± 1.74%。AE発生率：85.4%。ADR発生率：29.2%。死亡：なし。重篤なAE：3例。軽度低血糖事象：1例。

items.title: Empagliflozin mitigates lipopolysaccharide-induced tracheal injury in rats via downregulation of IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway and stem cell preservation: histological and molecular study.
items.abstract: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) is a component of the Gram-negative bacterial cell wall and is considered a potent inflammatory inducer. Empagliflozin (EMPA) is a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitor used in treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus. Interleukin-6/Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (IL-6/JAK/STAT3) signaling pathway is essential in driving inflammation, fibrosis, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Tracheal basal stem cells are responsible for epithelial regeneration after injury. This study aimed to investigate the potential protective effects of EMPA against LPS-induced tracheal injury, with emphasis on EMT and tracheal basal stem cells. Sixty adult male rats were allocated into four groups: control; EMPA, which received EMPA (10 mg/kg/day) via oral gavage for 28 days; LPS, which received single intratracheal dose of LPS (5 mg/kg) on day 1; and LPS + EMPA, which received single LPS dose and EMPA for 28 days. Tracheal specimens were processed for biochemical, histological, immunohistochemical and RT-quantitative real-time PCR analysis. Compared to the LPS group, the LPS + EMPA group showed marked improvement of histological, ultrastructural ,and biochemical alterations including maintenance of epithelial and cilia integrity, decreased lipid peroxidation, stimulated antioxidant enzyme activities, reduced serum inflammatory cytokines, increased percentage area of E-cadherin (an epithelial marker) immunostaining, decreased percentage area of fibrosis, vimentin (a mesenchymal marker), and pro-apoptotic Bax; and enhanced percentage area of cytokeratin 5/6 (CK5/6) (stem cell marker). Moreover, EMPA downregulated the IL-6/JAK/STAT3 pathway involved in EMT. In conclusion, EMPA alleviated LPS-induced tracheal injury through its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, downregulation of IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway, and preservation of the tracheal basal stem cells.
items.authors: Sarhan Nahla Reda, Elekhtiar Sally A, Elmowafy Rasha, Shrief Amira I
items.summary_ja: LPS誘起気管損傷に対するエンパグリフロジンの保護効果を検討した前臨床動物実験。60頭の成獣雄性ラットを4群（対照群、EMPA群：10 mg/kg/day経口投与28日間、LPS群：1日目に気管内投与5 mg/kg単回投与、LPS+EMPA群）に割り付け、気管標本を生化学的・組織学的・免疫組織化学的・RT-qPCR解析に供した。LPS+EMPA群はLPS群と比較して組織学的・超微構造・生化学的変化の著明な改善が認められ、上皮・線毛の維持、脂質過酸化の減少、抗酸化酵素活性の刺激、血清炎症性サイトカインの減少、E-カドヘリン免疫染色面積率の増加、線維化・ビメンチン・Bax面積率の減少、CK5/6面積率の増加が示された。またEMPAはEMTに関与するIL-6/JAK/STAT3経路を下方調節した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: エンパグリフロジンは抗酸化・抗炎症作用、IL-6/JAK/STAT3シグナル経路の下方調節、および気管基底幹細胞の保存を介してLPS誘起気管損傷を軽減した。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の糖尿病治療以外の気管保護作用の可能性を示す前臨床データであり、気道上皮再生・EMT抑制・幹細胞保存の観点から、SGLT2阻害薬のオフターゲット効果や新たな治療応用の機序解明に寄与し得る。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床動物実験（ラットを用いた実験的研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 組織学的変化、超微構造変化、脂質過酸化、抗酸化酵素活性、血清炎症性サイトカイン、E-カドヘリン免疫染色面積率、線維化面積率、ビメンチン面積率、Bax面積率、CK5/6面積率、IL-6/JAK/STAT3経路発現

items.title: The Evolution of Medications for Obesity Management.
items.abstract: This narrative review provides an overview of progress in the development of obesity medications, including a synthesis of data describing the efficacy and safety of currently available agents and emerging therapeutic options. Historically, many obesity medications have been withdrawn from the market due to safety concerns. However, expansion in scientific knowledge of the mechanisms regulating appetite and energy balance has led to the development of medications with greater safety and efficacy. The current generation of injectable incretin analogs, semaglutide and tirzepatide, is associated with mean weight loss in the range of 15%-20% over approximately 12-18 months. These agents confer additional substantial cardiometabolic benefits, including reductions in adverse cardiovascular and kidney outcomes, and improvements in glycaemia, blood pressure, lipid profile and steatohepatitis. As therapeutic options continue to expand, obesity medications are poised to play a critical role in the management of cardiometabolic disease.
items.journal: JGH open : an open access journal of gastroenterology and hepatology
items.authors: Gill Jaskirath, Sumithran Priya
items.summary_ja: 肥満治療薬の開発の進歩に関するナラティブレビュー。現在利用可能な薬剤および新興治療法の有効性と安全性のデータを統合し、歴史的に安全性懸念から市場から撤退した薬剤が多い中、食欲・エネルギーバランスのメカニズムに関する科学的知識の拡大により、より安全性・有効性の高い薬剤が開発されてきたことを概観する。現在の注射用インクレチンアナログ（セマグルチド、tirzepatide）は約12〜18ヶ月で平均15%〜20%の体重減少を達成し、心血管・腎臓アウトカムの改善、血糖値・血圧・脂質プロファイル・脂肪性肝炎の改善など、追加の心代謝上の利益をもたらす。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 現在の注射用インクレチンアナログ（セマグルチド、tirzepatide）は約12〜18ヶ月で平均15%〜20%の体重減少を達成し、心血管・腎臓アウトカムの改善や血糖値・血圧・脂質プロファイル・脂肪性肝炎の改善など、心代謝上の追加の利益をもたらす。
items.why_matters_ja: 治療選択肢が拡大する中、肥満治療薬は心代謝疾患の管理において重要な役割を果たすことが期待される。
items.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少、心血管アウトカム、腎臓アウトカム、血糖値、血圧、脂質プロファイル、脂肪性肝炎
items.endpoint_results_ja: 平均体重減少：約12〜18ヶ月で15%〜20%

items.title: Blood pressure, electrolyte and fluid balance in horses with insulin dysregulation after short-term treatment with canagliflozin.
items.abstract: Short-term treatment with SGLT-2 inhibitors decreases blood pressure in people with type 2 diabetes. The aim was to investigate the impact of a 3-week treatment with canagliflozin on blood pressure in insulin dysregulated (ID) horses and to study effects on fluid balance. This was a single-centre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel design study. The primary study evaluated glucose and insulin responses during an oral sugar test, and these results have been published previously. Here we report the effect of canagliflozin treatment on blood pressure, PCV, serum proteins and electrolytes. Baseline data were collected over an initial 3-day period from 16 privately owned ID horses and ponies. On the morning of the third day, blood sampling was performed for analysis of serum electrolytes, serum proteins and PCV, along with measurement of blood pressure using the non-invasive high definition oscillometry technique. Horses were then randomly assigned to either once-daily oral treatment with 0.6 mg/kg canagliflozin or placebo for a 3-week double-blind treatment period at home and a 3-day follow-up period similar to the baseline period, during which the double-blind treatment continued. There was no significant detectable change in systolic-, diastolic- or mean arterial blood pressure in canagliflozin treated horses compared to placebo. PCV, serum protein and electrolytes did not differ between treatments. Compared to humans, a significant reduction in blood pressure was not observed after short-term canagliflozin treatment. Additionally, there were no significant transient changes in PCV, serum protein or electrolyte concentrations as observed in humans with short-term canagliflozin treatment.
items.authors: Nostell Katarina, Lindåse Sanna, Svonni Elin, Höglund Katja, Bröjer Johan
items.summary_ja: インスリン調節異常（ID）馬における3週間のカナグリフロジン投与が血圧に与える影響および水分平衡への影響を調査した単一施設、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照、並行群間比較試験。16頭のID馬・ポニーをカナグリフロジン（0.6 mg/kg 1日1回経口投与）群またはプラセボ群に無作為に割り付け、3週間の二重盲検治療期間と3日間のフォローアップ期間を設けた。収縮期血圧、拡張期血圧、平均動脈圧、PCV、血清タンパク質、電解質を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ヒトとは異なり、短期間のカナグリフロジン投与後、インスリン調節異常馬では血圧の有意な低下も、PCV・血清タンパク質・電解質濃度の一時的な有意な変化も観察されなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT-2阻害薬はヒトの2型糖尿病患者で血圧を低下させることが知られているが、インスリン調節異常馬において同様の効果が発現するかは不明であった。本結果は、SGLT-2阻害薬の馬への応用において血圧低下という副次的効果や電解質・水分平衡への影響を期待できないことを示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 単一施設、無作為化、二重盲検、プラセボ対照、並行群間比較試験
items.endpoints_ja: 収縮期血圧、拡張期血圧、平均動脈圧、PCV、血清タンパク質、電解質
items.endpoint_results_ja: カナグリフロジン投与馬においてプラセボと比較して収縮期血圧、拡張期血圧、平均動脈圧に有意な検出可能な変化はなかった。PCV、血清タンパク質、電解質は治療間で差がなかった。ヒトで観察されるようなPCV、血清タンパク質、電解質濃度の有意な一時的な変化も観察されなかった。

items.title: Emerging role of GLP-1 mono, dual, and triple agonists in the management of MASH-related fibrosis.
items.abstract: Recent therapeutic advances have resulted in US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the first pharmacological agents-resmetirom and semaglutide-for advanced metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) without cirrhosis, reshaping the therapeutic landscape of the disease. Within this evolving framework, incretin-based pharmacotherapies-including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and their dual and triple combinations with glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide (GIP) and/or glucagon receptor agonists-have emerged as promising options, particularly for individuals with coexisting obesity or type 2 diabetes. These agents exert pleiotropic effects across multiple organs, modulating glucose and lipid metabolism, while providing cardiovascular and renal benefits. Despite these advances, key challenges remain regarding treatment duration, tolerability, and interindividual variability in therapeutic response. This review summarizes the emerging role of GLP-1 mono, dual, and triple agonists in MASH-related fibrosis, focusing on their mechanisms of action and evidence from phase 2 and phase 3 clinical trials with histology-assessed hepatic endpoints.
items.authors: Tavaglione Federica, Loomba Rohit
items.summary_ja: MASH関連線維症の管理におけるGLP-1単独、二重、三重アゴニストの新興する役割を総説したレビュー論文。作用機序と、組織学的肝臓エンドポイントを用いた第2相・第3相臨床試験のエビデンスに焦点を当てている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1単独、二重、三重アゴニストはMASH関連線維症、特に肥満または2型糖尿病を併存する患者において有望な治療選択肢として台頭しているが、治療期間、忍容性、治療反応の個人間変異に関する重要な課題が残る。
items.why_matters_ja: FDAがMASH（肝硬変なし）に対する初の薬物療法であるresmetiromとsemaglutideを承認し、疾患の治療風景が変化した。インクレチン系薬物療法は血糖・脂質代謝を調節し、心血管・腎臓への利益も提供する多面的な効果を持つ。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（総説）
items.endpoints_ja: 組織学的肝臓エンドポイント（histology-assessed hepatic endpoints）

items.title: Metformin-Associated Lactic Acidosis and Relative Euglycemic Ketoacidosis Precipitated by a Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist: A Case Report and Literature Review.
items.abstract: Metformin-associated lactic acidosis (MALA) is an uncommon but often fatal complication of metformin therapy (incidence less than 10 per 100,000 patient-years; with a 30-50% mortality). MALA most commonly occurs with acute kidney injury, which impairs metformin excretion and inhibits mitochondrial complex I, shifting pyruvate metabolism toward lactate production. Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA), classically defined as DKA with glucose below 250 mg/dL, is increasingly recognized not only with sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors but also with glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RA) through appetite suppression, vomiting, and reduced intake. Concurrent MALA and ketoacidosis with relative euglycemia is exceedingly rare, with no published synthesis of such cases to guide recognition or management. We present a case of severe MALA with ketoacidosis and relative euglycemia in a 59-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes on metformin and tirzepatide, managed successfully with emergent sequential hemodialysis and high-dose continuous venovenous hemodiafiltration. We also review reported MALA cases with GLP-1 RA use to identify shared precipitants, risk factors, and outcomes. The key lesson is that, in patients on metformin and a GLP-1 RA, gastrointestinal side effects can precipitate MALA, while a disproportionately low glucose can mask the accompanying ketoacidosis. Recognizing this pattern demands early measurement of serum beta-hydroxybutyrate and prompt initiation of renal replacement therapy.
items.authors: Adnani Harsha, Ladiwala Zoya, Lee Melinda, Patel Ami, King Joshua, Weir Matthew R
items.summary_ja: メトホルミン関連乳酸アシドーシス（MALA）は稀だが致死率の高い合併症であり、通常は急性腎障害を背景に発症する。一方、血糖値250 mg/dL未満の糖尿病ケトアシドーシス（euDKA）はSGLT2阻害薬だけでなくGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）でも食欲抑制・嘔吐・摂取量減少を介して認識されつつある。本報告は、メトホルミンとtirzepatideを服用中の59歳女性2型糖尿病患者で、重度のMALAにケトアシドーシスおよび相対的血糖正常を伴った症例を提示し、緊急の連続血液透析および高用量持続静脈-静脈血液濾過透析（CVVHDF）により成功裏に治療した。さらに、GLP-1 RA使用を伴うMALA症例の文献レビューを行い、共通する誘因・リスク因子・予後を整理した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: メトホルミンとGLP-1 RAを併用中の患者では、消化管副作用がMALAを誘発し得る一方、相対的に低い血糖値が随伴するケトアシドーシスを隠蔽し得る。このパターンを認識するためには、血清β-ヒドロキシブチル酸の早期測定と腎代替療法の迅速な開始が求められる。
items.why_matters_ja: MALAとケトアシドーシスが相対的血糖正常を伴って同時に出現することは極めて稀であり、認識や管理を導くための公表された統合報告はこれまでなかった。GLP-1 RAの普及に伴い、メトホルミン併用患者でのこの合併症の認識が臨床的に重要となる。

items.endpoints_ja: 抄録に記載なし

items.title: Oral Incretin-Based Therapies for Weight Management.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This paper aims to review the current development of oral incretin-based therapies for treatment of overweight and obesity, and outline the efficacy of upcoming therapeutic candidates as well as their safety profiles. Clinical recommendations are provided regarding the role of oral incretin-based therapies for treatment of overweight and obesity.
RECENT FINDINGS: Until recently, almost all incretin-based therapies have been injectable formulations due to limitations in absorption and bioavailability. Recently, novel techniques have emerged to overcome these barriers, with two agents (oral semaglutide and orforglipron) having obtained FDA approval; multiple other candidates are currently in development. Semaglutide is a peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist and orforglipron is a small-molecule biased GLP-1 receptor agonist approved for treatment of obesity; oral semaglutide is additionally approved for secondary cardiovascular risk reduction. In phase 3 trials, oral semaglutide and orforglipron have demonstrated clinically significant weight loss efficacy of > 10% with an adverse-event profile consistent with the GLP-1 class. Differences in formulations of novel oral agents result in differences in administration guidelines and potential risk of adverse events; with particular concern of drug-induced liver injury observed with first generation small-molecule incretin therapies. Overall, oral incretin-based therapies offer a promising new and potentially more accessible option for patients with overweight or obesity.
items.authors: Cheng Henry Evan, Bonafede Michael, Shukla Alpana P
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、過体重・肥満の治療における経口インクレチン系療法の開発现状を総説する。従来のインクレチン系療法は吸収・生体利用率の限界によりほぼすべて注射製剤であったが、近年の技術革新により経口製剤の開発が進み、経口セマグルチド（ペプチドGLP-1受容体作動薬）とオルフォグリプロン（低分子バイアスGLP-1受容体作動薬）がFDA承認を取得した。第III相試験において両薬剤は10%超の臨床的に有意な減量効果を示し、有害事象プロファイルはGLP-1クラスと一致した。経口製剤の配合の違いにより投与ガイドラインや有害事象リスクに差異が生じ、初世代低分子インクレチン療法では薬剤性肝障害が特に懸念される。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口セマグルチドとオルフォグリプロンは第III相試験で10%超の減量効果を示し、過体重・肥満患者にとってよりアクセスしやすい有望な治療選択肢を提供する。
items.why_matters_ja: 従来のインクレチン系療法は注射製剤が中心であり、経口製剤の登場は患者のアドヒアランス向上と治療アクセスの拡大に寄与する可能性がある。また、経口製剤の配合差に伴う有害事象リスク（特に薬剤性肝障害）の理解は臨床実践上重要である。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 減量効果（体重減少率）、有害事象プロファイル
items.endpoint_results_ja: 経口セマグルチドおよびオルフォグリプロンは第III相試験で10%超の臨床的に有意な減量効果を示した。有害事象プロファイルはGLP-1クラスと一致した。

items.title: Efficacy and safety of canagliflozin are consistent across polypharmacy burden in CKD: the CREDENCE trial.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Polypharmacy in chronic kidney disease (CKD) is substantial. Clinicians and patients are often reluctant to add medications to already complex regimens, partly due to concerns about diminishing efficacy and increased adverse effects. We assessed whether efficacy and safety of canagliflozin is modified by polypharmacy status in patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD.
METHODS: We conducted a post-hoc analysis of the CREDENCE trial, which evaluated the effects of canagliflozin on outcomes in patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD. Participants were categorized as no polypharmacy (0-4 medicines), polypharmacy (5-9 medicines), or hyperpolypharmacy (≥10 medicines). We assessed the relative effects of canagliflozin on clinical and safety outcomes by polypharmacy status using Cox proportional hazards models. We assessed absolute benefits using Poisson regression. The primary outcome was a composite of doubling of serum creatinine, kidney failure or death due to cardiovascular or kidney disease.
RESULTS: Among 4401 participants, 612 (14%), 2404 (55%), and 1385 (31%) were categorized as no polypharmacy, polypharmacy and hyperpolypharmacy, respectively. Mean number of medications was 8.3 (SD 3.77). The effect of canagliflozin on kidney and cardiovascular outcomes was consistent irrespective of polypharmacy status, with no interaction observed for safety outcomes (all P-interaction > 0.06). Rates of treatment discontinuation increased with medication burden, but were lower with canagliflozin versus placebo, regardless of polypharmacy status (P-interaction = 0.16). Incidence of all-cause hospitalization, and heart failure hospitalization or cardiovascular death increased with higher medication burden, thus absolute risk reductions were estimated to be substantially greater in patients with polypharmacy and hyperpolypharmacy.
CONCLUSION: Among patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD, the efficacy and safety of canagliflozin appears consistent regardless of polypharmacy status, with larger estimated absolute reductions in hospitalizations and cardiovascular events in those experiencing polypharmacy or hyperpolypharmacy. These findings suggest that polypharmacy alone should not preclude consideration of SGLT2 inhibitor therapy in patients with CKD and type 2 diabetes for whom treatment is otherwise indicated.
items.journal: Nephrology, dialysis, transplantation : official publication of the European Dialysis and Transplant Association - European Renal Association
items.authors: Yeung Emily K, Siriwardana Amanda, Buizen Luke, Tang Arthur H C, Jun Min, Polkinghorne Kevan R, Tang Sydney C W, Kotwal Sradha
items.summary_ja: CREDENCE試験の事後解析として、2型糖尿病を合併した慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者において、カナグリフロジンの有効性及び安全性が多剤使用（ポリファーマシー）の状態によって変調されるかを評価した。参加者を非ポリファーマシー（0〜4剤）、ポリファーマシー（5〜9剤）、ハイパーポリファーマシー（10剤以上）に分類し、Cox比例ハザードモデルで相対効果、Poisson回帰で絶対的有益性を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: カナグリフロジンの腎・心血管アウトカムに対する効果はポリファーマシー状態に関わらず一貫しており、安全性アウトカムでも相互作用は認められなかった。ポリファーマシーまたはハイパーポリファーマシーの患者では、入院および心血管イベントの絶対的リスク低減がより大きいと推定された。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者におけるポリファーマシーは重大な問題であり、臨床医や患者は複雑な治療レジメンに薬剤を追加することに消極的である。本研究は、ポリファーマシー単独ではSGLT2阻害薬治療の検討を妨げるべきではないことを示唆し、臨床現場での治療判断に直接寄与する。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（CREDENCE試験）の事後解析
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：血清クレアチニン値の2倍化、腎不全、または心血管疾患または腎疾患による死亡の複合エンドポイント。その他：安全性アウトカム、治療中止、全原因入院、心不全入院または心血管死亡。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 参加者4401名中、非ポリファーマシー612名（14%）、ポリファーマシー2404名（55%）、ハイパーポリファーマシー1385名（31%）。平均薬剤数は8.3（SD 3.77）。安全性アウトカムで相互作用は認められず（全P-interaction > 0.06）。治療中止のP-interaction = 0.16。全原因入院および心不全入院または心血管死亡の発生率は薬剤負荷の増加に伴い増加し、ポリファーマシーおよびハイパーポリファーマシーの患者で絶対的リスク低減がより大きいと推定された。

items.title: Adjunctive Treatments for Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Using Automated Insulin Delivery Systems. A Narrative Review.
items.abstract: Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) systems represent the most effective and safe treatment for the management of type 1 diabetes (T1D). Antidiabetic agents used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes, such as the Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 (GLP-1) Receptor Agonists (RAs), the dual Glucose-dependent Insulinotropic Polypeptide and GLP-1 RA and the Sodium-Glucose co-Transporter 2 inhibitors are associated with clinically significant weight loss and cardioprotective effect. Given the increased prevalence of overweight, obesity, and cardiovascular risk in patients with T1D, the addition of these medications to AID treatment is of considerable clinical interest. In this review limited data from randomized controlled and observational trials show that in overweight and obese patients with T1D treated with AID, the addition of weekly semaglutide, or tirzepatide is associated with significant weight loss, reduction in total daily insulin dose and increase in Time In target Range (TIR) without increased risk for hypoglycemia and Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA). Similarly, adjunctive treatment with empagliflozin resulted in increased TIR without increase in hypoglycemia, reduction in insulin requirements, and increase in the mean plasma ketone value, although DKA remained rare. However, studies of longer duration with more participants are required to establish the long-term safety and efficacy of these interventions in patients with T1D treated with AID.
items.authors: Kitsios Konstantinos, Trakatelli Christina-Maria
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、1型糖尿病（T1D）患者における自動インスリン投与（AID）システムへの併用療法（GLP-1受容体作動薬、GIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬、SGLT2阻害薬）に関する叙述的レビューである。肥満・過体重のT1D患者においてAIDに併用した週1回セマグルチド、チルゼパチド、エンパグリフロジンの有効性と安全性を、ランダム化比較試験および観察研究の限られたデータから検討した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満・過体重のT1D患者においてAIDにセマグルチド、チルゼパチド、またはエンパグリフロジンを併用すると、体重減少、総日量インスリン用量の減少、TIR（目標範囲内時間）の増加が認められ、低血糖やDKAのリスク増加は認められなかった。ただし、長期の安全性と有効性を確立するためには、より長期かつ大規模な研究が必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: T1D患者において過体重・肥満および心血管リスクの有病率が増加しており、AIDへの併用療法は臨床的に重要な関心事である。
items.study_type_ja: 叙述的レビュー（Narrative Review）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、総日量インスリン用量、Time In target Range（TIR）、低血糖リスク、糖尿病性ケトアシドーシス（DKA）、平均血漿ケトン値

items.title: Trends in GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Prescriptions for Children Ages 8 to 11 With Obesity: 2019-2026.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Clinical practice guidelines for pediatric obesity management allow for consideration of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) in children ages 8-11. No study has documented secular trends in GLP-1RA prescribing in this group. We hypothesized that there would be a significant increase over time, particularly for children with more severe obesity, greater comorbidity burden, and less socioeconomic vulnerability.
METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study of repeated annual cohorts from Epic Cosmos examined GLP-1RA prescriptions (Saxenda, Wegovy, Zepbound) for children (aged 8-11) without diabetes and with obesity from January 1, 2019 to June 17, 2026. A binomial logistic regression model for grouped data was performed to determine whether changes in the proportion of patients prescribed GLP-1RA over time were statistically significant.
RESULTS: Among 3 520 531 children with obesity but without diabetes, 0.6% received a GLP-1RA prescription. Older children (11 years: 79.5/10 000 vs 8 years: 41.5/10 000), female children (75.9/10 000 vs 42.8/10 000), and children with less social vulnerability (low: 76.1/10 000 vs high: 49.2/10 000) were more likely to be prescribed GLP-1RAs. Children with obesity-related comorbidities were substantially more likely to be prescribed GLP-1RAs (188.9/10 000). Prevalent prescribing increased from 0.03% in 2019 to 9.3% in 2026, a 310-fold increase (P < .001).
CONCLUSIONS: In this cohort of >3.5 million children aged 8 to 11 with obesity and without diabetes, GLP-1RA prescribing increased sharply from 2019 to 2026 yet remained uncommon, reaching 0.6% of children. Clinicians appear to be reserving GLP-1RAs for those at greatest cardiometabolic risk. Prescriptions are more likely to go to those with less socioeconomic vulnerability.
items.authors: Orandi Babak J, Patel Suhani S, Messito Mary Jo, Mankowski Michal A, Segev Dorry L, Massie Allan B
items.summary_ja: Epic Cosmosデータベースを用いた後方視的横断研究（反復年次コホート）であり、2019年1月1日から2026年6月17日までの期間において、糖尿病を伴わない肥満を有する8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1受容体作動薬（Saxenda、Wegovy、Zepbound）の処方傾向を評価した。3,520,531名の対象小児のうち0.6%がGLP-1RA処方を受けた。年齢が大きい（11歳：79.5/10,000 vs 8歳：41.5/10,000）、女性（75.9/10,000 vs 42.8/10,000）、社会的脆弱性が低い（低：76.1/10,000 vs 高：49.2/10,000）、肥満関連合併症を有する（188.9/10,000）小児で処方率が有意に高かった。有病率ベースの処方率は2019年の0.03%から2026年の9.3%へ310倍に増加した（P < .001）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 8〜11歳肥満小児におけるGLP-1RA処方は2019年から2026年にかけて310倍に急増したが、全体では依然として0.6%と低く、臨床医は最も心代謝リスクの高い患者に限定して処方している傾向がある。また、社会的脆弱性が低い小児に処方されやすいという格差が認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: 8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1RA処方の時間的トレンドを初めて文書化した研究であり、急速な普及の一方で依然として低率にとどまる現状、および社会的脆弱性に基づく処方格差の存在を明らかにした点で、小児肥満管理の臨床実践と公平性の観点から重要である。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的横断研究（反復年次コホート）
items.endpoints_ja: 糖尿病を伴わない肥満を有する8〜11歳小児におけるGLP-1RA処方の有病率（時間的変化）

items.title: Dapagliflozin ameliorates pulmonary arterial hypertension-induced right heart failure via ketone body metabolism and mitochondrial function enhancement.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)-induced right ventricular (RV) failure increases reliance on ketones. The efficacy of SGLT2 inhibitors, known to modulate ketone metabolism, in this context remains unclear.
METHODS: A PAH model was established in Sprague-Dawley rats via a single intraperitoneal injection of monocrotaline (MCT), followed by daily oral administration of dapagliflozin (DAPA). Pulmonary hemodynamics and RV function were evaluated using echocardiography and right heart catheterization. Myocardial injury, fibrosis, and mitochondrial ultrastructure were assessed via histological staining and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Ketone body levels and metabolic enzyme expression were determined by ELISA and immunoblotting, with transcriptomic analysis identifying potential targets validated by rescue experiments.
RESULTS: DAPA reduced pulmonary arterial pressure, improved RV systolic function, and attenuated RV hypertrophy and fibrosis. These benefits were associated with elevated β-hydroxybutyrate (β-OHB) and acetoacetate levels, alongside the upregulation of key ketone metabolic enzymes, including 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2 (HMGCS2), β-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase 1 (BDH1), and succinyl-CoA:3-oxoacid CoA transferase (SCOT). Furthermore, DAPA restored mitochondrial homeostasis by increasing adenosine triphosphate (ATP) production, reducing oxidative stress, and shifting mitochondrial dynamics towards fusion-specifically by increasing mitofusin 1 (MFN1) and mitofusin 2 (MFN2), while decreasing dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1) and fission 1 (FIS1). Transcriptomics revealed significant ADAMTS8 downregulation following DAPA treatment; crucially, adenovirus-mediated ADAMTS8 overexpression partially abrogated these cardioprotective effects.
CONCLUSION: DAPA effectively alleviates PAH-induced right heart failure by suppressing ADAMTS8 expression, thereby enhancing myocardial ketone body metabolism and improving mitochondrial function. These findings identify ADAMTS8 as a key therapeutic target and provide novel evidence supporting the application of DAPA in PAH.
items.authors: Xu Wendong, Liu Jia, Yan Longlong, Er Lu, Tian Shuwei, Du Rongpin
items.summary_ja: MCT投与によるPAHモデルラットにおいて、DAPAのPAH誘発右心不全に対する効果を評価した前臨床研究。DAPAは肺動脈圧を低下させ、右室収縮機能、右室肥大・線維化を改善し、ケトン体代謝（β-OHB、アセトアセテート、HMGCS2、BDH1、SCOTの上昇）とミトコンドリア機能（ATP産生増加、酸化ストレス減少、融合促進）を改善した。転写組学解析によりADAMTS8の発現低下が同定され、ADAMTS8の過剰発現により心保護効果が部分的に消失した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: DAPAはADAMTS8の発現抑制を介して心筋のケトン体代謝を促進し、ミトコンドリア機能を改善することでPAH誘発右心不全を軽減する。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬のPAHにおける有効性が不明確であったが、本研究はADAMTS8を新たな治療標的として同定し、DAPAのPAH応用を支持する新規証拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床研究（動物モデル：MCT投与PAHモデルラット）
items.endpoints_ja: 肺動脈圧、右室収縮機能、右室肥大、右室線維化、心筋障害、ミトコンドリア超微構造、ケトン体レベル（β-OHB、アセトアセテート）、ケトン体代謝酵素発現（HMGCS2、BDH1、SCOT）、ATP産生、酸化ストレス、ミトコンドリア動態関連タンパク質（MFN1、MFN2、DRP1、FIS1）、ADAMTS8発現

items.title: Glucagon-like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist-Associated Injection Site and Dermatologic Reactions.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are increasingly prescribed for type 2 diabetes mellitus and obesity, with expanding therapeutic applications. Although gastrointestinal adverse events are the most recognized toxicities, Cutaneous adverse events constitute a large burden of total adverse reactions.
OBJECTIVE: To review the prevalence, clinical features, mechanisms, and management of non-immunologic Injection Site and Dermatologic Reactions associated with GLP-1RAs.
METHODS: A review of clinical trials, pharmacovigilance studies, and case reports and series was performed. In addition, adverse event reports for tirzepatide, semaglutide, liraglutide, exenatide, dulaglutide, and lixisenatide were extracted from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Injection-site events were combined with skin-related adverse events to generate an adjusted "Skin and Injection-Site Reactions" category for comparison across agents.
RESULTS: Among 442,567 FAERS reports, 137,412 (31.0%) involved skin and injection-site reactions, representing the third most frequently reported adverse event category. Exenatide demonstrated the highest proportion of skin and injection-site reports (53.1%), followed by dulaglutide (33.5%), tirzepatide (32.6%), liraglutide (17.1%), semaglutide (12.2%), and lixisenatide (6.9%). Common reactions included pain, bleeding, erythema, bruising, mass, pruritus, and swelling. Additional adverse events included dysesthesias, nodules, granulomatous reactions, bruising, and hyperhidrosis. Most reactions were mild to moderate and generally managed symptomatically without requiring treatment discontinuation.
CONCLUSIONS: Non-immunologic cutaneous adverse events comprise a substantial proportion of reported GLP-1RA-associated adverse events with differing rates among individual agents. Recognition of these reactions and appropriate supportive management may improve patient outcomes. Prospective studies are needed to better define their adverse event risk rates, mechanisms, and optimal management strategies.
items.authors: Elgindi Dareen, Petronic-Rosic Vesna
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）に関連する非免疫性の注射部位反応および皮膚反応の有病率、臨床的特徴、機序、管理について、臨床試験、薬物警戒研究、症例報告・シリーズをレビューし、さらにFAERSからtirzepatide、semaglutide、liraglutide、exenatide、dulaglutide、lixisenatideの有害事象報告を抽出して比較した。442,567件のFAERS報告のうち137,412件（31.0%）が皮膚および注射部位反応を含み、第3位の有害事象カテゴリーであった。薬剤間で報告割合に差があり、exenatideが最も高かった（53.1%）。多くの反応は軽〜中等度で、対症療法により治療継続が可能であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1RA関連の非免疫性皮膚有害事象は報告された有害事象の大きな割合を占め、薬剤間で発生率に差がある。認識と適切な対症療法により患者アウトカムの改善が期待される。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1RAは2型糖尿病や肥満に対する処方が増加しており、治療応用も拡大している。消化管有害事象が最も認識されている毒性である一方、皮膚有害事象は総有害反応の大きな負担を占めており、臨床現場での認識と管理が患者アウトカムに直結する。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー（臨床試験・薬物警戒研究・症例報告の文献レビューおよびFAERSデータベース解析）
items.endpoints_ja: 皮膚および注射部位反応（Skin and Injection-Site Reactions）のFAERS報告における割合（薬剤間比較）

items.title: (Un)intended consequences of mass-prescribing GLP-1s.
items.abstract: It is difficult to overstate how much glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) pharmacotherapies have inundated the public discourse on obesity. An avalanche of scientific papers, news articles, and social media posts debate the efficacy, affordability, and appropriateness of GLP-1 receptor agonists not just for obesity but also skin disease, erectile dysfunction, pregnancy, and addiction. Attempting to cut through the noise, the World Health Organization (WHO) recently published the first-ever global guidelines recommending GLP-1s for the treatment of obesity, while committing to develop a global framework ensuring "fair access" to these medicines for the 1 billion people affected worldwide. Going deeper, the guidelines also advocate for "robust populationlevel policies" to address the root causes of obesity in unhealthy food environments. However, to complicate these efforts, WHO's recommendations unfold at a time rife with competitive pressures among pharmaceutical companies, food companies vying for the GLP-1 market segment, and wellness companies promoting supplements and telemedicine programs for what is being billed as a GLP-1 lifestyle. This commercial milieu is ripe for unintended consequences that conspire against fair access to these medicines.
items.authors: Hagenaars Luc L, Schmidt Laura A
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬は肥満に関する公衆の議論を席巻しており、WHOは初めて肥満治療におけるGLP-1の推奨を含むグローバルガイドラインを発表した。同ガイドラインは世界中の10億人の患者への「公平なアクセス」を確保するグローバルフレームワークの構築を約束するとともに、不健全な食品環境における肥満の根本原因に対処する「強固な人口レベルの政策」を提唱している。しかし、製薬企業、食品企業、ウェルネス企業間の競争圧力が高まる中、これらの医薬品への公平なアクセスに逆行する意図しない結果が生じる可能性がある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: WHOのGLP-1推奨は公平なアクセスを目的としているが、製薬・食品・ウェルネス業界の商業的競争環境が、その目的に逆行する意図しない結果を招くリスクがある。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬の大量処方と商業化が加速する中、公平なアクセスを確保するための政策設計が重要な課題となる。

items.title: Predictive Value of Urine Tubular Biomarkers on Kidney Outcomes: Observations from EMPA-KIDNEY.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Urine tubular biomarkers have previously been associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression independently of estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and albuminuria. We evaluated whether nine urine tubular biomarkers could improve prediction of kidney failure beyond serum creatinine and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio among adults with CKD.
METHODS: Among 5100 participants in EMPA-KIDNEY, a randomized trial which assessed the effects of empagliflozin 10 mg versus matching placebo among patients with CKD at risk of progression, nine urine creatinine-indexed tubular biomarkers were measured including alpha-1 microglobulin, dickkopf-3, epidermal growth factor [EGF], interleukin-18, kidney injury molecule-1 [KIM-1], monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 [MCP-1], neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin, uromodulin, and human cartilage glycoprotein-40. Outcomes were kidney disease progression ('treated kidney failure', renal death, or sustained ≥40% eGFR decline) and treated kidney failure (maintenance dialysis or kidney transplant). Relative to models based on the linear predictor of the kidney failure risk equation (KFRE), improvements in discrimination were estimated with further addition of the nine tubular biomarkers using absolute difference in Uno's C-index.
RESULTS: Over median 3.5 years of follow-up, 1191 participants experienced kidney disease progression and 461 experienced treated kidney failure. KFRE demonstrated excellent discrimination for treated kidney failure [C-index 0.858 (0.840,0.874)] and moderate discrimination for kidney disease progression [0.724 (0.705,0.743)]. Addition of three biomarkers (MCP-1, KIM-1, and EGF) most strongly associated with CKD outcomes yielded some further improvement in predicting kidney failure [absolute difference 0.014 (0.009,0.024)] and kidney disease progression [0.038 (0.026,0.053)]. Prediction of kidney outcomes were only slightly improved when further expanding from three to all ning tubular biomarkers.
CONCLUSION: In a wide range of causes of CKD, adding three urine tubular biomarkers (MCP-1, KIM-1, EGF) to KFRE improves estimates of risk of CKD progression.
items.journal: Clinical journal of the American Society of Nephrology : CJASN
items.authors: Malijan Greco B, Herrington William G, Judge Parminder K, Sardell Rebecca J, Chapman Daniel, Hill Michael, Moffat Stewart, Zhu Doreen
items.summary_ja: EMPA-KIDNEY試験（empagliflozin 10 mg vs. プラセボ、CKD進行リスクのある成人）の5100名の参加者において、9種の尿クレアチニン指数化細管バイオマーカー（α-1ミクログロブリン、dickkopf-3、EGF、IL-18、KIM-1、MCP-1、NGAL、ウロモジュリン、hCG-40）が、血清クレアチニンと尿アルブミン/クレアチニン比に基づくKFREに追加された際に腎不全の予測を改善するかを評価した。中央値3.5年の追跡期間中、1191名が腎疾患進行、461名が治療腎不全を経験した。KFREは治療腎不全に対してC-index 0.858（0.840, 0.874）、腎疾患進行に対してC-index 0.724（0.705, 0.743）を示した。CKD転帰と最も関連が強い3バイオマーカー（MCP-1、KIM-1、EGF）の追加により、腎不全の予測が絶対差0.014（0.009, 0.024）、腎疾患進行の予測が絶対差0.038（0.026, 0.053）改善された。3種から全9種に拡大しても予測改善はわずかに留まった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: KFREにMCP-1、KIM-1、EGFの3種の尿細管バイオマーカーを追加することで、CKD進行のリスク推定が改善される。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者の腎不全リスク予測において、既存のKFREに尿細管バイオマーカーを追加することで予測精度が向上する可能性が示された。これは臨床試験におけるリスク層別化や患者選定、また個別化されたリスク評価に活用できる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（EMPA-KIDNEY）の二次解析
items.endpoints_ja: 1) 腎疾患進行（治療腎不全、腎死、または持続的なeGFR 40%以上の低下）2) 治療腎不全（維持透析または腎移植）
items.endpoint_results_ja: 中央値3.5年の追跡期間中、腎疾患進行1191名、治療腎不全461名。KFREのC-index：治療腎不全 0.858（0.840, 0.874）、腎疾患進行 0.724（0.705, 0.743）。MCP-1、KIM-1、EGF追加によるUno's C-indexの絶対差：腎不全 0.014（0.009, 0.024）、腎疾患進行 0.038（0.026, 0.053）。

items.title: From insulin resistance to incretin receptor agonism in the prevention of type 2 diabetes mellitus in obese individuals.
items.abstract: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) represents one of the most significant metabolic challenges of the modern era, with more than 828 million people worldwide living with diabetes. Obesity and insulin resistance are major modifiable contributors to T2DM risk and progression, although the disease is heterogeneous and arises from complex interactions among β-cell dysfunction, hepatic glucose dysregulation, adipose-tissue dysfunction, altered incretin biology, chronic low-grade inflammation, and genetic susceptibility. In individuals with obesity and insulin resistance, progression through prediabetes to overt hyperglycaemia represents an important, although not universal, disease trajectory and provides a clinically relevant window for preventive intervention. This review examines pharmacological strategies relevant to T2DM prevention in individuals without established diabetes who have prediabetes and/or obesity associated with a high risk of progression to T2DM, with particular emphasis on incretin-based obesity pharmacotherapy. Metformin remains the glucose-lowering agent with the most established long-term evidence for diabetes prevention in selected high-risk individuals with prediabetes, acting through multiple hepatic and intestinal mechanisms involving both AMPK-dependent and AMPK-independent pathways. Other established antihyperglycaemic drug classes are discussed primarily to distinguish therapies with evidence for delaying progression to diabetes from agents whose principal role remains the treatment of established T2DM. SGLT2 inhibitors provide substantial cardiovascular and renal protection, although current evidence is insufficient to support their routine use solely for T2DM prevention. GLP-1 receptor agonists and the dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide have substantially advanced obesity pharmacotherapy, producing clinically meaningful weight loss and broader cardiometabolic benefits that may reduce progression to T2DM in high-risk individuals.Next-generation incretin-based therapies, including triple receptor agonists, may further expand therapeutic options but remain an evolving area of investigation. Lifestyle intervention and sustained weight management remain the foundation of T2DM prevention, with pharmacological strategies selected according to individual metabolic risk, obesity-related treatment indications, comorbidities, and the strength of evidence supporting diabetes prevention.
items.authors: Teofilović Branislava, Trkulja Jelena, Grujić-Letić Nevena, Gligorić Emilia, Baletic Djordje, Tomić Ljiljana, Mesarović Aleksandra, Rašković Aleksandar
items.summary_ja: 肥満およびインスリン抵抗性を有する2型糖尿病（T2DM）未罹患者におけるT2DM予防の薬物戦略をレビューした。メトホルミンは前糖尿病を有する高リスク個体における糖尿病予防に最も確立された長期エビデンスを持つ血糖降下薬であり、AMPK依存性及び非依存性の肝・腸管機構を介して作用する。SGLT2阻害薬は心血管・腎保護効果は大きいものの、T2DM予防単独の適応としての現在のエビデンスは不十分である。GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1二重受容体作動薬tirzepatideは肥満薬物療法を大きく前進させ、臨床的に有意な減量と広範な心代謝保護効果により、高リスク個体におけるT2DMへの進行抑制に寄与し得る。次世代インクレチン系療法（三重受容体作動薬等）は治療選択肢をさらに拡大し得るが、依然として研究段階である。生活習慣介入と持続的な体重管理がT2DM予防の基盤であり、薬物戦略は個々の代謝リスク、肥満関連治療適応、合併症、および糖尿病予防を支持するエビデンスの強さに応じて選択される。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満・インスリン抵抗性を有する前糖尿病個体におけるT2DM予防において、メトホルミンが最も確立されたエビデンスを持つ一方、GLP-1受容体作動薬やtirzepatideといったインクレチン系薬物療法が肥満治療の進展を通じて糖尿病予防に新たな選択肢を提供しつつある。
items.why_matters_ja: 世界中で8億2,800万人以上が糖尿病を有し、肥満とインスリン抵抗性はT2DMリスクの主要な修正可能因子である。前糖尿病から顕性高血糖への進行は予防介入の臨床的に重要な窓を提供するため、肥満個体におけるT2DM予防の薬物戦略の整理は公衆衛生上重要である。
