items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists for Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Review.
items.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) affects nearly 1 billion adults worldwide and is independently associated with cardiovascular disease, stroke, and increased mortality. While continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) remains the criterion standard treatment, adherence rates of only 30% to 60% limit its population-level effectiveness. Obesity is present in 60% to 70% of patients with OSA and represents the primary modifiable risk factor, yet, until recently, no pharmacological therapies specifically targeted this pathophysiological mechanism. The December 2024 US Food and Drug Administration approval of tirzepatide as the first medication indicated for moderate to severe OSA in adults with obesity represents a paradigm shift toward disease-modifying pharmacotherapy, with implications for otolaryngologic practice.
OBSERVATIONS: Six meta-analyses demonstrated consistent apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) reductions with glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), ranging from -5.7 to -21.9 events per hour. The SURMOUNT-OSA phase 3 trials showed that tirzepatide reduced AHI by 20 to 24 events per hour vs placebo, with 42% to 50% of patients experiencing disease remission (AHI, <5 events per hour or <15 without symptoms). Weight loss is the primary established mechanism, with GLP-1 RAs reducing tongue fat and parapharyngeal adipose tissue that contribute to upper airway collapse. Emerging preclinical evidence has suggested potential weight-independent effects through carotid body glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor modulation of chemosensitivity (affecting loop gain), leptin pathway interactions that are associated with upper airway neuromuscular control, and NLRP3 inflammasome suppression. However, GLP-1 RAs did not match CPAP efficacy (approximately22 vs 31 events per hour of an AHI reduction), cardiovascular outcome benefits remain unproven, and weight regain commonly occurs after discontinuation.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This review suggest that GLP-1 RAs offer otolaryngologists a disease-modifying adjunct for obesity-related OSA that is best positioned as complementary therapy alongside CPAP, preoperative optimization before upper airway surgery, or potentially to expand hypoglossal nerve stimulator candidacy. They are appropriate for patients with a body mass index (calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared) greater than 30 who are CPAP-intolerant or have obesity-related comorbidities but are unlikely to benefit individuals without obesity or those with primarily anatomical obstruction. Critical evidence gaps include associations with pharyngeal critical closing pressure, drug-induced sleep endoscopy collapse patterns, and hypoglossal nerve stimulator combination therapy outcomes.
items.authors: Harris Alexandria, Kaffenberger Thomas
items.summary_ja: 本レビューは、肥満を伴う閉塞性睡眠時無呼吸（OSA）に対するグルカゴン様ペプチド-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）の役割を考察する。2024年12月にFDAがtirzepatideを肥満を伴う中等症〜重症OSAの適応として承認したことを背景に、6つのメタアナリシスによるAHI減少効果、SURMOUNT-OSA第III相試験の結果、体重減少を主とする作用機序（舌脂肪・傍咽頭脂肪組織の減少）、および体重非依存性機序（頸動体GLP-1受容体による化学感受性調節、レプチン経路、NLRP3炎症小体抑制）を概観する。耳鼻咽喉科臨床における位置づけとして、CPAP併用療法、上気道手術前の最適化、下舌神経刺激器適応拡大の可能性を提示する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAは肥満関連OSAに対する疾患修飾的補助療法として、CPAP併用、上気道手術前の最適化、下舌神経刺激器適応拡大の拡大に最も適した位置づけである。BMI>30でCPAP不耐容または肥満関連合併症を有する患者に適切だが、肥満を伴わない患者や主に解剖学的閉塞を有する患者には効果は期待できない。
items.why_matters_ja: OSAは世界で約10億人の成人に影響し、心血管疾患・脳卒中・死亡率上昇と独立に関連する。標準治療であるCPAPのアドヒアランスは30〜60%にとどまり、OSA患者の60〜70%に肥満が存在するにもかかわらず、これまでこの病態生理学的メカニズムに特化した薬物療法は存在しなかった。tirzepatideのFDA承認は疾患修飾的薬物療法へのパラダイムシフトを意味し、耳鼻咽喉科臨床に直接的な影響を与える。
items.study_type_ja: レビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 呼吸時無呼吸低呼吸指数（AHI）の減少、疾患寛解（AHI<5 events/hour または 無症状で<15 events/hour）

items.title: Emerging Topics In Obesity Treatment in the Setting of Organ Transplantation.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: This review summarizes current evidence on the treatment of obesity in the solid organ transplant setting and identifies evidence gaps.
RECENT FINDINGS: Lifestyle modification, pharmacotherapy, and metabolic and bariatric surgery are all potential options for management of obesity in the setting of solid organ transplantation. Limited available data on use of incretin-based pharmacotherapy in solid organ transplantation support its safety and effectiveness in appropriately-selected patients, however prospective large-scale studies are needed. Obesity treatment is an important component of transplant care, as obesity is associated with increased mortality and adverse graft outcomes. Lifestyle modification, anti-obesity pharmacotherapy, and metabolic and bariatric surgery can be employed safely in both pre- and post-transplant settings. Newer incretin-based pharmacotherapy, including glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and dual GLP-1 receptor agonist/gastric inhibitory polypeptide offer potential for substantial weight loss and improved cardiometabolic outcomes. Bariatric and endoscopic metabolic procedures can be beneficial in carefully selected patients pre- or post-transplant. Precision approaches including sarcopenic obesity and measurement of body composition can help tailor interventions. These developments highlight the importance of multidisciplinary management and underscore the need for additional research within transplant populations.
items.authors: Maahs Ethan, Zimmerman Zoe, Khungar Vandana, Banini Bubu A
items.summary_ja: 固形臓器移植における肥満治療の現状証拠を総括し、エビデンスのギャップを特定したレビュー記事。生活習慣改善、薬物療法（インクレチン系薬剤を含む）、代謝・肥満手術が移植前後の肥満管理の選択肢として検討されている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 肥満治療（生活習慣改善、抗肥満薬物療法、代謝・肥満手術）は移植前後のいずれの場面でも安全に実施可能であるが、特にインクレチン系薬物療法については前向き大規模研究が未だ必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は移植患者において死亡率の増加や移植片の不良転帰と関連しており、肥満治療は移植ケアの重要な構成要素である。

items.title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors and gastrointestinal neoplasm risk in type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.abstract: The potential carcinogenic effects of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remain controversial, particularly regarding site-specific gastrointestinal (GI) neoplasms. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine the relationship between SGLT2 inhibitors and the risk of GI neoplasms in patients with T2DM. We searched PubMed, EMBASE, Cochrane CENTRAL, Scopus, and Web of Science through March 17, 2025, for RCTs in T2DM comparing SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo or active comparators. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias. The primary outcome was GI neoplasms reported in publications, supplementary materials, or trial registries, usually as adverse events rather than centrally adjudicated cancer endpoints. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated in Stata 17.0. In 48 RCTs (n = 48,765), SGLT2 inhibitor therapy was not associated with overall GI neoplasm risk (OR = 1.10, 95% CI: 0.84-1.44; p = 0.46; I² = 0%). Site-specific analyses showed no statistically significant association for esophageal (OR = 1.12, 95% CI 0.37-3.45), gastric (1.20, 0.65-2.23), hepatic (0.62, 0.31-1.22), pancreatic (0.91, 0.51-1.64), colonic (1.28, 0.78-2.08), colorectal (0.76, 0.27-2.17), and rectal neoplasms (0.98, 0.49-1.97), with all p-values > 0.05. Subgroup analyses by agents (e.g., canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin), baseline age, body mass index (BMI), HbA1c, treatment duration, and dose were also non-significant (all p > 0.05). Approximately half of the trials had follow-up of one year or less, limiting our ability to evaluate long-term risk. Available RCT evidence does not show a clear increase in GI neoplasm risk with SGLT2 inhibitors in T2DM. However, limited follow-up, low event counts, and non-cancer-specific outcome ascertainment, the findings should be interpreted as reassuring but not definitive evidence of long-term oncologic safety.Systematic review registration: PROSPERO No. CRD42024619019.
items.authors: Zhang Yu-Fan, Xie Jia-Jie, Wu Qi, Zhou Xiao-Yu, Zeng Chen, Zeng Yan, He Yi-Meng, Guo Man
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者におけるSGLT2阻害薬と消化管腫瘍リスクの関連を評価したランダム化比較試験（RCT）の系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス。PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane CENTRAL、Scopus、Web of Scienceを2025年3月17日までに検索し、SGLT2阻害薬をプラセボまたは活性比較薬と比較したT2DMのRCTを対象とした。主要アウトカムは、出版物、補足資料、または試験登録に登録された消化管腫瘍（通常は有害事象として報告され、中央裁定されたがんエンドポイントではない）。48件のRCT（n=48,765）を含むメタアナリシスでは、SGLT2阻害薬の投与は消化管腫瘍全体のリスクと関連しなかった（OR=1.10, 95% CI: 0.84-1.44; p=0.46; I²=0%）。部位別解析では、食道（OR=1.12, 95% CI 0.37-3.45）、胃（1.20, 0.65-2.23）、肝（0.62, 0.31-1.22）、膵（0.91, 0.51-1.64）、結腸（1.28, 0.78-2.08）、大腸（0.76, 0.27-2.17）、直腸腫瘍（0.98, 0.49-1.97）いずれも統計的に有意な関連は認められなかった（全p値>0.05）。薬剤別（カナグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン、エンパグリフロジン）、ベースライン年齢、BMI、HbA1c、治療期間、用量によるサブグループ解析も有意ではなかった（全p>0.05）。約半数の試験はフォローアップが1年以下であり、長期リスクの評価には限界がある。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 利用可能なRCTのエビデンスでは、T2DM患者においてSGLT2阻害薬による消化管腫瘍リスクの明確な増加は示されていない。ただし、フォローアップ期間の短さ、イベント数の少なさ、がん特異的なアウトカムアセスメントの不在から、本結果は安心材料ではあるが、長期の腫瘍学的安全性を確定するものではない。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2阻害薬の潜在的ながん原性、特に部位特異的な消化管腫瘍に関する議論は未解決であり、本メタアナリシスはSGLT2阻害薬の消化管がんリスクに関する安全性プロファイルの重要なエビデンスを提供する。
items.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験の系統的レビューおよびメタアナリシス
items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：消化管腫瘍（有害事象として報告）。部位別解析：食道腫瘍、胃腫瘍、肝腫瘍、膵腫瘍、結腸腫瘍、大腸腫瘍、直腸腫瘍。サブグループ解析：薬剤別（カナグリフロジン、ダパグリフロジン、エンパグリフロジン）、ベースライン年齢、BMI、HbA1c、治療期間、用量。

items.title: Pharmacotherapy of heart failure: Impact of the 2021 guideline update on guideline-directed medical therapy assessed using a Japanese employee health insurance claims database.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the impact of the 2021 guideline update on guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) utilization in patients with heart failure (HF).
BACKGROUND: The 2021 update of the Japanese guidelines for HF management followed the introduction of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin into clinical practice. However, the impact of this guideline update on drug utilization patterns remains unclear.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patient data were obtained from the Japanese employee health insurance claims database (JMDC). The simple GDMT score was determined based on the combination and dose of four key pharmacological classes: β-blockers, renin-angiotensin system inhibitors, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors. Because a simple GDMT score of ≥ 5 has been associated with improved prognosis in patients with HF, patients with scores ≥ 5 were classified into the high-score group for analysis.
RESULTS: Following the guideline update, the proportion of patients in the high-score group increased from 6.97% (n = 4,013) to 9.33% (n = 6,363), standardized difference 0.09. The mean simple GDMT score also showed a small but statistically significant increase (5.72 ± 0.79 vs. 6.00 ± 1.09) with standardized difference 0.28. This upward trend was particularly marked for the prescription rates of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin (sacubitril/valsartan: 1.40% before the update vs. 22.57% after the update; standardized difference, 0.69; dapagliflozin: 12.41% before the update vs. 26.64% after the update; standardized difference, 0.36).
CONCLUSION: The 2021 guideline update was associated with increased use of sacubitril/valsartan and dapagliflozin, resulting in greater overall GDMT intensity. However, these findings are limited to data from 2021, and further long-term studies are needed to evaluate trends in GDMT utilization.

items.summary_ja: 2021年の日本心不全ガイドライン更新がガイドライン推奨薬物療法（GDMT）の利用に与えた影響を、日本の従業員健康保険請求データベース（JMDC）を用いて調査した。β遮断薬、レニン・アンギオテンシン系阻害薬、鉱質コルチコイド受容体拮抗薬、SGLT2阻害薬の4つの主要薬物クラスに基づく簡易GDMTスコアを算出し、スコア≥5を高スコア群として分類した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 2021年のガイドライン更新後、サクビトリル/バルサルタンとダパグリフロジンの処方率が大幅に増加し、GDMT全体の強度（平均簡易GDMTスコア）が有意に向上した。
items.why_matters_ja: ガイドライン更新が実際の臨床現場の薬物利用パターンにどのように影響を与えるかをリアルワールドデータで示すことで、ガイドラインの臨床実装効果を評価する参考となる。
items.study_type_ja: 観察研究（請求データベースを用いた後方視的コホート研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 高スコア群（簡易GDMTスコア≥5）の割合、平均簡易GDMTスコア、サクビトリル/バルサルタンの処方率、ダパグリフロジンの処方率

items.title: Postmarketing Safety Signals and Medication-Use Risks of GLP-1-Based Therapies in Diabetes and Obesity: A Multi-Source Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory Evidence-Mapping Study.
items.abstract:
AIMS: To characterise postmarketing safety signals and medication-use risks associated with GLP-1 receptor agonists and the GIP/GLP-1 co-agonist tirzepatide in diabetes and obesity care using an integrated pharmacovigilance, utilisation-context, regulatory, and external-consistency framework.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) data from 2021Q1 through 2026Q1 were processed using deleted-case exclusion, latest-case-version retention, and case-product deduplication with analysis at the GLP-1 primary-suspect case-product level. Primary-suspect records for semaglutide, tirzepatide, dulaglutide, liraglutide, exenatide, and lixisenatide were analysed using reporting odds ratios, proportional reporting ratios, and an approximate Information Component. Medicaid utilisation data, FDA labelling/Safety-Related Labelling Changes resources, FDA shortage and compounded-product communications, and Canada Vigilance reports provided contextual interpretation; no data source was used to estimate incidence, comparative risk, or causality.
RESULTS: The final FAERS analysis set included 243 114 GLP-1 primary-suspect case-product records within 8 995 547 background reports. Tirzepatide accounted for 133 100 records, followed by semaglutide (55619) and dulaglutide (38406). Frequently reported terms included incorrect dose administered, nausea, injection-site pain, diarrhoea, vomiting, off-label use, and extra dose administered. Prioritised domains included gastrointestinal intolerance, medication-use/device events, impaired gastric emptying, pancreatobiliary events, renal/dehydration events, and hypoglycaemia. Canada Vigilance and FDA labelling/SrLC mapping showed descriptive visibility for most major domains, while medication-use terms reflected use-process rather than conventional adverse-drug-reaction issues.
CONCLUSIONS: Multi-source pharmacovigilance can improve interpretation of GLP-1 postmarketing safety evidence in diabetes and obesity care. Findings should be interpreted as signal-prioritisation and medication-safety evidence, not as incidence, proof of causality, or population-level comparative risk, given the limited clinical interpretability of spontaneous-reporting data.
items.authors: Ren Long, Zhang Yuan, Fang Fang, Ma Yabin
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGIP/GLP-1共作動薬tirzepatideの糖尿病・肥満治療における市販後安全性シグナルと薬剤使用リスクを、統合的な薬物警戒・利用コンテキスト・規制・外部整合性フレームワークを用いて特徴化する研究。FAERSデータ（2021年Q1〜2026年Q1）をdeleted-case exclusion、latest-case-version retention、case-product deduplicationを経て、GLP-1 primary-suspect case-productレベルで分析。ROR、PRR、近似ICを用いたシグナル検出に加え、Medicaid利用データ、FDAラベリング/SrLC、FDA供給不足・調剤品通信、Canada Vigilance報告を文脈的解釈に使用。最終分析セットは8,995,547件の背景報告内に243,114件のGLP-1 primary-suspect case-product記録を含む。
items.key_takeaway_ja: マルチソース薬物警戒は糖尿病・肥満治療におけるGLP-1の市販後安全性証拠の解釈を改善しうるが、自発報告データの臨床的解釈の限界から、結果はシグナル優先順位付けおよび薬剤安全性証拠として解釈すべきであり、発症率、因果関係の証明、集団レベルの比較リスクとしては解釈すべきでない。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1系薬剤は糖尿病・肥満治療で広く使用されており、市販後の安全性シグナルと薬剤使用リスクの把握は患者安全に重要である。本研究は、薬剤使用関連用語（誤った用量の投与、追加用量の投与など）が従来の有害事象（ADR）の問題ではなく使用プロセスの問題を反映していることを示し、薬物警戒データの解釈における重要な区別を提示している。
items.study_type_ja: 市販後薬物警戒研究（FAERS自発報告データを用いたシグナル検出：ROR、PRR、近似IC）および規制証拠マッピング研究。臨床試験ではない。
items.endpoints_ja: GLP-1 primary-suspect case-productレベルでの安全性シグナル検出（ROR、PRR、近似ICによる優先ドメインの特定）。優先ドメイン：消化管不耐性、薬剤使用/デバイス関連事象、胃排出障害、膵胆道事象、腎/脱水事象、低血糖。

items.title: Chronic kidney disease progression with proton pump inhibitors versus H2 receptor antagonists in NSAID users.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Clinical evidence comparing the renal impact of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) and Histamine-2 receptor antagonists (H2RAs) in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) receiving traditional non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (tNSAIDs) is lacking. We evaluated CKD progression risk associated with PPIs versus H2RAs within a tNSAID-treated cohort to inform clinical prescribing.
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used South Korean nationwide claims data (2018-2023). Stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (SIPTW) balanced the cohorts. Restricted cubic spline Cox regression addressed non-linear associations between CKD progression and cumulative exposure to tNSAIDs and acid suppressants (PPIs or H2RAs). Sensitivity analyses addressing unspecified CKD stages confirmed the robustness of the primary findings.
RESULTS: Among 141 093 tNSAID initiators with CKD prescribed PPIs (n = 5315) or H2RAs (n = 7112), PPIs were associated with higher CKD progression risk than H2RAs (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74). Baseline comorbidities-hypertension (aHR 2.03, 95% CI 1.37-2.99]), diabetes (1.69 [1.29-2.21]), and a history of kidney disease (1.43 [1.13-1.81])-and prior diuretic use (2.00 [1.56-2.58]) were associated with increased risk of CKD progression. In contrast, dapagliflozin or empagliflozin use was protective (0.49 [0.27-0.89]). The risk of CKD progression for PPIs relative to H2RAs was most pronounced in females, those with CKD stage 3, patients aged ≥71 years, and those with 1-15 days of treatment (all P < .05).
CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that H2RAs may be associated with a lower risk of CKD progression than PPIs in tNSAID users with CKD, potentially offering a safer alternative when PPI therapy is not indispensable.
items.authors: Park Susin, Chun Pusoon
items.summary_ja: 韓国全国保険請求データ（2018-2023年）を用いた後方視コホート研究であり、tNSAID使用のCKD患者においてPPIとH2RAのCKD進行リスクを比較した。安定化逆確率治療重み付け（SIPTW）と制限的立方スプラインCox回帰を用い、PPIはH2RAと比較してCKD進行リスクが高いことを示した（aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74）。女性、CKDステージ3、71歳以上、治療期間1-15日の患者でリスク差が最も顕著であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: tNSAID使用のCKD患者において、PPIはH2RAと比較してCKD進行リスクが有意に高い（aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74）。PPIが不可欠でない場合、H2RAがより安全な代替選択肢となり得る。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者におけるtNSAID併用時の胃酸抑制薬の選択は臨床的に重要な課題であり、本研究はPPIとH2RAの腎影響を直接比較した臨床証拠を提供し、処方判断に資する。特にSGLT2阻害薬（ダパグリフロジン・エンパグリフロジン）の保護効果（aHR 0.49）も示され、CKD管理における薬剤選択の戦略に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（全国保険請求データ）
items.endpoints_ja: CKD進行（主要エンドポイント）
items.endpoint_results_ja: PPI vs H2RA: aHR 1.38, 95% CI 1.10-1.74。高血圧: aHR 2.03, 95% CI 1.37-2.99。糖尿病: aHR 1.69, 95% CI 1.29-2.21。腎疾患の既往: aHR 1.43, 95% CI 1.13-1.81。利尿薬の既往使用: aHR 2.00, 95% CI 1.56-2.58。ダパグリフロジンまたはエンパグリフロジン使用: aHR 0.49, 95% CI 0.27-0.89。

items.title: Semaglutide Bioavailability: Limitations, Formulation Innovation and Future Opportunities.
items.abstract: Semaglutide, a long-acting glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist, improved the type 2 diabetes mellitus treatment and obesity by its glucose-lowering and weight loss effects. Although the subcutaneous route provides high bioavailability and stable pharmacokinetics, the development of oral semaglutide makes a significant advancement in peptide therapeutics. However, oral delivery remains limited by an absolute bioavailability of only approximately 0.4-1% under optimized fasting conditions with restricted water intake, whereas systemic exposure is essentially absent in the fed state because plasma semaglutide concentrations remain below the limit of quantification. This extremely low exposure reflects peptide degradation within the gastrointestinal tract, poor epithelial permeability, gastric physiological constraints, and presystemic metabolism. The combination with sodium N-(8-[2-hydroxybenzoyl]amino) caprylate (SNAC) helps in gastric absorption by increasing the local gastric microenvironmental pH, thereby reducing acid-induced peptide unfolding, suppressing pepsin activation, maintaining semaglutide predominantly in its absorbable monomeric form by limiting oligomer formation, and enhancing transcellular uptake. But the oral form of semaglutide is constrained by narrow dose limits, considerable pharmacokinetic variability that, despite large fluctuations in individual absorption, produces relatively stable steady-state exposure because semaglutide's approximately one-week half-life and extensive albumin binding buffer day-to-day differences in absorption. This review examines semaglutide pharmacokinetics, focusing on mechanistic challenges to oral bioavailability and formulation approaches to address this. We assess emerging methods such as nanotechnology-based formulations, other permeation enhancers, enzyme inhibitors and device-based delivery systems for their abilities to improve absorption and efficacy. Furthermore, clinical efficacy and patient adherence as well as research opportunities are considered. Continual development of these technologies may emerge as a solution to enhance bioavailability, decrease dosing frequency and expand the range of uses of oral peptide therapies.
items.authors: Vahora Shahin, Shah Vishal, Patel Bhavesh
items.summary_ja: セマグルチドは長作用型GLP-1受容体アゴニストであり、2型糖尿病および肥満の治療に血糖降下作用と減量効果により貢献している。皮下投与は高い生体利用率和安定した薬物動態を提供するが、経口セマグルチドの開発はペプチド治療における重要な進歩である。しかし、経口投与は最適化された絶食条件（水分摂取制限付き）下でも絶対生体利用率が約0.4〜1%と極めて低く、食後状態では血中セマグルチド濃度が定量限界以下であり全身曝露は実質的に欠如している。本レビューは、セマグルチドの薬物動態、経口生体利用率の機能的課題、およびそれに対処する製剤アプローチ（ナノテクノロジーベースの製剤、他の透過促進剤、酵素阻害剤、デバイスベースの送達システム）を考察している。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 経口セマグルチドの生体利用率は絶食条件下でも約0.4〜1%と極めて低く、食後状態では全身曝露が実質的に欠如する。SNACの併用により胃内吸収が促進されるが、狭い用量制限と大きな薬物動態変動が課題であり、半減期（約1週間）とアルブミン結合が日内変動を緩衝して比較的安定した定常状態曝露を維持している。
items.why_matters_ja: 経口ペプチド治療の生体利用率向上は、投与頻度の低減と適応範囲の拡大につながる可能性がある。セマグルチドの経口製剤の限界と将来の技術的解決策（ナノテクノロジー、透過促進剤、酵素阻害剤、デバイスベース送達）の理解は、ペプチド医薬品の開発戦略に直接的な示唆を与える。

items.endpoint_results_ja: 絶対生体利用率：最適化された絶食条件（水分摂取制限付き）下で約0.4〜1%。食後状態：血中セマグルチド濃度が定量限界以下（全身曝露は実質的に欠如）。半減期：約1週間。

items.title: Patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction following rapid weight loss associated with semaglutide use: A case report.
items.abstract: Patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction (PETD) is an uncommon condition characterized by an abnormally patent Eustachian tube, leading to symptoms such as aural fullness and autophony. Rapid weight loss is a recognized risk factor due to loss of peritubal adipose support. With the increasing use of semaglutide and other glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists for obesity management, substantial and rapid weight reduction has become more common, raising the potential for underrecognized otologic complications. A 79-year-old male presented with intermittent bilateral aural fullness and ear "popping" without associated pain, vertigo, or systemic symptoms. His history was notable for intentional weight loss of approximately 200 lb following initiation of semaglutide therapy. Otoscopic examination was unremarkable, and prior tympanometry demonstrated normal middle ear pressure. In the absence of findings suggestive of obstructive Eustachian tube dysfunction, a clinical diagnosis of patulous Eustachian tube dysfunction was made. The patient was managed conservatively with hydration, intranasal saline, and avoidance of decongestants. Rapid, extreme weight loss associated with GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy may precipitate PETD and should be considered in patients presenting with aural fullness and normal middle ear findings. Recognition of this association supports appropriate conservative management and may prevent unnecessary interventions.
items.authors: Burmeister James R, Jawad Malik, Zazay Ismail, Kobernick Aaron
items.summary_ja: セマグルチド治療開始後に約200ポンドの意図的な減量を経た79歳男性が、間欠的な両側性耳閉塞感と耳の「ポッピング」を主訴に来院した。耳鏡所見は異常なく、以前のティンパノメトリーでは中耳圧が正常であった。閉塞性耳管機能障害を思わせる所見がないことから、弛緩性耳管機能障害（PETD）と臨床診断された。水分補給、鼻腔内生理食塩水、去充血薬の回避による保存的治療が行われた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬治療に伴う急速かつ極端な減量はPETDを誘発し得るため、耳閉塞感と正常な中耳所見を呈する患者において本症を考慮すべきである。
items.why_matters_ja: セマグルチドをはじめとするGLP-1受容体作動薬の肥満管理における使用増加に伴い、著明かつ急速な減量が増加しており、未認識の耳科合併症の潜在的可能性が高まっている。本関連の認識は適切な保存的治療を支持し、不要な介入を防止できる可能性がある。
items.study_type_ja: 単例報告（Case Report）
items.endpoints_ja: 単例報告であり、正式な評価項目（endpoint）は定義されていない。臨床診断（PETD）と保存的治療による管理が記載されている。

items.title: Current therapeutic landscape and future treatment perspectives of MASH.
items.abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), the progressive form of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), is a heterogeneous and systemic disease that confers risk not only for cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but also for extrahepatic complications including cardiovascular disease and chronic kidney disease. Over the past decade, numerous late-stage clinical trials have advanced the therapeutic landscape of MASH, culminating in a pivotal inflection point with accelerated approval of the thyroid hormone receptor-β (THRβ) agonist resmetirom and the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonist semaglutide, establishing pharmacological options for patients with non-cirrhotic MASH and fibrosis. Concurrently, growing evidence indicates that MASH comprises distinct, partially overlapping disease subsets, ranging from liver-centric phenotypes with accelerated fibrogenesis and liver-related outcomes to cardiometabolic phenotypes characterized by insulin resistance and increased cardiovascular risk. This suggests that optimal treatment efficacy will require stratified and potentially combinatorial approaches. In addition to lifestyle interventions, a cornerstone of MASLD management, pharmacotherapies targeting metabolic dysfunction (including PPAR agonists, FGF21 analogues or incretin-based and glucagon-based therapies), fibrogenesis, inflammation and/or the gut-liver axis are emerging. In this Review, we summarize the therapeutic landscape for MASH and discuss how recent advances in disease phenotyping and biomarkers may enable a transition towards personalized therapy.
items.authors: Gallage Suchira, Govaere Olivier, Anstee Quentin M, Shulman Gerald I, Tacke Frank, Heikenwalder Mathias
items.summary_ja: MASH（代謝機能異常関連脂肪性肝炎）の治療の現状と将来の展望を総説したレビュー論文。過去10年間の後期臨床試験の進展を概観し、甲状腺ホルモン受容体β（THRβ）アゴニストのレスメチロームとGLP-1受容体アゴニストのセマグルチドの加速承認を転換点として位置づけている。また、MASHが肝臓中心型と心代謝型という部分的に重複する異なる疾患サブセットから構成されることを示唆し、層別化・併用アプローチの必要性を論じている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MASHは肝臓中心型（線維化加速・肝関連アウトカム）と心代謝型（インスリン抵抗性・心血管リスク増大）という部分的に重複する異なる疾患サブセットから構成されており、最適な治療効果には層別化および潜在的な併用アプローチが必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: MASHは肝硬変・肝細胞癌だけでなく、心血管疾患や慢性腎臓病などの肝外合併症のリスクも伴う疾患であり、レスメチロームとセマグルチドの加速承認により、非肝硬変性MASHかつ線維化を有する患者に対して薬物治療の選択肢が確立された。

items.title: From measured BMI to documented obesity in hospitalized adults: a decade-long analysis and implications for cardiometabolic care.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Obesity contributes substantially to cardiometabolic and overall morbidity and mortality, yet remains underdiagnosed in clinical practice. We aimed to assess discharge documentation rates of obesity among hospitalized patients with elevated body mass index (BMI) and compare these with coding rates of other cardiometabolic risk factors.
METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of adults hospitalized between 2013 and 2023 with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² and no prior coded obesity or bariatric surgery. Obesity and metabolic comorbidities were identified via ICD-9 codes.
RESULTS: Among 42,243 eligible adults (mean age 60.9 ± 16.9 years; 49.7% women; mean BMI 33.9 ± 3.9 kg/m²), only 10.6% had obesity documented at discharge. The likelihood of coding increased by 17% for each additional BMI unit (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.16-1.18). Documentation was associated with higher utilization of obesity-related care, including metabolic clinic attendance (OR 2.26, 95% CI 2.05-2.49), bariatric surgery (OR 3.51, 95% CI 2.74-4.51), and GLP-1 receptor agonist prescriptions (OR 3.44, 95% CI 2.76-4.28). In comparison, diabetes was documented in 59.7% of patients with HbA1c ≥ 6.5%, and severe dyslipidemia in 39.0% of those with LDL-C ≥ 190 mg/dL.
CONCLUSIONS: Despite being objectively measurable, obesity remains substantially underdocumented compared with other cardiometabolic risk factors. Documentation was associated with greater uptake of metabolic clinic visits, bariatric surgery, and GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy. As effective obesity treatments become routine practice, closing this documentation gap is a prerequisite for translating measured BMI into actionable care.
items.authors: Avivi Ido, Zelmanoff Daniel D, Golan Netanel, Arbel Yaron
items.summary_ja: 2013年から2023年に入院したBMI≥30 kg/m²で既往に肥満コードまたは肥満手術の既往がない成人42,243例を対象とした横断的解析。退院時の肥満文書化率は10.6%のみであり、他の心代謝リスク因子（糖尿病59.7%、重症脂質異常症39.0%）と比較して著しく低かった。肥満の文書化は代謝外来受診（OR 2.26）、肥満手術（OR 3.51）、GLP-1受容体作動薬の処方（OR 3.44）と関連していた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 客観的に測定可能な肥満は、他の心代謝リスク因子と比較して依然として著しく文書化不足であり、この文書化ギャップの解消は測定されたBMIを実践的なケアに変換するための前提条件である。
items.why_matters_ja: 効果的な肥満治療が標準的な診療になるにつれ、肥満の文書化ギャップを解消することは、測定されたBMIを実践的なケアに変換するための前提条件となる。文書化の有無が代謝外来受診、肥満手術、GLP-1受容体作動薬療法の利用率に影響することを示し、臨床現場におけるドキュメント管理の改善が患者アウトカムに直結することを示唆する。
items.study_type_ja: 横断的解析（retrospective cross-sectional analysis）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：BMI≥30 kg/m²の入院患者における退院時の肥満文書化率。副次エンドポイント：他の心代謝リスク因子（糖尿病、重症脂質異常症）との文書化率の比較、肥満文書化と肥満関連ケアの利用率（代謝外来受診、肥満手術、GLP-1受容体作動薬処方）との関連。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 退院時の肥満文書化率：10.6%。BMI 1単位増加あたりの文書化オッズ比：OR 1.17（95% CI 1.16-1.18）。肥満文書化と代謝外来受診：OR 2.26（95% CI 2.05-2.49）。肥満文書化と肥満手術：OR 3.51（95% CI 2.74-4.51）。肥満文書化とGLP-1受容体作動薬処方：OR 3.44（95% CI 2.76-4.28）。糖尿病文書化率（HbA1c≥6.5%の患者）：59.7%。重症脂質異常症文書化率（LDL-C≥190 mg/dLの患者）：39.0%。
